plugins.readme_text:
# oh-my-dsh-omo-fork-chs

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@tacrine_f/oh-my-dsh-omo-fork-chs)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tacrine_f/oh-my-dsh-omo-fork-chs)
[![license: SUL-1.0 (content) + MIT (packaging)](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-SUL--1.0_(content)_%2B_MIT_(packaging)-orange)](#license)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19.0%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24.0.0-blue)](#peer-model)

The **Simplified-Chinese unofficial fork** of the `tri-agent` agent preset, packaged for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh) as a publishable Cordis
bundle. Its preset id is `omo-fork-chs` and its `order` is `11`, so it sits beside `tri-agent`
rather than replacing it: this package **does not change the default preset** and does not change
which preset a session picks. Only the persona prose is translated; the toolchain composition and
the orchestration doctrine are the upstream design.

The preset gives an agent a two-mode identity and a full coding toolchain:

- **Atlas** is the standing orchestrator. It does not implement, verify, or review; it reads the
  plan, the notepad and the evidence, does the bookkeeping, and delegates every unit of work to a
  named subagent.
- **Prometheus** is the planning doctrine. While a session is in plan mode (`/plan`), the identity
  swaps to Prometheus for the whole planning session and then swaps back. A single plugin,
  `plan-aware-persona.mjs`, owns the one `deployment:persona-prefix` slot and chooses the text per
  assembly by reading the public `plan` session projection. The `planMode` service is deliberately
  not injected: it lives inside the `isolate: { planMode: true }` realm, so injecting it from
  outside would never resolve.

Around that identity the preset mounts the coding toolchain: filesystem and shell tools, background
jobs, skills, goals, plan mode, compaction, delegation and workflows. The declaration carries 40
`- id:` rows, of which 9 are anchored subagent rows (explore, librarian, oracle, momus,
multimodal-looker, sisyphus-junior, metis, hephaestus, sisyphus). The package ships **11 persona
files**; the plugin reads `atlas.md` and `prometheus.md` itself, and the other 9 are anchored to the
subagent rows.

## What ships

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The published bundle patch: the preset declaration (`id: preset-omo-fork-chs`, `config.id: omo-fork-chs`, `config.name: 'Oh My DSH Chs - OMO Fork'`, `order: 11`) and its `plugins:` list. 540 lines, 11 rewritten sites. |
| `plan-aware-persona.mjs` | The package entry that registers the plan-aware persona prefix and the configured suffix. Exported as `./persona`. |
| `index.js` | The package root. It is intentionally empty: the bundle's behaviour lives in `cordis.patch.yml` and in `./persona`. |
| `personas/` | 11 persona documents, translated into Simplified Chinese. |
| `baseline/` | A frozen snapshot of the pre-port patch plus a sidecar that explains what it does and does not prove. |
| `tools/` | The port, verification, baseline and package-check CLIs. |
| `test/` | The zero-dependency test suite, run with `node --test`. |
| `LICENSE-MIT.md` | The MIT terms that cover our own work. |
| `LICENSE-SUL-1.0.md` | The verbatim upstream Sustainable Use License 1.0 terms, which cover the upstream-derived content. |
| `NOTICE.md` | The modification notice, the upstream attribution, and the machine-readable license scope mapping. |

The patch mounts the following peer packages, which DSH provides:

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset`, `dsh-agent-instructions`, `dsh-tool-bash`, `dsh-tool-pwsh`,
`dsh-tool-fs`, `dsh-tool-fs-search`, `dsh-tool-jobs`, `dsh-skill-filesystem`, `dsh-tool-skill`,
`dsh-command-goal`, `dsh-tool-goal`, `dsh-plan-mode`, `dsh-compaction-basic`, `dsh-command-compact`,
`dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner`, `dsh-tool-subagent-control`, `dsh-tool-subagent`,
`dsh-workflow-ptc`, `dsh-tool-workflow`, `dsh-tool-ralph`, `dsh-tool-ask-user`, `dsh-tool-todo`,
`dsh-tool-web`, `dsh-tool-present`, plus `@deepseek-ai/cordis`. That is 25 peer dependencies in
total.

## Install

Installation is **two explicit steps**. Step 1 installs the dependency; step 2 tells the profile to
load it. Both are required, and `dsh` is not assumed to be on your `PATH`.

### Step 1: install the package into the profile

Point the CLI at your DSH checkout's bin file, and forward the install to the profile:

```powershell
node "<dsh bin>" plugin --profile <profile> add -w @tacrine_f/oh-my-dsh-omo-fork-chs
```

For example, on a checkout whose runtime is `<dsh runtime>`, `<dsh bin>` is
`<dsh runtime>\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js`, so:

```powershell
node "<dsh runtime>\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js" plugin --profile web add -w @tacrine_f/oh-my-dsh-omo-fork-chs
```

This runs pnpm inside `$DSH_HOME\profiles\<profile>\`, so it writes a `dependencies` entry. **It
does not touch `dsh.profile.bundles`.**

### Step 2: add the package to `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart

Open `$DSH_HOME\profiles\<profile>\package.json` and add the package name to the profile's
`dsh.profile.bundles` array:

```jsonc
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        // ...your existing bundles...
        "@tacrine_f/oh-my-dsh-omo-fork-chs"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Then **restart the Host and start a new session.** A live agent keeps the composition it booted
with, so an already-running session will not pick the preset up; a new session is required.

### Verify the install composed

```powershell
$env:DSH_HOME = "<dsh home>"
node "<dsh bin>" --profile <profile> --dump-config
```

The output should contain a `preset-omo-fork-chs` row whose `name` is
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset`, whose `config.id` is `omo-fork-chs`, whose `config.name` is
`'Oh My DSH Chs - OMO Fork'` and whose `config.order` is `11`, plus nine `personas` expressions
resolving through this package. `--dump-config` prints the raw `!!js` expression text, so the nine
anchors appear as the `resolve('<pkg>/package.json')` form rather than as resolved filesystem
paths.

## Post-install edits you may need

The published patch ships **only** the portable preset declaration. Two things that were local to
the machine this fork came from are deliberately **not** shipped, so you may want to re-add them
yourself:

1. **Making `omo-fork-chs` your default preset.** The published patch does **not** set a default
   preset, and this package never forces one. If you want this preset to be the default, set the
   registry row yourself in your own profile or overlay patch:

   ```yaml
   - id: agent-preset-registry
     config:
       default: omo-fork-chs
   ```

   (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` inserts that row with `default: standard`; the row above replaces the
   whole config, so only the default changes.)

2. **Giving `subagent_multimodal_looker` a model route.** The bundle this fork was derived from
   carried a machine-specific `provider` and `model` route for that row, and that route is **not
   portable**, so the published patch carries no `agentOptions` row at all. Without one the
   multimodal subagent inherits the deployment's route. To pin one, add an `agentOptions` block to
   that row in your own overlay:

   ```yaml
   - id: tool-subagent-multimodal-looker
     name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
     config:
       # ...the shipped config...
       agentOptions:
         provider: <your provider>
         model: <your model>
   ```

## Failure mode: it fails loud on purpose

`plan-aware-persona.mjs` reads its persona prose from disk at mount time. A **missing or empty
persona file fails the mount**, naming the file in the error:

```
plan-aware-persona: cannot read persona "file:///.../personas/atlas.md"
plan-aware-persona: persona "file:///.../personas/atlas.md" is empty
```

That is deliberate. An empty persona prefix would silently strip the agent's identity, so a mount
error that names the file is far easier to act on than an agent that quietly lost its instructions.

## Peer model

Every `@deepseek-ai/*` package the patch mounts is declared as a **`peerDependency`**, never as a
regular `dependency`. DSH provides them; the bundle must not install its own

plugins.description: 给 DSH 会话头部加一颗重启按钮：完全退出并把新实例拉回来，全程零窗口。非官方插件。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-restart-button

会话头部右侧那一排里的那颗「⟳」（就在那颗文件夹图标右边一格，纯图标，不带字）：**完全退出 DeepSeek Harness，再把新实例拉起来。**

给"改了插件代码 → 必须重启才生效"这件事准备的。点击到界面回来约 8 秒，全程没有终端窗口。

## 怎么工作的

宿主自己就是那个要被关掉的东西，而且**它所在的那棵进程树是一个作业对象：树里的一切连同宿主一起死**。
所以流程分成"找死"和"活着"两只手：

```
点 ⟳（3 秒倒计时，可取消）
  └─ 宿主：spawn helper（PowerShell）→ 立刻回 HTTP 响应
       └─ helper（restart-dsh.ps1）：
            1. 写 relay-config.json（参数）和 relay-launch.vbs（无窗口入口）
            2. schtasks 建一次性任务并运行：
               动作 = wscript.exe //B relay-launch.vbs
               wscript 是 GUI 子系统程序，系统不给它建控制台；VBS 再以窗口样式 0 跑拉起器
               不成就退到 WMI，再退到 Shell.Application，最后才是自己拉
            3. 回读日志，确认出现新的 `relay start` —— 确认它活着，才继续
            4. 软杀 2 秒 → 强杀（CloseMainWindow / Stop-Process）
            5. 退出。它会被作业对象带走，无所谓了
       └─ 拉起器（relaunch-dsh.ps1，隐藏运行，活在外面）：
            读 relay-config.json
            → 等旧实例真的消失（每 250ms 轮询，最多 20 秒；等不到就退出不启动）
            → 用 explorer.exe 起 DSH（不继承控制台）
            → 等 127.0.0.1:19387 重新监听 → 删掉计划任务 → 记一行 ok
```

## 为什么是这些形状（每条都是实测换来的）

1. **不能用 `node:child_process`**：从宿主里 spawn 出来的子进程 63 毫秒就"退出 0"，脚本一行都没跑。
   改用 DSH 自己的 `ctx.subprocess`（工具调用走的就是它）。
2. **拉起器必须由服务创建**：作业对象连坐。`Shell.Application` 转发看着成功，实测那个进程仍在作业里，
   在宿主死的同一瞬间被杀。只有计划任务 / WMI 创建的进程能活。
3. **必须先确认它活着才动刀**：不然杀了之后没人拉，DSH 就死在那儿。
4. **DSH 必须由 explorer 起**：`Start-Process` 会让 DSH 成为当前控制台的子进程，Chromium 会主动 attach 上去，
   于是那个窗口在 DSH 活着期间不会关，而关掉它会给 DSH 发 CTRL_CLOSE —— DSH 跟着死。
5. **计划任务的动作必须是 GUI 子系统程序**：这台机器默认终端是 Windows Terminal，
   `powershell.exe -WindowStyle Hidden` 拦不住 WT 窗口（`GetConsoleWindow` 都返回 0）。wscript 才真没有窗口。
6. **`.ps1` / `.cmd` 一律纯 ASCII**：PowerShell 5.1 读没有 BOM 的 .ps1 按 ANSI/GBK 解释，
   UTF-8 中文注释会**吃掉换行**，把下一行代码并进注释里静默不执行（曾让 `$alive = Get-Targets` 消失，
   日志显示 `alive=0`，我为此查了三轮）。校验：`Select-String -Pattern '[^\x00-\x7F]'` 应为空。
7. **别用 `$home`**：它和自动变量 `$HOME` 同名（不区分大小写），赋值静默失效，
   relay-config.json 曾被写到 `C:\Users\<user>\` 根下。用 `$pluginHome`。
8. **`schtasks /TR` 上限 261 字符**：所以任务不传参数，参数走 relay-config.json。

## 装法

```powershell
# 1. 接进 profile（file: 依赖 + bundles 行 + pnpm install）
#    推荐直接用 DSH 的插件管理器装这个 spec：
#    file:E:/agent/projects/dsh-restart-button

# 2. 刷新页面（Ctrl+Shift+R）
```

改这个插件的代码：

```powershell
node E:\agent\projects\dsh-restart-button\tools\sync.mjs
# 然后点会话头部那颗 ⟳
```

`sync.mjs` 那一步不能省：profile 用的是 `nodeLinker: hoisted`，`file:` 依赖是**装的时候抄一份**，
源目录和运行时目录是两份独立的数据（实测不是硬链接，`fsutil hardlink list` 各只列自己一条）。
宿主加载的、按 ⟳ 时找的，都是抄过去的那份。

`tools/` 必须跟着一起同步 —— 按钮找的 `restart-dsh.ps1` 就在抄过去的那份里，
只同步 `lib` / `client` 的话，脚本改了多少次按钮都还是跑旧的。

## 用法

- **界面**：会话头部右侧那一排，文件夹图标右边一格，只有一个 ⟳。点一下 3 秒倒计时，再点一下取消。
- **命令**：`/restart now`、`/restart dry`（空转自检，只报账不动手）、`/restart status`。
- **兜底**：双击仓库里的 `tools\restart-dsh.cmd`（路径跟着自己走，界面挂了也能用，走同一个 helper）。
  桌面上那份独立拷贝已移除，免得两个入口各跑一份脚本。

## 日志

`~/.dsh/dsh-restart-button/restart.log`。一次成功的重启：

```
helper start: pid=4516 exe='E:\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe' grace=2s caller='header-button' consoleHidden=False
relay: arming (baseline relay-start lines = 8, config = '...\relay-config.json', launcher = '...\relay-launch.vbs', taskCmdLength = 92)
relay: schtasks create -> 成功: 成功创建计划任务 "dsh-restart-button-relay"。
relay start: pid=35280 exe='E:\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe' wait=20s port=19387
relay armed via: schtasks
stage1: alive=7 pid=16928,20316,27764,34312,35084,35612,35664
stage2: force kill 7 pid=...
relay: old instance is gone, launching in 600ms
relay launched via explorer: E:\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe
relay: new instance visible = True
ok: 127.0.0.1:19387 is listening again
relay: scheduled task removed
```

## 已知边界

- **只支持 Windows**：计划任务、WMI、镜像名收尸、控制台语义，全是 Win32 玩法。
- **会打断正在跑的回合**：所以有 3 秒倒计时。
- **需要计划任务或 WMI 至少一个可用**：都被策略封掉的机器上，会退到 shell / inline，那时窗口可能又出现
  且不一定起得来；`relay abort` 那几行会说明是卡在哪一步。
- **helper 自己那个控制台窗口**：它由插件的 `ctx.subprocess` 拉起，可能闪一下（约 8 秒内随 helper 退出消失）。
  要彻底消除得让插件改走 `wscript` 调 helper，那是宿主半的改动，需要一次宿主重载。
- **不是官方插件**：跟着 DSH 版本走，宿主那层的服务名变了就得跟着改。

plugins.description: 基金申请书核对：依据《国家自然科学基金条例》《2026 年度国家自然科学基金项目指南·申请规定》（国务院令第796号、2026 年度）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-nsfc-form-check — NSFC proposal form review and identity-clue prompting against the institution's own roster

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-nsfc-form-check` reads one NSFC proposal — its body lines, its electronic document properties, and the institution's own roster of identity terms — and checks that material against a versioned rule pack: whether a roster is configured at all, where the configured applicant, institution and advisor terms occur in the body and inside a configured line range, what the title, author, company and last-modified-by properties carry, whether the material fits the length limit the deployment set, whether the configured form-review items and duplicate-application disclosure are present, whether the advisor's name has been filled in as the yearly guidelines require, and whether any configured classified or sensitive term appears. Every finding names the clause it came from, states whether that clause is a direct requirement, a principle or a local configuration, and every check that could not run is listed in `skipped` with its reason.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-nsfc-form-check: real output over its NF-009 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-nsfc-form-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-nsfc-form-check-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `NF-009` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| Nobody filled in the applicant name list. Does the identity checking just pass? | No. `NF-001` is the first thing reported when `authorNames`, `institutionNames` and `advisorNames` are all empty, and every identity check that needs those terms reports itself in `skipped` with its reason. An empty finding list therefore never means nothing was wrong — read `NF-001` and the `skipped` entries before drawing any conclusion. |
| A co-author with the same surname as the applicant appears in the body text. | `NF-002` matches the configured `authorNames` literally, line by line, so a namesake, a common surname or a citation of another researcher's work can all be reported. The finding is a technical prompt only — 《国家自然科学基金条例》(国务院令第796号) 第二十一条 requires confidentiality from reviewers and says nothing that forbids a name in the body — so a term you have already cleared can be added to `allowList`. |
| The author property holds a name. Is that reported, and does it need a configured list? | Yes, and no. `NF-006` does not need a roster: with `authorNames` empty it still reports any non-empty author property, and with a roster configured it says whether the value matches an applicant name. `NF-005`, `NF-007` and `NF-008` do need an identity-term list and enter `skipped` without one. All four only read the properties, so they say nothing about the body text. |
| I filled in the page and word limits myself. Will it tell me the proposal is too long? | Only within the limit you set. `NF-010` ships `maxLines` and `maxChars` unset and enters `skipped`, because those limits change every year and by project type; once you fill them in it reports the extracted paragraph count or the character total that exceeds them. `maxLines` counts extracted paragraphs, not typeset pages, so it is not the same as a page count. |
| Did the material include every form-review item our research office asks for? | `NF-011` reports itself in `skipped` until `require` is configured, and with no checklist the plugin does not pretend to know one. Once configured it matches your `match` phrases literally and reports the ones it cannot find. It checks that the phrase is present, not that the column was filled in correctly or that the signature is genuine. |
| We are re-submitting last year's proposal. Must the disclosure note be there? | `NF-012` needs both `markerPatterns`, which recognise your template's wording for a repeat or follow-on application, and `requiredDisclosure`, which lists what must be disclosed. With either unset it enters `skipped`; when the markers are configured but no declaration is found it reports that this rule does not apply. It never assumes a disclosure wording, and never decides that a proposal really is a repeat. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《国家自然科学基金条例》 | 国务院令第796号 | NF-001, NF-002, NF-003, NF-004, NF-005, NF-006, NF-007, NF-008, NF-009, NF-010, NF-011, NF-012, NF-013, NF-014, NF-015 |
| 《2026 年度国家自然科学基金项目指南·申请规定》 | 2026 年度（逐年更新） | NF-014, NF-015 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks an **NSFC proposal's text and electronic document properties** and
reports the identity clues it finds, alongside the length and form-review items a deployment
configures. It is not `dsh-rulefile-check` (which audits the legality of a regulatory document), not
`dsh-policy-brief-draft` (which drafts a policy explainer), and not `dsh-review-reply-check` (which
tracks reviewer comments). It reads one proposal and reports literal matches against cited clauses.

> ### ⚠️ Read this before using the anonymity checks
>
> **There is no current national provision that forbids an applicant's name, institution or advisor
> from appearing in an NSFC proposal.** Three independent texts were read in full for this plugin —
> 《国家自然科学基金条例》(国务院令第796号), the 2026 年度《项目指南·申请规定》, and the 2019 年度
> guidelines — and none contains 匿名, 盲审, 活页, or any "must not appear" wording about identity.
> The regulation does not contain the word 匿名 at all. Its **avoidance** clause (第二十条) requires a
> reviewer from the applicant's own legal entity to recuse, which presupposes that the system knows
> the applicant's institution — the opposite of an anonymous process.
>
> So every finding this plugin makes about a name or an institution is a **technical observation for
> a human to weigh**, labelled 身份线索词 and never phrased as a violation. The plugin is useful for a
> research-office self-check, and it is **wrong to use it as a compliance gate**. Two rules go further
> and cite the guidance verbatim: `NF-014` checks that the advisor's name **is** filled in, because the
> yearly guidelines require it, and `NF-015` checks 涉密与敏感信息, which is the one "must not appear"
> requirement that really exists — and its object is classified information, not identity.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately not declared: it has no reader and cannot reject a host |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native`, `ptc` and `both`; for a batch of proposals use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `nsfc_form_check` tool. It reads one proposal — body text, document properties, and the
institution's own roster of identity terms — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report in
which every finding names the clause it came from and states whether that clause is a direct
requirement, a principle, or a local configuration.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NF-001` | a roster is configured, otherwise the identity checks cannot run | warn | principle |
| `NF-002` | the body mentions an applicant name | warn | principle |
| `NF-003` | the body mentions an institution name | warn | principle |
| `NF-004` | the body mentions an advisor name | warn | principle |
| `NF-005` | the document title property contains an identity clue | info | principle |
| `NF-006` | the author property is non-empty or names the applicant | info | principle |
| `NF-007` | the company property names the institution | info | principle |
| `NF-008` | the last-modified-by property names the applicant | info | principle |
| `NF-009` | identity clues inside a configured line range | info | principle |
| `NF-010` | the material fits the configured length limit | info | l

plugins.description: DSH 技能：情侣向睡前陪伴。一句温柔情话 → 一个谐音梗猜谜小故事 → 一句温柔晚安。131 条谐音词对、43 个落点，纯 Markdown、零依赖。
plugins.readme_text:
# 晚安 · wen-wanan

一个情侣向的睡前陪伴技能：触发后按「一句温柔情话 → 一个谐音梗猜谜小故事 → 一句温柔晚安」三段式输出。

技能名 `wen-wanan`，版本 `1.2.0`。

> **两种用法**：作为 **DSH 插件**一键安装（`skill("wen-wanan")` 可调用），或者作为**纯 Markdown 提示词**复制到任意 AI 助手。内容完全同一份。

## 它解决什么问题

睡前想说点什么，但想不出来——这大概是情侣之间最高频的小尴尬。

这个技能把"睡前话"拆成三段固定结构，每段只做一件事：

1. **情话**负责让人放松（具体、有动作、能念出口）
2. **谐音梗故事**负责让人笑（一本正经铺垫 → 突然拐到亲密的词上）
3. **晚安**负责落地（回扣上一段的词，不凭空起新话题）

三段顺序不能换：先被哄软，再被逗笑，最后被一句晚安送进被窝。

## 目录结构

```
wen-wanan/
├── SKILL.md                  # 技能主体（YAML 头：name / version / description）
├── references/
│   ├── pun-pool.md           # 谐音素材池：按落点分类的 131 条词对 + 三档判定
│   └── examples.md           # 五种排比句式的成稿示例 + 反面对照表
├── index.js                  # DSH 插件入口：把 SKILL.md 注册成 skill（不注册工具）
├── cordis.patch.yml          # DSH bundle 清单
├── package.json              # npm 元数据（dsh.bundle 指向上面那份清单）
├── README.md                 # 本文件
├── LICENSE                   # MIT
└── CHANGELOG.md              # 版本变更记录
```

## 怎么用

### 情况一：装成 DSH 插件（推荐）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:17897693/wen-wanan
```

装好后在会话里直接说「晚安」「哄我睡」等触发词即可，模型会自动调用 `skill("wen-wanan")`。

插件本身**不注册任何工具**，只负责把 `SKILL.md` 装载进技能目录——所以它不会影响你现有的其它插件。

### 情况二：手动放进技能目录

把 `SKILL.md` 与 `references/` 放进技能目录，**文件夹名与 `SKILL.md` 里的 `name` 保持一致**（`wen-wanan`），保持相对路径不变。

`SKILL.md` 顶部 `---` 之间是元数据：

- `name`：技能名，与文件夹名一致
- `version`：版本号
- `description`：触发说明，决定模型什么时候调用它

### 情况三：当作提示词粘贴（给非 DSH 的助手）

用文本编辑器打开 `SKILL.md`，把 `---` 之间的头信息和正文一起复制，粘贴给你的 AI 助手作为自定义指令（系统提示词／角色设定／自定义 GPT 的 Instructions）。

⚠️ **注意**：粘贴方案下，正文里 `references/xxx.md` 这样的相对路径**是失效的**（助手读不到你的本地文件）。要把两个 references 文件的内容**一并粘贴在后面**——素材池能明显提高谐音梗的稳定性，示例则能帮它找准句式。

### 情况四：只当素材库用

`references/pun-pool.md` 本身就是一份整理好的中文谐音词对表（131 条，按落点分组，标了声调档位）。不用 AI，当成写情话的点子库单独翻也有用。

## 设计要点（给想改的人）

- **禁词表是硬的**：正文列了 11 个书面腔词（愿／岁月／星河／温柔以待……），出现即重写。这条是整份文档最重要的约束——它决定了输出像不像"人说的话"。
- **先想谐音，再编故事**：反过来做（先编故事再硬塞读音）一定会生硬。素材池就是为这个顺序准备的。
- **兜底优先级**：排比 ＞ 亲密落点 ＞ 谐音。谐音可以松，前两样不能丢。
- **不用跨会话记忆**：技能明确要求模型不要假装记得昨晚用了什么词。用户主动提起才避开。
- **谐音分三档**：一档读音全同（最省力）、二档只差声调、三档声母韵母有差（备胎）。池子里一档占近一半。

## 备注

- 文件均为 UTF-8 无 BOM、纯 LF 行尾。Windows 记事本、macOS 文本编辑、VS Code、Typora 都能直接打开。
- 若记事本打开后中文显示乱码，是编码问题：改用 VS Code / Typora，或另存为 UTF-8。
- 内容定位是"睡前陪伴"，禁忌章节明确排除了擦边、土味梗与低俗荤梗。
- **隐私**：本技能零依赖、无网络请求、不读写用户文件。所有内容都在 `SKILL.md` 与 `references/` 里，可自行审阅。

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: DSH 会话历史查看器：项目内检索、Markdown 渲染阅读、一键导出对话 · Browse, search and export your DSH session history (offline, zero dependencies)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-history-viewer · DSH 历史查看器

**浏览、检索、导出你的 DSH 会话历史。** 纯本地读取会话日志，不依赖任何第三方插件，也不上传任何数据。

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-history-viewer?label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-history-viewer)
[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-xiao0xueAI%2Fdsh--history--viewer-blue)](https://github.com/xiao0xueAI/dsh-history-viewer)

一句话安装（然后**重启一次 `dsh web`**、刷新页面，左栏底部就会出现 🕘）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-history-viewer
```

> 本机 npm 源若是只读镜像（如 npmmirror）且装不到最新版，临时用官方源：
> `npm_config_registry=https://registry.npmjs.org dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-history-viewer`


> 为什么需要它：DSH 官方的历史类插件（如 `dsh-history`）已经不适配 0.2.x（peer 范围把新版本排除在外，启动时会被拒绝加载）。本插件直接读
> `~/.dsh/sessions/**/session.v*.jsonl.zstd`，把历史变成可检索、可阅读、可导出的资源，插件生态怎么变都不影响它。

## 功能

- **侧边栏入口**：侧栏底部出现 🕘 按钮，点开在应用内浮层查看（也可"在新标签页打开"）
- **按项目（工作区）过滤**：项目名取自 DSH 自己的 `storages/workspace.json`，改过名/搬过目录也能正确归类
- **📌 固定会话**：把常看的会话固定住，只看这些（按项目分别记录）
- **范围切换**：只看对话 / 含工具 / 全部（思考过程与上下文注入）
- **项目内全文检索**：搜索结果按会话分组、带上下文、关键词高亮，**点一条直接跳到原文位置并闪烁**
- **Markdown 渲染**：正文与搜索卡片都按 DSH 界面那样渲染（标题/表格/代码块/粗体），不显示源码符号
- **导出**：把当前范围的对话一键导出为 Markdown
- **本地缓存**：索引缓存在 `~/.dsh/dsh-history-viewer/`，过期自动后台重建

## 安装

在任意 profile 里：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-history-viewer
```

从本地目录安装（开发用）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-history-viewer
```

装完**重启一次 `dsh web`**（Host 半体会热加载，但浏览器端的模块清单在启动时组装）。刷新页面后，侧栏底部就有 🕘 按钮。

## 怎么用（上手 5 分钟）

**入口**：刷新页面后，**左侧栏最底部**有一个 🕘 按钮 → 点开在应用内浮层里显示完整界面；
浮层右上角还有「在新标签页打开」（适合长时间翻历史，或让界面占满屏幕）。

**界面地图**：

```
┌ 左栏 ──────────────────┐┌ 右栏 ─────────────────────────────┐
│ 搜索框（回车=搜对话）   ││ 标题 + 路径 + 原文/渲染 + 导出     │
│ 项目下拉（工作区）      ││ ───────────────────────────────── │
│ 范围：只看对话/含工具/全部│ 正文（分页：← 更早 / 更晚 →）      │
│ 📌 只看固定的 N 个      ││   或 搜索结果（按会话分组卡片）    │
│ 会话列表（📌 可固定）   ││                                   │
└────────────────────────┘└───────────────────────────────────┘
```

**四个最常用动作**：

1. **只看某个会话**：鼠标移到左栏会话上点 **📌** 固定它 → 顶部按钮变成「📌 只看固定的 1 个」；
   再点这个按钮就在"只看固定的"和"本项目全部"之间切换（固定按项目分别记）。
2. **找一句话**：搜索框输入关键词回车 → 右栏按会话分组列出命中（带上文/下文、关键词高亮）→
   **点任意一条直接跳到原文那条消息**并闪烁定位。右上角可调「每个会话显示 8/20/50/全部」。
3. **导出这段对话**：右上角「导出这段对话」→ 下载 Markdown（按当前项目/固定/范围过滤）。
4. **看操作细节**：范围切到「含工具」（工具调用与结果）或「全部」（含思考过程与上下文注入）。

**看长会话**：正文是分页的，顶部有「← 更早 / 更晚 →」与「第 X–Y 条 / 共 N 条」，不会一次吐几 MB。

**插件版 vs 独立版**：插件版跟着 DSH 走（DSH 起来就能用，无需另开进程）；
独立的命令行版本不依赖 DSH，双击它的 `查看历史.cmd` 即可使用，适合分享给不想装插件的人。

## 数据与隐私

- 只读 `<DSH_HOME>/sessions`（默认 `~/.dsh/sessions`）与 `<DSH_HOME>/storages/workspace.json`
- 写：仅在自己的缓存目录 `~/.dsh/dsh-history-viewer/`（索引与固定配置）
- 路由只服务本机：连接来源必须是回环地址 + `Host` 精确白名单 + `Sec-Fetch-Site`/`Origin` 同源 +
  本次运行随机令牌（`/api/*` 必须带 `x-hv-token`），不做任何外部网络请求
- 环境变量：`DSH_HOME` 可指定 DSH 数据目录；`DSH_HISTORY_VIEWER_DIR` 可指定缓存目录

## 常见问题

| 现象 | 原因 / 处理 |
|---|---|
| 侧栏底部没有 🕘 | 装完插件后**重启一次 `dsh web`** 再刷新页面（浏览器端模块清单在启动时组装） |
| 第一次打开停顿几秒 | 首次访问要在 worker 里建索引（本机 88 个会话约 6 秒，之后不再发生，且不阻塞 DSH） |
| 打开是空的 | 可能固定了某个会话而它不在当前项目里 —— 点顶部「📌 只看固定的」或把项目切到「全部项目」 |
| 搜索结果很长 | 正文分页 + 每会话命中条数可调；点命中会跳到原文位置 |

## 已知边界

- 索引是快照：新会话由后台 worker 重建（默认 5 分钟冷却）；因此刚发出的消息可能要等一次刷新
- 检索结果里超长内容会截断（工具结果 4000 字、单条命中 900 字），截断不会切断 `**粗体**` 标记；原始日志始终完整
- 多帧 zstd 靠帧魔数切分（Node 的流式解码只解第一帧）；解析失败/空帧会计入索引里的 `stats` 而不是静默丢弃


## 开发

```
index.js        Host 半体：ctx.webServer.register 挂 /plugins/dsh-history-viewer（界面 + API）
lib/core.js     核心：多帧 zstd 解析、v3/v4 日志抽取、按 id 合并副本、项目归属、检索、转录导出
client.js       Client 半体：sidebar.footer.action 入口 + shell.overlay 浮层（iframe）
ui.html         界面本体（零依赖前端：Markdown 渲染 + 高亮 + 分页展开）
locale/*.json   插件卡片文案（中文/英文）
cordis.patch.yml  bundle 行声明
```

- 服务端：`ctx.webServer.register({ kind: 'prefix', path, handler })`（`inject: ['webServer']`）
- 客户端：`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: '<包名>', factory })` + `ctx.slots.inject/register`
- 不 `require` 任何 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*`（版本漂移会让 slot 条目崩溃），React 从 module table 取

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH web plugin: arrange the list slots other plugins contribute to — show/hide, reorder, rename — without touching upstream.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-slots-manager

DSH web 插件：**编排其他插件贡献到界面上的槽位条目**——显示/隐藏、排序、改名——**不需要修改上游**（deepseek-harness）。

它由两部分组成：

- 一个**槽位无关的引擎**：在客户端槽位注册表（`ctx.slots`）的原型上打三个补丁，对每个纳管槽位套用一份策略；
- 一张**槽位表**（[`src/slots.ts`](src/slots.ts)）：唯一写明具体槽位的地方。**加一个槽位 = 加一行。**

## 管理哪些槽位

| 槽位 | 位置 | 隐藏 | 排序 | 改名 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `settings.section` | 「设置」对话框左侧导航里的分区 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `sidebar.panellist` | 左侧栏的面板图标按钮 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `sidebar.footer.action` | 左侧栏底部、Settings 旁边的动作 | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |

**`sidebar.footer.action` 为什么不能改名**：该槽位的注册项**不声明 `label`**，按钮文案由组件自己通过 locale 取，渲染器也从不读 `options.label`。改名在那里不会有任何可见效果，所以 UI **不提供**该按钮（而非提供后失效）。

**两个入口，同一个面板**：

| 入口 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| 「设置编排」 | 设置对话框左侧导航里的一个分区（排在顶部附近，**不可隐藏**） |
| 左侧栏「插件」页 → 本插件详情页 | 与 `dsh-mnemon`、`dsh-context` 的配置区同一位置（`plugins.bundle.config`，keyed by 包名） |

面板按组渲染：

```text
┌─ 设置页 ─────────────────────────────┐
│  设置分区      5 项      [重置本槽位] │
├─ 左侧边栏 ───────────────────────────┤
│  面板按钮      1 项      [重置本槽位] │
│  栏底动作      1 项      [重置本槽位] │
└──────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 原理：三个补丁 + 两条读路径

引擎在 `SlotRegistry.prototype` 上打三个补丁，覆盖所有注册与读取路径（cordis 服务代理每次访问都动态取方法、不缓存，因此对所有插件立即生效）：

| 补丁 | 拦截点 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `register` | 注册入口 | 记录**原值**（order / label / registrant）。这里不改写，保证 reset 永远能还原 |
| `entries` | 列表读取方（设置外壳的导航） | 过滤隐藏 + 读时改写 order/label（**返回克隆**，该路径没有 `isLive` 检查） |
| `entriesOfSlot` | 内容选举方（渲染器）+ 侧边栏自己的面板列表 | 过滤隐藏 + **原地替换 `entry.options`** |

### 为什么 `entriesOfSlot` 必须原地替换而不是克隆

渲染器对返回的 entry 做存活性检查，用**对象身份**比较：

```js
isLive(entry) {
  for (const rec of this.records.values()) if (rec.entries.includes(entry)) return true
  return false
}
```

返回克隆会直接抛 `StaleAuthorizationError`。所以这里换成「保留 `entry` 身份、替换 `entry.options`」——原 `options` 对象不被就地修改，读取方看到的始终是**生效值**（有覆盖用覆盖，否则回退原值），因此 `reset` 天然还原，不需要额外的还原逻辑。

### 需要捕获「补丁安装前」的注册

**基础分区（通用设置/模型/插件）先于任何 profile 插件注册**，它们的注册不经过补丁。如果没有原值，原地改写会让条目卡在被覆盖的值上、`reset` 无法还原。引擎因此在**首次读取**时补记原值（此时条目仍是干净的）。

### 持久化文档按槽位分组

```json
{ "version": 1, "slots": { "settings.section": { "hidden": {}, "order": {}, "labels": {} } } }
```

**分组是必须的，不是美化**：条目 id 只在单个槽位内唯一。`dsh-client-ui-plugin-manager` 用的侧边栏面板 id 就是 `plugins`，而它同时也是一个设置分区 id——扁平结构会让隐藏其中一个连带隐藏另一个。

策略经 **DSH 标准 settings 命名空间**（`slots-manager`）持久化：host 半区把策略声明为**自己的插件 `Config`**，客户端经 `remote.settings` Remote RPC 读写，由 SettingsProvider 落盘（纯服务端）。

> **为什么是 `Config` 而不是 `settings.register`**：现代 DSH 的 settings 服务**没有 `register`**。它按 `ns` 在 profile 的**可配置插件条目**里查：
>
> ```js
> const entry = configEditor.entries().find((row) => row.options.id === ns)
> const schema = entry?.fiber?.runtime?.Config
> if (entry === undefined || schema === undefined) throw new Error(`No configurable plugin entry "${ns}"`)
> ```
>
> 所以**命名空间 id 必须等于本插件的条目 id**（`slots-manager`，见 `cordis.patch.yml`），schema 必须是本模块导出的 `Config`，可编辑字段用 `meta.volatile` 标记 —— 这里整份文档都是 volatile，因为插件的全部配置就是这份策略。
>
> ⚠️ 顺带一提：`.volatile()` **只存在于 DSH 自带的 schemastery**（它给原型打了补丁），npm 上的 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery@3.18.1` 没有这个方法。`extra()` 的类型又不够宽，所以直接写 `meta.volatile` —— 三者产生的是同一个 `meta.volatile`，而 DSH 只读它。

## 安装

```bash
# 方式一：官方 CLI
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-slots-manager

# 方式二：profile 仓库（file: 依赖）
# package.json:
#   "dependencies": { "dsh-slots-manager": "file:../dsh-slots-manager" }
#   "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ ..., "dsh-slots-manager" ] } }
pnpm install
```

重启 `dsh web` 后生效。

> ⚠️ **与 `dsh-settings-manager` 互斥**：本插件是它的替代品（同一套补丁机制，范围更大）。两个同时启用会叠加两套补丁。启用前请先移除 `dsh-settings-manager`。
>
> 本插件也**不读取** `dsh-settings-manager` 留下的任何数据——命名空间与文档结构都是新的，旧配置不会迁移。

## 开发 / 构建

```bash
pnpm install        # 安装依赖
pnpm typecheck      # tsc --noEmit（严格模式）
pnpm build          # esbuild 打包 → lib/（client.js 包进 DSH __ModuleLoader__ 格式）
pnpm test           # 全部测试
```

`lib/` 是**构建产物**（已 gitignore），由 `pnpm build` 生成；`main`/`exports` 指向 `lib/`，所以用 `file:` 依赖前需先构建。

## 测试

```bash
pnpm test               # UT + e2e 冒烟（node:test）
pnpm test:unit          # 仅单元测试
pnpm test:e2e           # 仅 e2e 冒烟（jsdom 挂载真实组件）
pnpm test:playwright    # 真实浏览器对接运行中的 DSH
```

| 层 | 覆盖 |
|---|---|
| `tests/unit/policy.test.mjs` | 策略存储：读写、持久化、reset/resetAll、自身分区保护、启动加载 |
| `tests/unit/patches.test.mjs` | 三个补丁：注册经过、读路径隐藏/重排/改名、`entriesOfSlot` 身份安全、bump 无残留 |
| `tests/unit/reorder.test.mjs` | 重排原语与重编号 |
| `tests/unit/multi-slot.test.mjs` | **多槽位**：按槽位隔离、`entriesOfSlot` 上的隐藏/排序/改名、`isLive` 身份契约、补丁安装前注册的原值还原、**非纳管槽位逐字节不被触碰**、能力矩阵 |
| `tests/unit/compat.test.mjs` | **上游契约自检**：纳管槽位仍是 catalog 里的 `root`/`list` 槽位、`SlotRegistry` 仍暴露三个被补丁的方法。找不到 DSH 时**跳过**（不失败）—— CI 里由 `test` job 按 `DSH_VERSION` 装一份 DSH 并指向它，所以自检在 CI 上**真实执行**；本地可 `DSH_INSTALL_DIR=… pnpm test:unit` |
| `tests/e2e/smoke.test.mjs` | jsdom + react-dom 真实渲染面板：开关、重排、重置、改名、分组结构 |
| `tests/playwright/` | 真实浏览器：分区在导航顶部、面板渲染、开关/排序/重置/拖拽/改名（含刷新后持久） |

> **契约自检为什么重要**：引擎依赖两个它并不 import 的上游事实（三个原型方法、每个槽位是 `list`）。上游一改，插件会**静默失效**——面板里少一项，或 `installPatches` 直接放弃、整个插件什么都不做。这个测试把沉默变成红灯。
>
> 它也是踩过坑的：`register` 是**类体外**的原型赋值（`SlotRegistry.prototype.register = …`），而 `entries`/`entriesOfSlot` 是类成员。按源码结构搜索会误判成「没有 register」，所以探测必须针对实例原型。
>
> 另一处：它要探**两种 DSH 布局** —— 开发机全局安装是 `<dsh>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/*`（嵌套），而 CI 用 `npm install --prefix` 会把整棵树**提升到同级**。只探嵌套会让它因为与契约无关的原因在 CI 上红。
>
> CI 里 dsh 版本**钉在 workflow 级 `env: DSH_VERSION`**（全文件唯一出现处），不用浮动的 `@alpha`：自检断言的是「这个确切的构建仍声明了所补丁的槽位」，浮动 tag 会把上游漂移变成无法解释的红灯。

## 限制与说明

- **基础分区永远先于任何第三方插件注册**，注册入口抓不到它们——全部由读路径补丁覆盖，所以本插件不依赖加载顺序。
- 隐藏 `sidebar.panellist` 的条目**只是隐藏入口**：它对应的主面板可能仍能通过其他方式到达（侧边栏点击本身走 `selectPanel(id)`，即 id 就是面板 key）。
- 本插件自身分区（`slots-manager`）不可隐藏，保证管理入口始终可达；「Settings」入口位于 `sidebar.settings`（**不是** `sidebar.panellist`），所以即使隐藏了所有面板图标，也仍能进设置恢复。
- `sidebar.footer.action` 的隐藏与插件自带的显示开关（如 `dsh-context` 的 `insightsEntry`）功能重叠：插件自带的开关是组件返回 `null`，本插件是把注册项从槽位移除。两者不冲突，本插件的价值在于**统一位置**。
- 纳管槽位的顺序由该槽位的读取方决定，本插件通过改写 `options.order` 生效。
- 非纳管槽位（`conversation.*`、`plugins.*`、`shell.*` 等）**逐字节不被触碰**。

## 结构

```
src/slots.ts     纳管槽位表（唯一的「加一行」入口）
src/client.ts    浏览器半区源码：策略文档 + 三个补丁 + 管理面板
src/host.ts      宿主半区源码：导出 `Config`（= `slots-manager` settings 命名空间的 schema）
lib/client.js    构建产物（gitignore）：esbuild 打包 + DSH __ModuleLoader__.load 包装（只依赖 react seed）
lib/host.mjs     构建产物（gitignore）：宿主半区（ESM，import type 已擦除 → 零运行时导入）
scripts/build.mjs  构建（node scripts/build.mjs）；typecheck 用 pnpm typecheck
cordis.patch.yml 打包挂载声明
docs/design.md   设计与上游契约依据（权威出处、风险、分期）
tests/           单元测试（node:test）、e2e 冒烟（jsdom+react）、Playwright
```

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-stage-sandbox — 跨平台 dsh 沙箱 monorepo

本仓把两个**独立实现**的 dsh 沙箱插件合并为一个跨平台工作区，**保留两者各自的 git 历史**：

| 包 | 来源 | 平台 | 隔离机制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`packages/win`](packages/win) | `dsh-winstage-sandbox`（原 `dsh-sandbox-windows`） | Windows | 受限令牌（WRITE_RESTRICTED）+ ACL + Job Object + AppContainer + shim（file/reg IAT hook）+ 注册表暂存；DSH 审阅悬浮窗 |
| [`packages/linux`](packages/linux) | `dsh-sandbox-linux` v2.3 | Linux | bubblewrap + Landlock + seccomp + cgroup v2 + overlayfs；dry-run/commit 控制面 + CAS 发布 |
| [`packages/core`](packages/core) | 本仓新增 | 跨平台 | **起步为占位**：PAL（平台抽象层）契约 + 控制面共享接口的类型占位。真正的共享层抽取是后续独立任务。 |

两者共享同一架构语义（**暂存 → 候选冻结 → 选择性提交/审批**），但平台后端完全不同。
`packages/linux` 的 `src/pal/` 已声明"平台差异在 PAL 收敛、按 host 平台选后端、永不按 OS 名分支"，
本 monorepo 即以此为目标逐步把共享控制面收敛进 `packages/core`。

## 工作区

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm -r run typecheck        # 两包各自 tsc --noEmit
pnpm -C packages/linux test  # Linux：vitest
pnpm -C packages/win exec node tests/suite-wiring.ts   # Windows：离线治理套件（可在任意会话跑）
```

> `packages/win` 的 Windows 专属套件（受限令牌/ACL/AppContainer/shim）必须在 **Windows** 上跑；
> 离线确定性与治理套件可在任意平台跑。见 `packages/win/docs/测试套件总览.md`。
> `packages/linux` 的 bubblewrap/Landlock 用例在缺能力的宿主上会如实 SKIP。

## 加载方式（各自）

- **Windows**：`packages/win/dsh-plugin/cordis.patch.yml`（详见 `packages/win/README.md`）。
- **Linux**：`packages/linux` 的 profile patch（见 `packages/linux/README.md`）。

## 历史与合并

见 [`MERGE-NOTES.md`](MERGE-NOTES.md)。

plugins.description: Use your Kimi Code / Grok (X Premium) / Google Antigravity / GLM (BigModel) subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers - OAuth sign-in, per-model visibility, drag-to-reorder Auto fallback, and plan quotas from the Settings page. No API keys.
plugins.readme_text:
[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh.md)

# dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/EricFL1998/dsh-subscription-oauth)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth)
[![Licence: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/licence-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

**Use the AI subscriptions you already pay for as LLM providers in DeepSeek
Harness — no API key.** Sign in once per provider from **Settings →
Subscriptions** (订阅) and that account's models join the session model picker,
with its plan quota shown next to the connection.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth
```

The same package installs straight from the repository, which needs no registry:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:EricFL1998/dsh-subscription-oauth
```

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Capability** | 模型与推理 / Model & inference — it registers LLM provider routes |
| **Licence** | [MIT](LICENSE) |
| **Built for** | DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`), Node ≥ 20 |
| **Platforms** | Windows, macOS and Linux; nothing platform-specific beyond Node itself |
| **Accounts** | your own subscriptions only — credentials stay on your machine |
| **Network** | the providers' own hosts and the OAuth endpoints listed below; no telemetry, no third-party relay |

| Route | Provider | Login | Wire |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kimi` | Kimi Code | OAuth **device flow** (RFC 8628) | OpenAI **Responses** — `https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1/responses` |
| `grok` | Grok (X Premium) | OIDC **authorization code + PKCE** on a loopback callback | OpenAI **Responses** — `https://api.x.ai/v1/responses` |
| `antigravity` | Google Antigravity | Google **authorization code + PKCE** (`/oauth-callback`) plus Cloud AI Companion project discovery | Cloud Code Assist `v1internal` — `streamGenerateContent?alt=sse` |
| `glm` | GLM (BigModel) | ZCode's **browser sign-in with a polled flow** (China region) | OpenAI **Responses** — `https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4/responses` |
| `ark` | Volcengine Ark | Volcengine **SSO** (authorization code + PKCE on a loopback callback) | OpenAI **Responses** — `https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/coding/v3/responses` |
| `auto` | Auto | none — it holds no account of its own | delegates to whichever route owns the model it picks |

The Kimi device flow is the one `opencodex` uses; the Grok flow is the one its
CLI uses (`auth.x.ai` discovery, client `b1a00492-…`, port `56121`, scope
`grok-cli:access`); the Antigravity flow is Google's desktop OAuth client
(`accounts.google.com`, port `51121`, scopes including `cclog` and
`experimentsandconfigs`), with the account's project discovered through
`loadCodeAssist`.

**GLM signs in the way ZCode does**, not with an API key: the plugin asks
`zcode.z.ai` for a login flow, opens `bigmodel.cn/login` in the browser, and polls
the flow until the subscription's tokens come back. Nothing has to receive a
`zcode://oauth/callback` redirect and no app secret is involved, because the
callback is completed server-side and the flow is authenticated by a secret the
plugin generates itself. Allowances are read from BigModel's own
`/api/monitor/usage/quota/limit`, which meters a rolling five-hour window and a
weekly one.

**Ark signs in with Volcengine SSO** (authorization code + PKCE on a loopback
callback, the flow its own CLI uses) and then has to satisfy two planes that want
different credentials. The **data plane** takes only an ordinary API key as a plain
bearer — it refuses STS credentials outright — while the **control plane**, a
different host, is signed with the temporary STS credentials that the SSO token
response carries. So a sign-in mints one API key through the control plane (reusing
a key this plugin already created, if there is one) and keeps the STS set for the
quota, which is read per subscription period and per model's free allowance.

## What it registers

| Surface | What appears |
| --- | --- |
| `ctx.llm` | the `kimi`, `grok`, `antigravity`, `glm` and `auto` provider routes (models, reasoning efforts, streaming) |
| Settings | a **Subscriptions** section: one card per provider — sign in, sign out, default account, token refresh, plan quota, model catalog, manage dialog |
| Model picker | each provider's own models, plus **`auto` as its own route** spanning them — Kimi ships `kimi-for-coding`, `k3`, `k3[1m]`, `k3-256k`; Grok seeds `grok-4.6`, `grok-4.5` and adds whatever its live catalog reports; Antigravity lists the agent-callable subset of what its endpoint reports (`fetchAvailableModels`), filtering out tabs, commit-message and transcription surfaces; GLM ships the `glm-5.3` family (`glm-5.3`, `glm-5.3-flash`, `glm-5.2`, `glm-5.1`, `glm-5`) and adds whatever its coding host lists |

Credentials live at `~/.dsh/plugins/kimi-oauth/auth.json` (mode `0600`,
written atomically, one section per provider). The directory keeps the name this
plugin had when it served Kimi Code alone: it holds **live logins**, so it is left
in place rather than renamed, and every profile that mounted the earlier version
finds its accounts exactly where it left them. This machine's Kimi device id
lives beside it in `kimi-device-id`; it is stable across restarts, because the
service correlates usage to it.

### Token lifetimes, and why the card may say "expired"

Kimi Code access tokens live **15 minutes**; the refresh token lives **30 days**.
Grok access tokens are similar. Every request refreshes automatically when the
access token is within five minutes of lapsing, and the Settings card refreshes
eagerly while you are looking at it — so what it shows is the live expiry, and
"token expired" appears only when a refresh genuinely failed and the account
needs a new sign-in. Access-token expiry is normal and does not mean the login
is gone.

## Settings page

| Every route folded | A subscription card open | A card with its catalog |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ![Folded provider list](docs/images/providers-folded.png) | ![GLM card with plan quota](docs/images/glm-card-open.png) | ![Kimi card with its catalog](docs/images/kimi-card-open.png) |

The page leads with **`auto`**, the way to reach every other route at once; the
routes it stands in for follow in the order they were configured. Each route is one
**folded row** — status dot, name, route key, a one-line summary of the connection,
and an **Edit** button — so the section reads as a list of providers and opens one
on demand. **Every visit starts folded** — an open card is a gesture within one
visit, not a stored setting — so re-opening Settings always shows the same compact
list. Inside an open card are the
account rows (★ sets the default account, `退出登录`/`Sign out` removes one), the
model catalog, and the plan quota. Controls follow the host's own settings-form
vocabulary — a 6 px radius (`--dsw-radius-sm`), a transparent fill, a hairline
border, and the theme's hover/active/focus tokens — declared in one scoped
stylesheet, so the page keeps that look instead of falling back to the browser's
default button chrome.

The **Models** heading is its own disclosure, **folded on every visit** too: click it to open the
catalog. **Each model has its own switch** (a toggle,
not a checkbox), which decides whether the session model picker offers it. The
choice is stored on the host (`~/.dsh/plugins/kimi-oauth/preferences.json`) as a
hidden list, so it survives restarts and every session sees it; a model added by a
later catalog refresh appears automatically rather than arriving hidden. A hidden
model is listed dimmed and stays **resolvable** — an existing session that already
selected it keeps working — so hiding is a picker-visibility choice, not a
revocation. `· 已隐藏 N 个` in the header counts the hidden ones.

**Add model** publishes an id this build has never heard of, so a model released
after the plugin was built is usable at once. The id is checked for shape, not
against a list — the endpoint is the only authority on what it serves — and it is
stored per route, published with conservative m

plugins.description: Self-learning agent skills for DeepSeek Harness: evidence-gated auto-publishing, bounded growth and safe recovery.
plugins.readme_text:
# Skill Workshop for DeepSeek Harness

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) · [Security](SECURITY.md)

A native DSH **skill authoring and self-learning workshop**. Import, edit, and manage `SKILL.md`-based skills, or let completed tasks produce candidate procedures that can be promoted automatically after evidence checks.

## Features

- Browse, create, update, and import native DSH skills from Markdown, directories, and supported skill archives.
- Learn reusable workflows from completed tasks without granting a model direct write access to the published skill root.
- **Unattended auto-promotion by default:** the same skill needs evidence from at least **two distinct successful task turns**, each linked to genuine user requests and assistant results.
- Guard against uncontrolled growth: bounded candidates and managed skills, stale-candidate expiry, history pruning, and retirement of unused workshop-owned skills.
- Protect manual edits and externally managed skills from automated overwrite; recover interrupted publications using durable records and hash checks.

## Install

Requires native DSH skill and session services; runtime and peer requirements are listed in [package.json](package.json).

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Kerberos255/dsh-skill-workshop
```

Replace the profile name as needed, pin a commit if desired, and restart DSH after installing or upgrading code.

## Quick start

1. Open **Settings → Plugins → Skill Workshop**. Choose the project skill root (`.dsh/skills`) or user skill root (`DSH_HOME/skills`).
2. Run regular DSH tasks. Eligible successful turns may generate **skill candidates**; short, failed and interrupted tasks are skipped.
3. Once a candidate has independent evidence from two distinct turns and passes checks, the workshop **publishes it without asking for per-skill manual confirmation**.
4. Inspect candidate/managed counts and customize limits, or use the editor/import screen for manual skills. Manual import and external edits retain their review flow.

## Growth-control defaults

| Bound | Default |
| --- | --- |
| Pending auto-learned candidates per workspace | **32** |
| Workshop-managed skills per workspace | **64** |
| Candidate expiry without fresh evidence | **45 days** |
| Automatic learning cooldown / daily attempts | **60 minutes / 8** |
| Managed skill retirement / grace | **90 days idle / 7 days** |
| Processed automatic-learning records | **180 days** |

Candidate evidence is a **source and repetition safeguard**, **not proof that a procedure was re-executed or externally validated**. Automatic publication will not overwrite a manually edited skill, and reaching the managed cap blocks new automatic skills.

## Data and testing

Candidate and publication state live in local DSH SQLite; published skills remain files in the chosen native skill root. Interrupted changes are checked and may require human review **only for conflicts or unusual recovery states**. No secret/session database belongs in the public repository.

Run `npm test` for portable tests. Live model learning and DSH registry/UI behavior require separate integration testing. See [config.example.json](config.example.json) and [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

Related: [Dream & Memory](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-memory-dreaming) · [Instruction Files](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-instruction-files).

MIT licensed. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

## Optional plugin diagnostics

The plugin optionally emits privacy-restricted operation and failure metadata to dsh-plugin-diagnostics. Diagnostics contain event type, status, fixed error code and elapsed time; conversation content and credentials are not logged. The diagnostics plugin is optional and does not change the host requirements.

plugins.readme_text:
# ZY-Agents ZY-Agents 是单租户自托管的企业级多智能体平台，采用**管理面与执行面分离**的架构：主服务负责认证、编排与数据，内核宿主负责 Agent 运行时与本地工具执行。 ## 架构概览 ``` ┌───────────────┐ ┌────────────────┐ │ apps/web │ │ apps/admin │ │ Vue3 用户端 │ │ Vue3 管理端 │ └──────┬────────┘ └───────┬────────┘ │ HTTP (REST) │ └─────────┬──────────┘ ▼ ┌─────────────────────┐ │ services/api │ │ FastAPI 业务面 │ │ 认证 / 编排 / 知识库 │ │ 技能 / 配额 / 审计 │ └─────┬─────────┬─────┘ │ │ model gateway tool gateway ← 双网关（HMAC 签名回调） │ │ ▼ ▼ ┌─────────────────────────┐ │ services/kernel-host │ │ Node.js DSH 执行面 │ │ Runtime Profile 内容寻址│ │ 回合循环 / 工具桥 / 审验 │ │ 审批 / 事件日志 │ └───────────┬─────────────┘ │ 本地 Agent 配对 ▼ ┌────────────────┐ │ 本地 Agent │ │ CLI + Chromium │ └────────────────┘ ``` ## 核心特性 - **回合制 Agent 编排** — 管理面下发任务，执行面按回合循环驱动模型与工具，状态可恢复 - **知识库检索** — 全文检索起步，可扩展嵌入与重排 - **技能注入** — 技能以 Runtime Profile 内容寻址方式进入 Agent 上下文 - **审批 broker** — 敏感工具调用经人工审批后执行 - **事件日志全链路** — 每个回合、每次工具调用均可追溯 - **白标 / 品牌化** — 展示层品牌（名称 / logo / 主题色）按部署配置，与契约层隔离 - **本地 Agent 配对** — CLI + 独立 Chromium 的本地执行，适配内网无 API 的存量系统 ## 快速开始 ### 前置依赖 - Python >= 3.11（主服务） - Node.js >= 22（内核宿主与前端构建） - MongoDB 与 Redis（本地开发可用 `make mongo-up` / `make redis-up` 拉起，或使用系统安装的实例） ### 启动步骤 ```bash # 1. 生成 .env 密钥（JWT、双网关签名、签名 URL 等） make bootstrap # 2. 编辑 .env，配置 OpenAI 兼容模型服务： # MODEL_PROVIDER_BASE_URL=... # MODEL_PROVIDER_API_KEY=... # MODEL_PROVIDER_MODEL=... # 3. 初始化数据库（索引 + 种子账号 + 服务端工具目录，幂等可重复执行） make mongo-up make redis-up make init-db # 4. 一键启动全部服务（api / kernel / web + mongo / redis） make dev ``` > 说明：数据库初始化也可以跳过（API 首次启动时会自动完成同样的初始化，全部幂等）；`make init-db` 的价值是**启动前显式完成并可查看初始化结果**（打印种子账号写入数、集合文档数）。本地运行数据（Mongo 数据文件、`data/`、`.localdata/`）不进仓库，git 跟踪列表只含源码与文档。 启动后访问 **http://127.0.0.1:4173**（用户端）。各服务端口：主服务 API `127.0.0.1:8000`、内核宿主 `127.0.0.1:8101`、用户端 `127.0.0.1:4173`。 停止服务：`make down`；查看日志：`make logs`。 ### 种子账号 首次启动且用户集合为空时，自动创建三个演示账号（用户名固定，**密码由环境变量注入、不落代码**）： | 用户名 | 角色 | 密码变量 | |---|---|---| | `admin` | 管理员 | `SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD` | | `ops` | 运维（受限管理） | `SEED_OPS_PASSWORD` | | `member` | 普通成员 | `SEED_MEMBER_PASSWORD` | 首次部署前在 `.env` 中配置这三个密码；生产部署务必修改或删除这些账号。 ### 配置说明 - 全部环境变量模板见 [.env.example](.env.example)，每个变量均带注释说明用途与默认值。 - JWT、双网关签名等密钥由 `deploy/bootstrap/generate-secrets.sh` 自动生成（`make bootstrap` 调用），请勿手工编造、勿入库。 ## 项目结构 ``` ZY-Agents/ ├── services/api/ # FastAPI 主服务（业务面：认证、编排、知识库、技能、双网关） ├── services/kernel-host/ # Node.js 22 DSH 内核宿主（执行面：回合循环、工具桥、审批、事件日志） ├── apps/web/ # Vue3 用户端 ├── apps/admin/ # Vue3 管理端 ├── deploy/ # 部署脚本与密钥生成 ├── docs/ # 设计文档（六份） └── Makefile # 本地开发入口（bootstrap / dev / check 等） ``` ## 文档索引 | 文档 | 内容 | |---|---| | [00-architecture-spec.md](docs/00-architecture-spec.md) | 架构规格：约束与结论、部署形态、服务分层、双网关、升级机制 | | [01-engineering-design.md](docs/01-engineering-design.md) | 工程设计：目录树、分层依赖规则、模块接口、装配与编排 | | [02-data-model-and-api.md](docs/02-data-model-and-api.md) | 数据模型与 API：MongoDB 集合字段、公开 HTTP 路由表 | | [03-kernel-contract.md](docs/03-kernel-contract.md) | 内核契约：双网关端点与签名方案、宿主协议、版本锁 | | [04-localagent-protocol.md](docs/04-localagent-protocol.md) | 本地 Agent 协议：配对流程、帧级字段、连接状态机 | | [05-spec-compliance.md](docs/05-spec-compliance.md) | 合规登记：约束落点与检测手段 | ## 社区讨论 欢迎扫码加入微信群「dsh 企业应用开发技术」，一起交流企业级 Agent 平台架构、DSH 内核与本地工具执行的落地实践：

## License [MIT](LICENSE) © ZY-Agents Contributors

plugins.description: Blazing fast Rust-native linter for Odoo modules
plugins.readme_text:
odoo-lint

Blazing fast Rust-native linter for Odoo modules. The command is called `odl`. It checks Python files, manifests, XML and CSV data files and translation (`.po`) files, with the checks of OCA's pylint-odoo, `oca-checks-odoo-module` and `oca-checks-po`: same names, same messages, same results on their own test suites. It also warns about files that do not belong in a module, such as packages or database dumps committed by accident.

Linting all of OCA/sale-workflow 18.0, as OCA's pre-commit hook runs pylint-odoo. See benchmarks.

- ⚡ **250x faster** than pylint with pylint-odoo, and still 30x faster on a single core - ⚖️ **Drop-in for pylint-odoo and OCA's pre-commit checks**: same codes, names and messages, 95/95 checks matching on their own test suites (Python, manifests, XML, `.po`), and `# pylint: disable=` comments keep working - 🔧 **Automatic fixes**, safe and unsafe as in Ruff, for Python, manifests, XML and `.po` files (`odl check --fix`, `--diff` to preview) - ⬆️ **Upgrade checks**: leftovers of older Odoo versions, such as Bootstrap 4 classes that do nothing since Odoo 15.0, with fixes - 🌍 **Translation checks that predict Odoo's loader**: why Odoo logs "malformed po file", and why a translation does not show up - 📦 **Installable with pip, uv or pipx**: one binary in prebuilt wheels for Linux, macOS and Windows, without Python dependencies - 🛠️ **Configured in `pyproject.toml`**, including company-specific author rules - 📋 **Output for CI**: GitHub annotations, GitLab Code Quality, SARIF and JSON - ✍️ **In your editor**: a language server (`odl server`) with quick fixes, and extensions for VS Code and Zed - 🤖 **For AI coding agents**: an MCP server, and plugins for Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness and OpenCode that lint every file the agent edits - 🪝 **Git hooks**: pre-commit and hk ## Installation ```bash uv tool install odoo-linter # or: pipx install odoo-linter cargo install odoo-lint # from crates.io ``` The PyPI package is called `odoo-linter`, because `odoo-lint` is too similar to an existing PyPI project. On crates.io it is `odoo-lint`. ## Quick start ```bash odl check path/to/addons # lint a directory odl rule # list all rules odl rule C8101 # explain a rule odl check --fix # apply the safe fixes (--diff to preview) ``` Rules ported from pylint-odoo keep its codes, names and messages, and `# pylint: disable=` comments keep working. Company-specific rules are configured in your `pyproject.toml`: ```toml [tool.odoo-lint] target-version = "17.0" [tool.odoo-lint.rules.manifest-required-author.mapping] "acme_*" = "Acme Corp" ``` For AI coding agents there is an MCP server (`odl mcp`) and a post-edit hook, packaged as plugins for Claude Code (`/plugin marketplace add bosd/odoo-lint`), DeepSeek Harness and OpenCode. See the [documentation](https://odoo-lint.readthedocs.io/) for all commands, configuration options and rules. ## Development ```bash uv sync --all-groups # builds odl into .venv via maturin uv run nox # pre-commit, fmt, clippy, cargo tests, CLI tests, docs ``` See the [development guide](https://odoo-lint.readthedocs.io/en/latest/development.html). ## License MIT

plugins.description: DSH 工作流插件（开发中）：把工程纪律转化为运行时控制——拦截、门控、证据与规则资源层，白盒可改｜Developer preview, not released.
plugins.readme_text:
# shisan-xinuo-discipline（开发代号 dsh-plugin-dev）

**基于 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的白盒工作流治理插件**——把依赖模型自觉的工程纪律转化为宿主运行时可执行、可测量、可修改的流程控制。源码单文件引擎（`src/shisan-xinuo-core.ts`）+ 数据层规则包（`content/`），一切行为面可用真实运行证据复查。

> 状态：**v1.0 工程验收版（内部）——未发行**。全部主张按下方状态标签分层，未过对照实验的不宣称有效性。

## 能力矩阵（主张=状态标签制，证据可复查）

| # | 主张 | 状态 | 证据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | L3 危险操作在工具执行管线内被程序性拦截（命中→审批询问，宿主侧不可绕过该检查） | **已实现有测试**（正则覆盖 6 域+9 豁免+嵌套 shell 形态） | 单测 8正10负+23例+58误拦样本；真实宿主拦截实录 |
| 2 | 收口验证依据真实退出码而非模型自述（discipline_gate 工具：宿主真跑 cmd，声明与实测不符=打回） | **已实现有测试**（含 E1 中两次打回无效验证的实录） | tests/gate-tool 44 例；E1-v1 报告 §1 |
| 3 | 规则包可替换：改 `content/rules.json` 即改红线，不动引擎代码；无效配置 fail-closed 回退内置默认 | **已实现有测试**（真实宿主自定义域拦截实证） | tests/config-rules 24 例；CHANGELOG v0.3 |
| 4 | 工具预算器：按任务判级裁剪工具面（restrict 掩码），测量以每请求线缆真值为准 | **已实现有测试**（L1 面 -58.6%；同 agent 会话中途收窄实证） | tests/budget 21 例；CHANGELOG v0.4 |
| 5 | 行为遥测与对账：exec-log 全落账，tally `--report/--check` 出数+对账（白名单/不变量/快照，抓植入差错） | **已实现有测试** | tests/tally 16 例（5 类攻击样本全被抓） |
| 6 | 有效性（改善任务结果） | **未证**——E1-v1 机制验证轮 n=1 区分力不足，按预注册矩阵不判有效/无效 | docs/e1-v1-report §4 |
| 7 | 拦截覆盖完备性 | **已知边界**——枚举型正则有天花板：命令形态替换已闭合一例；「目标替代」（用 write 清空代替删除+对偷换目标做真验证）不可在正则层修，指向 v1.x T3 受控执行器/状态机 | docs/e1-v1-report §3 |
| 8 | T3 受控执行器/教训库/跨平台映射 | **规划**（v1.x） | docs/design-specs/dsh-toolification-roadmap |

**诚实条款**：本插件保证「过程可审计、收口有真值」，不保证「模型更聪明」；三命题分立——机制存在（✓v0.1-v0.5）≠机制有效（待补样本轮）≠产品有效（待发行后数据）。

## 安装（开发形态）

DSH profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 追加：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: shisanxinuo-core
      # Windows 绝对路径须用 file:// URL（ESM loader 判定）
      name: 'file:///D:/path/to/dsh-plugin-dev/src/shisan-xinuo-core.ts'
```

正式 bundle 化（`dsh.bundle` manifest）=发行批工作，未做。

## 配置（契约详见 docs/config-contract.md）

- `content/rules.json`：L3 危险域+只读豁免（fail-closed：无效回退内置默认，防护不静默解除）
- `content/discipline.md`：注入的纪律文本
- `content/budget.json`：判级→工具掩码（fail-open：无效不裁剪；纪律五件工具永不裁）
- 环境钩子：`SHISANUO_RULES` / `SHISANUO_DISCIPLINE` / `SHISANUO_BUDGET` / `SHISANUO_BUDGET_LEVEL`
- 实验臂：`tmp/arm-A-observe.flag`（惰性）/ `tmp/arm-B-text.flag`（纯文本）/ 无旗标=全量 C

## 测试与测量

```bash
for f in tests/*.test.mjs test/*.test.mjs; do node "$f"; done   # 9 套单测（无需构建，Node ≥23 直跑 .ts）
node scripts/tally.mjs --report --freeze   # 出数+冻结快照
node scripts/tally.mjs --check             # 对账（exit 1=发现违规）
node scripts/e1-run.mjs                    # E1 三臂实验（免费模型）
```

## 目录

- `src/shisan-xinuo-core.ts` 引擎（单文件：拦截/收口真值/机判/预算/遥测）
- `content/` 规则包（Config 面）｜ `scripts/` tally/e1 ｜ `tests/` 9 套单测
- `docs/` 契约/实验预注册与报告/路线图/发行规划 ｜ `CHANGELOG.md` 版本记录（内部）

## 版本史（详见 CHANGELOG.md）

v0.1 机制雏形 → v0.2 真值闭环（gate 工具）→ v0.3 可修改性（Config 化）→ v0.4 上下文控制（预算器）→ v0.5 判定制度+E1-v1 → **v1.0 工程验收（内部）**。路线=docs/design-specs/release-and-versioning-plan-20261013.md。

plugins.readme_text:
# ArchiLens — 可溯源 RTL 硬件拓扑图（DSH 插件）

**ArchiLens（包名 `hw-topo-dsh`，核心技能 `hw-topo`）是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的硬件拓扑图插件：扫描 Verilog/SystemVerilog 源码生成模块拓扑图，图中每个节点与连线都强制携带 `file:line` 源码证据，交付前由机器对源码树重新扫描逐项复核，幻觉率非零即拒绝交付。**

[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.3.0-blue.svg)](./package.json)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A518-green.svg)](./package.json)
[![npm 依赖](https://img.shields.io/badge/npm%20运行时依赖-0-brightgreen.svg)](./package.json)

> **上游归属（保留声明）**：本项目基于 [`tt-a1i/archify`](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify) 的官方 DSH 包 `@tt-a1i/archify-dsh@0.1.0`（同源移植 [GongYuanCaiJi/dsh-archify](https://github.com/GongYuanCaiJi/dsh-archify)）改造：保留 DSH 插件打包形态（`cordis.patch.yml` filesystem Skill provider + `prepare` 暂存脚本）与独立 HTML 查看器理念，将五类通用图表引擎替换为**硬件拓扑专用 + 证据优先 + 自检门禁**流水线。完整第三方声明见 [`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](./THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

## 为什么需要它

让 AI 画硬件架构图，最大的敌人是幻觉：模型凭记忆补全，模块名拼错、连线不存在、行号瞎编——而这些错误嵌在一张"看起来很专业"的 SVG 里，肉眼几乎查不出来，等发现图和代码对不上，往往已经进了文档、进了评审。

ArchiLens 的解法是把"生成"变成"转录"：图里的每一个元素都不允许来自记忆，只能来自对源码树的机械扫描；交付之前再用一次**全新的扫描**反向核对每一个证据指针，对不上就拒交。门禁是机器执行的退出码，不是模型的自觉。

## 核心能力

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| RTL 证据扫描 | `scan` 默认走 RTLens 的 `rtlens.evidence/1` 证据后端（词法解析 + 引用追踪，行号位置不变）；RTLens 不可用时显式降级到内置容错正则扫描器，`degraded` 状态进回执、HTML 横幅、wiki 页眉（`hw-topo/lib/rtlens-backend.mjs`、`scan-rtl.mjs`） |
| 机器派生规格 | `derive` 从证据包机械转录拓扑规格（模块 / 例化 / 连线，证据完备度 100%）；`--focus <顶层模块>` 只画子树，`--no-groups` 关闭按目录分组（`hw-topo/lib/spec.mjs`） |
| 反幻觉门禁 | `verify` 对 RTL 树**重新扫描**（不信任旧证据包）逐元素复核，输出 `backed / disclosed / unbacked / broken` 四态判定与 `hallucinationRisk`，非零即 exit 1 拒交（`hw-topo/lib/verify.mjs`） |
| 四件套交付 | `deliver` 产出 `<前缀>.html`（交互查看器：点击元素看证据片段、搜索、深浅主题）+ `<前缀>.svg`（独立矢量图）+ `<前缀>.wiki.md`（代码库索引页，每行带 file:line 链接）+ `<前缀>.receipt.json`（机器可读回执与工件 SHA-256）（`hw-topo/lib/viewer.mjs`、`render-svg.mjs`、`wiki.mjs`） |
| GitHub 直达成图 | `search` + `gh` 免 clone：把分支/标签解析成 commit SHA 后下载 tarball（记录 SHA 与 tarball sha256，带路径穿越防护），SVG 节点框直达 `github.com/<owner>/<repo>/blob/<sha>/<file>#L<line>` 永久链接，解包结果按 SHA 缓存（`hw-topo/lib/github.mjs`） |
| 双引擎交叉核对 | `--cross-check` 让另一个引擎当见证者，只比行号不改图；分歧按五类披露（`coordinate-mismatch` / `dead-ifdef` / `generate-block` / `arrayed-form` / `coverage-only`），`--cross-check-strict` 下坐标冲突即 verify 失败（`hw-topo/lib/cross-check.mjs`） |
| DSH 插件形态 | `npm install` 触发 `prepare` 暂存技能到 `skills/`，`cordis.patch.yml` 注册 filesystem Skill provider，一条 `dsh plugin add` 即装（`scripts/stage-skill.mjs`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`lib/index.js`） |

## 快速开始

环境：Node ≥ 18，无 npm 运行时依赖。

### 安装（DSH 插件）

```bash
# 方式一：Git 仓库（推上去之后；<owner> 换成实际用户/组织名）
dsh plugin add github:<owner>/archify-dsh --profile <profile 名>

# 方式二：npm pack 产物 tgz 直装
npm pack
dsh plugin add ./hw-topo-dsh-<版本>.tgz --profile <profile 名>

# 方式三：本地开发（目录直装）
git clone <本仓库> archify-dsh && cd archify-dsh
npm install                                   # 仅触发 prepare 暂存 skills/，无运行时依赖
dsh plugin add <archify-dsh 路径> --profile <profile 名>
```

装完 30 秒自检（技能 CLI 在 DSH profile 的 node_modules 里）：

```bash
node <profile>/node_modules/hw-topo-dsh/skills/hw-topo/bin/hw-topo.mjs doctor --json
# 期望 {"ok": true ...}
```

### 第一次出图（CLI 直用）

```bash
node hw-topo/bin/hw-topo.mjs demo <输出目录>                        # 端到端演示：扫描→派生→交付
node hw-topo/bin/hw-topo.mjs scan  <RTL根目录> --out topo.bundle.json --json
node hw-topo/bin/hw-topo.mjs derive topo.bundle.json --out topo.topology.json --title "<题>" --project <名> --json
node hw-topo/bin/hw-topo.mjs verify topo.topology.json --json       # 幻觉率门禁，非零即停
node hw-topo/bin/hw-topo.mjs deliver topo.topology.json --json      # HTML + SVG + wiki + 回执
node hw-topo/bin/hw-topo.mjs validate topo.topology.json --json     # 仅校验规格结构
```

常用 scan 选项：`--backend auto|rtlens|builtin`（默认 auto）、`--evidence <rtlens证据.json>`（直接消费已生成的 `rtlens.evidence/1` 文档，跳过二次扫描）、`-D NAME`（可重复，`+define+` 语义）、`-I <目录>`（`` `include`` 搜索路径）。完整参数以 `node hw-topo/bin/hw-topo.mjs`（不带参数）打印的 usage 为准。

在 DSH 会话里则直接让 agent 按名字用技能：

```text
Use the hw-topo skill to map <RTL根目录> 的模块拓扑,生成可溯源的 SVG 与 wiki 索引。
```

### GitHub 仓库直达成图

```bash
node hw-topo/bin/hw-topo.mjs search "riscv cpu" --limit 5 --json    # 按星数返回候选
node hw-topo/bin/hw-topo.mjs gh <owner/repo> --ref <分支|tag|sha> --focus <顶层> --json
```

网络只用于 `search` / `gh` 两个子命令；scan / verify / deliver 完全离线。未认证 GitHub API 限 60 次/小时，设 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 环境变量可提升。无 RTL 的仓库明确报 `no-rtl` 退出，不生成空图。

## 工作方式

```
scan ───▶ 证据包（模块/例化/端口,file:line + sha256;后端身份与降级状态记入 provenance）
derive ──▶ 拓扑规格（机器转录,证据完备度 100%）
curate ──▶ 只做减法/标注（删节点、分组;无法溯源但确需展示的项进 meta.disclosed_unverified,渲染 ⚠ 虚线）
verify ──▶ 对 RTL 树重新扫描逐元素复核 → hallucinationRisk = (unbacked + broken) / elements
deliver ─▶ HTML + SVG + wiki 索引 + 回执（四件套）
```

### verify 判定语义

| 判定 | 含义 | 计入风险分子 |
|---|---|---|
| `backed` | 证据精确命中（file + line + 内容） | 否 |
| `disclosed` | 无源码证据但已显式披露（⚠ 虚线） | 否（页面可见） |
| `unbacked` | 无任何证据 → 潜在幻觉 | **是** |
| `broken` | 指针失效：文件缺失 / 行号越界 / 模块挪位 | **是** |

退出码约定：`0` 成功；`1` verify 未过（严禁描述为成功）；`2` usage / IO 错误（证据 schema 不匹配也走这一档）。

### 证据后端与行号契约

| 后端 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| `auto`（默认） | 找得到可用 RTLens（≥ 6.2.0）就用它；找不到回退内置扫描器，记 `degraded: true` + 人话原因 |
| `rtlens` | 永不降级：不可用即 exit 2 并点名是哪个 root / 解释器 / 版本不合格 |
| `builtin` | 一律内置容错正则扫描器，如实标注为降级 |

- **行号契约**：RTLens 原生 0-based + 绝对路径，hw-topo 对外 1-based + 根相对 POSIX；换算只发生在适配器（`hw-topo/lib/evidence-adapter.mjs`）一处，每个坐标带 `line0` / `line1` 双基准，`line1 === line0 + 1` 不成立即抛错。这条契约有一个永久回归锚点：把未经适配的原始坐标喂进门禁，必须 13 个元素全部判 `broken`、风险 1.0、exit 1（`hw-topo/test/off-by-one-regression.test.mjs`）。
- **同后端铁律**：`verify` / `deliver` 复用 bundle `provenance` 记录的后端与参数，不会出现"扫一次、验一次、两套行号"；显式换后端会在回执打 `backendOverride` 标记。
- **降级三处可见**：回执 `provenance`、HTML 顶部横幅、wiki 页眉——缺一即静默降级。`rtlens.evidence/1` 字段表见 `docs/evidence-contract.md`。
- 参数透传不静默：`-D` / `-I` / `--max-files` 等改变证据内容的选项原样转交 RTLens 并记入 `provenance.backendOptions`；取值不合法直接 exit 2，绝不悄悄退回默认值。

### 核心模块（`hw-topo/lib/`）

| 模块 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `scan-rtl.mjs` | 内置容错正则扫描器（兜底后端） |
| `rtlens-backend.mjs` | RTLens 后端发现 / 探活 / 调用与显式降级 |
| `evidence-adapter.mjs` | `rtlens.evidence/1` → hw-topo bundle 的纯转录（唯一坐标换算点） |
| `spec.mjs` | bundle → 拓扑规格（derive） |
| `verify.mjs` | 逐元素复核门禁与风险指标 |
| `cross-check.mjs` | 双引擎交叉核对与五类分歧分类 |
| `layout.mjs` / `render-svg.mjs` | 排版与独立 SVG 渲染 |
| `viewer.mjs` / `wiki.mjs` | 交互 HTML 查看器与 wiki 代码库索引页生成 |
| `github.mjs` | 仓库搜索、钉 SHA tarball 下载与源码永久链接 |

## 测试

```bash
npm test
```

两个套件共 110 个测试（技能套件 106 + 仓库套件 4）：扫描器提取（注释/字符串/宏陷阱）、坐标契约与 off-by-one 回归锚点、证据适配器与后端降级、双引擎差分（五类分歧 + strict 门禁）、JSON BOM 容忍、路径 containment / 注入防护（`hw-topo/test/security.test.mjs`）、插件打包与 demo 端到端。其中"跨引擎真机等价性门禁"（`hw-topo/test/cross-engine-parity.test.mjs`）需要真实 RTL 语料与 RTLens 环境，缺样本时按原因自跳过，不误报失败；语料位置用环境变量 `HW_TOPO_OSS_REPOS` 指定。

## 目录导航

| 路径 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `hw-topo/` | 核心技能源码：`SKILL.md`（技能定义与反幻觉工作流）、`bin/hw-topo.mjs`（CLI 入口）、`lib/`（上表 12 个模块）、`schemas/topology.schema.json`（规格结构）、`examples/fixture/rtl/`（3 文件演示语料） |
| `hw-topo/test/` | 测试套件与夹具（`rtlens-evidence.fixture.json` 证据样本、`rtlens-pkg/` 假 rtlens 包用于后端测试） |
| `lib/index.js` | 插件入口：从 DSH profile 解析技能根目录 |
| `scripts/stage-skill.mjs` | `prepare` 脚本：把 `hw-topo/` 暂存为 `skills/hw-topo/` 供打包分发 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | DSH bundle patch：注册 filesystem Skill provider |
| `docs/` | `evidence-contract.md`（`rtlens.evidence/1` 字段表离线镜像，规范版本在 RTLens 仓库）、`trigger-routing.md`（rtlens / hw-topo / archify 三方触发权分层） |
| `SHARE.md` / `交付清单.md` | 面向同事的安装分发说明与交付清单 |
| `skills/`、`*.tgz`、`.tmp*/` | 构建产物（prepare 暂存 / npm pack 输出 / 临时目录，均已 gitignore） |

## 与相关项目的关系

一个 DSH profile 里通常同时装着三套"会讲结构"的技能，触发权分层见 `docs/trigger-routing.md`：

| 请求 | 交给谁 |
|---|---|
| 谁例化了谁 / 端口对不对 / 信号谁驱动 / 改动影响面 | **RTLens**（peer 依赖 `rtlens-dsh ≥ 6.2.0`，可选；唯一证据引擎 / 事实层，不出图） |
| RTL 拓扑图交付物（HTML / SVG / wiki / 回执） | **本插件**（事实默认来自 RTLens，图与门禁是自己的） |
| 非 RTL 通用架构图 / 时序图 / 状态机 / 数据流 / Mermaid | **archify**（上游项目，本插件 description 显式排除，不接） |

冲突裁决：事实冲突（行号 / 端口 / 例化说法不一致）以 RTLens 证据为准；图冲突（分组 / 排版 / 交付形态）以本插件交付物为准，但不得改动事实字段。若 DSH profile 另连了 RTLens MCP，可用 `get_hierarchy` / `get_module_info` / `trace_signal` 取信号级连接转录进 spec——每条仍需 file:line 证据过门禁，RTLens 数据不替代 verify 门禁。

## 许可

[MIT](./LICENSE)。版权链：© 2026 tt-a1i (Archify)、© 2025 Cocoon AI（原始 architecture-diagram-generator）、© 2026 GongYuanCaiJi（dsh 移植）；本插件的改造延续同一许可。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-notify-ar

**إشعارات ويندوز بأزرار فعلية لـ DeepSeek Harness — عربي أولاً.**

الوكيل يخلّص شغلو وانت بعيد عن الشاشة؟ بدل ما ترجع تفتح التطبيق، اضغط الزر من الإشعار والوكيل بيكمّل حالو.
ولما الوكيل يطلب **إذن**، بتوافق أو بترفض من الإشعار — وهو شغّال.

[English](README.en.md) · [المواصفة الكاملة](https://github.com/qusaykhadour/dsh-notify-ar/blob/main/SPEC.md)

---

## المشكلة اللي بيحلّها

إضافة `dsh-notify` الموجودة بتوصلك إشعار **صيني ثابت** (مكتوب بالكود)، والضغط عليه **ما بيعمل شي** —
لأنها مبنية بـ`activationType="background"` (تعليق المطوّر نفسه بالكود).

يعني: بتوصلك «خلص الشغل»، وبعدها بتضل ترجع للتطبيق مشان تكمّل، أو مشان توافق على إذن.

## شو بيعمل `dsh-notify-ar`

| الإشعار | الزر | النتيجة |
|---|---|---|
| 🥇 **طلب إذن** | **موافق** | الصلاحية اتعطت — بلا ما تفتح التطبيق |
| خلص الشغل | **تابع** | الوكيل بيكمّل من حيث وقف |
| شغل شغّال | **وقّف** | الجولة بتوقف (والطابور بينحفظ) |
| أي حالة | **افتح التطبيق** | يرجّع نافذة DSH للمقدمة |

- **عربي + إنجليزي** مع RTL مضبوط · **اللغة الافتراضية = لغة التطبيق**
- **هوية خاصة فيه** (`Qusay.DshNotifyAr`) — ما بيشارك مخزن إشعارات PowerShell
- **أمان**: كل إشعار بيحمل **nonce** بستخدم مرة وحدة ⇒ ضغطة قديمة أو مزوّرة **مرفوضة**

## التثبيت

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-notify-ar
node "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-notify-ar\scripts\setup.mjs"
```

بعدها **أعد تشغيل DSH**.

`setup.mjs` بيعمل تلات شغلات:
1. بيترجم `click-gateway.exe` بـ`csc.exe` المحلي (موجود بويندوز افتراضياً — **ما في تحميل**)
2. بيسجّل الهوية (AUMID) عبر Start Menu shortcut + خاصية `System.AppUserModel.ID`
3. بيسجّل مخطّط `dshnar://` ويوجّهه للـexe

> ⚠️ **ليش لازم exe؟** فحصنا أثبت إنو ويندوز **ما بيشغّل** `powershell.exe` ولا `cmd.exe` كهدف تنشيط —
> الأزرار بتظهر بس ما بتعمل شي. لازم ملف تنفيذي حقيقي.

## الإعدادات

مثبتة بالـprofile بـ`cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: dsh-plugin-notify-ar
  name: dsh-notify-ar
  config:
    locale: auto          # auto | ar | en
    enabled: true
    rootsOnly: true       # الجلسات تبعك بس، مو الوكلاء الفرعيين
    notifyApproval: true  # زر الأذونات
    cooldownMs: 10000     # أقل فترة بين إشعارين لنفس الجلسة
    aumid: Qusay.DshNotifyAr
```

## الحدود (بصراحة)

- **الأزرار بتشتغل بس إذا التطبيق شغّال** (ولو مصغّر) — الوكيل عايش جوّا العملية. إذا مسكّر: الزر بيفتحه.
- **زر فعّال واحد لكل إشعار** — ويندوز بيمحي الإشعار بعد أول ضغطة. لهيك إشعار واحد لكل قرار.
- **ما في موافقة إلا بطلب صريح**: الوكيل لازم يطلب `sandbox_permissions` + `justification` مع بعض.
  رفض عادي بينرفض مباشرة من الـsandbox (ما بيسأل).
- **التثبيت بدو صلاحية أوسع** — كتابة الريجستري ممنوعة جوّا sandbox DSH.

## الأمان

جسر الضغطات ملف JSONL، فأي عملية على الجهاز بتقدر تكتب فيه. لهيك:

- كل إشعار بيحمل **nonce عشوائي 128-bit** بستخدم **مرة وحدة**
- nonce مزوّر / مستعمل / منتهي ⇒ **مرفوض** (مجرّب: replay مرفوض)
- الإجراءات المسموحة whitelist: `approve` · `reject` · `continue` · `stop` · `open`
- مجلد البيانات مقفول قدر الإمكان (بيحتاج `SeSecurityPrivilege` — بيمرق بهدوء إذا مو متوفر، والـnonce هو الحماية الحقيقية)

## التطوير

```powershell
cd Projects\notify-ar\plugin
node scripts\test-toast.mjs          # بناء XML + العربي
node scripts\test-pipeline.mjs       # الضغطة كاملة + الأمان (9 اختبارات)
node scripts\test-approval.mjs       # منطق الموافقة (26 اختبار)
node scripts\test-approval-wire.mjs  # مسار الموافقة كامل
node scripts\smoke.mjs --action continue   # إشعار حقيقي + انتظار الضغطة
```

## الترخيص

**MIT** — © 2026 Qusay Ali Khadour.

مبني على أفكار من [`dsh-notify`](https://github.com/Pasumao/dsh-plugin-notify) © 2026 Pasumao (MIT) —
مع الشكر. الفرق: `dsh-notify-ar` أزراره **بتعمل**، ونصوصه **مو صينية**.

# dsh-jenkins-plugin

[![check](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/Endless-zby/dsh-jenkins-plugin/ci.yml?branch=main&label=check)](https://github.com/Endless-zby/dsh-jenkins-plugin/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

Jenkins integration for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): **a live build-progress panel in the Web GUI's right sidebar**, plus a set of model-facing Jenkins tools.

Once installed you stop switching to the Jenkins page to watch a build: the jobs you follow become cards in the sidebar with a live progress bar, a notice when a build finishes, and — when a build fails — one button that hands the failure to the model for a diagnosis.

![The Jenkins panel: a running build's card with live stage progress, an unstable build, and failed builds offering rebuild and hand-to-AI](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Endless-zby/dsh-jenkins-plugin@main/doc/panel-favorites-2.png)

## Install

Installing from npm is recommended — the package ships prebuilt code and needs no build permission:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-jenkins-plugin
```

Restart `dsh web`, open **Settings → Jenkins**, add an instance (URL, account, password/API token) and save; the **Jenkins** panel then appears in the right sidebar.

![The Jenkins entry on the Web sidebar's start page](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Endless-zby/dsh-jenkins-plugin@main/doc/settings-instances-1.png)

Other sources:

```sh
# tarball (offline or internal distribution)
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-jenkins-plugin-0.1.0.tgz

# git sources: the profile must allow the prepare script to build (pnpm ≥10 blocks it by default)
dsh plugin --profile web add github:<owner>/dsh-jenkins-plugin
```

A git install fetches **sources, not built artifacts**, so the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` has to allow its prepare script:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  dsh-jenkins-plugin: true
```

That is permission for this package's code to run on your machine at install time, outside any sandbox the agent runs in — only allow sources you trust, and pin a commit (`github:<owner>/dsh-jenkins-plugin#<sha>`). Use npm or a tarball to avoid the step entirely.

## What you get

**The panel** (the **Jenkins** tab in the right sidebar) has two modules:

- **Following** — one card per followed job: state dot, build number, outcome tag, **live progress bar**, the running stage's name, the change description of the current build, and the Maven project version when the controller reports one. Cards are fed by an SSE stream, not by a polling page.
- **All jobs** — collapsed by default; ☆/★ at the end of each row follows or unfollows it.

![The two modules: following cards and the expanded job list with per-row follow buttons](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Endless-zby/dsh-jenkins-plugin@main/doc/panel-favorites-1.png)

Clicking a job or a card drills down without ever leaving the panel: build history (paged) → build detail (stage bar, embedded console log, test summary, change set, artifacts). Downloading an artifact is the only action that opens a Jenkins page.

![A job's build history, with the parameter box and trigger control](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Endless-zby/dsh-jenkins-plugin@main/doc/panel-drilldown-1.png)

![One build: parameters, stage feedback, console log, test summary and change set](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Endless-zby/dsh-jenkins-plugin@main/doc/panel-drilldown-2.png)

**Writes** happen in the panel as *button → inline confirmation → run → result in place*:

| Action | Notes |
|---|---|
| Trigger a build | parameterized jobs get a `KEY=VALUE` box |
| Rebuild | offered only for failed builds; **reuses the failed build's parameters** |
| Abort | `allowCancel` is off by default; enable it to use the button |
| Hand to AI | offered only for failed builds; sends the failed log tail, stages and change set to the current session's model, and the answer appears in the conversation |

Jobs on `denyJobs` are refused whatever the switches say, and **not a single request reaches Jenkins**.

**Tools the model can call on its own:**

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `jenkins_jobs` | list jobs and their status, optionally with recent build history |
| `jenkins_build_status` | one build's result, duration, Pipeline stages, change set, test summary |
| `jenkins_log` | console log, tail by default, continue from `next_offset` |
| `jenkins_workspace` | a build's workspace directory or artifact list (workspace reads need the Jenkins Workspace API plugin) |
| `jenkins_build` | trigger or cancel a build — the only write tool; `denyJobs`/`allow.*` first, then operator approval |

**Multiple instances**: the settings page holds several Jenkins controllers and probes each one with "test connection" before saving (if any row fails, the whole save is rejected with zero writes). The panel footer switches instances and marks the current one in green. The instance list and the followed jobs live in `$DSH_HOME/jenkins.json`.

**Completion notices**: a followed job's finished build is announced once through the platform's own background-job mechanism; the same build is never announced twice.

**Failure wake** (`notifyWakeOnFailure`, off by default): when a *followed* job fails, the conversation it was followed from gets the failure handed to it — the same log tail, stage and commits the button sends — so the model can explain it without anyone watching the build list. The favorite remembers which session followed it, so the answer lands where the person is. Only a real failure wakes anyone (`unstable` and `aborted` do not), each build wakes at most once, and a session that has closed is skipped silently. `allowAnalyze: false` turns it off too, since it sends the same log.

## Permissions and risks

Please take these as read before installing:

- **Network**: requests go only to the Jenkins addresses you configure. Nothing else is contacted.
- **Credentials**: Basic auth; the password/API token is stored and resolved through **DSH's own credentials service** (`tokenRef` names a credential reference). The plugin's own `jenkins.json` holds only URLs, accounts and credential names — **no passwords** — and credentials never appear in tool output, the panel, or logs.
- **Writes**: it can trigger and cancel builds. `allowTrigger` defaults to on, `allowCancel` to off, and `denyJobs` hard-blocks specific jobs (including whole folders). Model-side calls additionally require approval; a panel click uses inline confirmation plus the same policy check.
- **Build logs enter the model's context**: "hand to AI" and the model's own `jenkins_log` calls send **console log content to the model as part of the prompt**. Jenkins logs are **untrusted input** — they can contain arbitrary text, including instructions aimed at the model — so treat them that way. Only the last 16 KiB of a failed build's log is sent by default (`analyzeLogBytes`).
- **Local state**: `$DSH_HOME/jenkins.json` (instance list plus followed jobs) and DSH credentials (passwords).
- The plugin never triggers a build by itself: only your click or an explicit model call does.

## Compatibility

- **Harness**: built and verified against `0.1.6-alpha.2` (both `engines.dsh` and the peer dependencies pin that version).
- **Node**: matches the harness, `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.
- **Surface**: the panel is a Web GUI surface (`dsh web`), verified on the Web composition.
- **Jenkins**: verified against a real **Jenkins 2.176.2** (FreeStyle and Maven jobs, an instance with 777 jobs). Several honest degradations:
  - **Pipeline stages** need Blue Ocean's `wfapi` endpoints; on a controller without Pipeline jobs the stage list is empty and the card falls back to an elapsed-time estimate — that is "the controller reported no stages", not a broken panel.
  - **Workspace reads** need the Jenkins Workspace API plugin; without it `jenkins_workspace` says so instead of pretending.
  - **Maven versions** come from `mavenArtifacts/api/json`, which only Maven jobs answer — and on a real 2.176.2 it is usually produced when the build *ends*, so a running Maven build's card may have no version. When there is none, nothing is shown; a version is never guessed.
