plugins.description: Live CPU, memory and GPU readout in the DeepSeek Harness composer status bar.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-dock-vitals

Live **CPU / memory / GPU** readout in the DeepSeek Harness composer status bar — a small clickable badge next to the built-in context meter.

```
2 turns 30 steps · 98 tok/s │ 1.8M tok · cache 84% │ 6%
CPU 13%  MEM 87%  GPU 15%
                ↑ this plugin's badge, right of the context meter
```

- **Display-only plugin.** It registers no tools for the model. Samples never enter the conversation context and are never sent anywhere.
- Three metrics out of the box — **CPU / memory / GPU**; video memory and GPU temperature are one toggle away in settings.
- GPU works across vendors, no admin rights: `nvidia-smi`, `rocm-smi`, macOS `ioreg`, and Windows PDH counters as the catch-all. Whichever backend answers is named in the snapshot, and a backend that cannot report a field leaves it blank instead of printing `0`.
- Click the badge for a details panel: per-metric values, GPU model, core count and capacity.
- Three refresh presets: **fast 1.5 s / medium 3 s / slow 10 s** (default `3000 ms`).
- Opening ten sessions still samples once — every badge shares one snapshot and one timer.
- Sampling stops on its own 15 seconds after the last reader.
- Follows the host language (Chinese / English), including the details panel and tooltips.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-dock-vitals
```

Or drop the tarball in:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-dock-vitals-0.1.0.tgz
```

Restart DSH afterwards.

## Data sources

| Metric | Source | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CPU | Node `os.cpus()` sampled twice | Machine-wide busy percentage (`1 - Δidle/Δtotal`), not per-core. The first sample has no baseline and reads empty. |
| Memory | `os.totalmem()` / `os.freemem()` | |
| GPU | A vendor CLI, probed per platform (see below) | When nothing answers, GPU shows `—` while CPU and memory keep working. |

GPU backends, tried in this order on each platform — the first that answers wins, and the winner is remembered so later ticks skip the dead ones:

| Platform | Backend | Command | Permission | Video memory / temperature |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Windows / Linux, NVIDIA | `nvidia-smi` | `--query-gpu=... --format=csv,noheader,nounits` | none | both |
| Windows, any vendor | PDH counters via `typeperf` | `"\GPU Engine(*)\Utilization Percentage" -sc 2 -si 1` | none | **neither** |
| Linux, AMD | `rocm-smi` | `-u --showmemuse --showmeminfo vram -t --showtemp --showproductname --csv` | none | both |
| macOS, any GPU | `ioreg` (IOKit registry) | `-r -d 1 -w 0 -c IOAccelerator` | **none** | used only (no total) |

`typeperf` is the only way to read a GPU on Windows for AMD/Intel — ROCm is Linux-only — so it is worth knowing its cost: **one round takes ~2.7 s**, where `nvidia-smi` takes ~50 ms. That is why GPU sampling is decoupled from the badge refresh rate: CPU and memory keep their own cadence, and the GPU value is served from the last completed reading.

Aggregation follows Task Manager: sum each process per engine type, then take the **busiest engine type** per adapter, then the busiest adapter. Summing every instance together over-reports, and reading only the 3D engine misses video encode/decode load entirely.

A field the active backend cannot report is `null` in the snapshot, never `0` — a missing temperature and a 0 °C temperature are different things. The details panel hides those rows rather than printing a made-up number.

The host side exposes one read-only endpoint:

```
GET /dsh-dock-vitals/snapshot
```

```json
{
  "cpu": { "percent": 13.2, "cores": 24 },
  "memory": { "usedPercent": 87.3, "usedGiB": 13.7, "totalGiB": 15.7 },
  "gpu": {
    "available": true,
    "name": "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU",
    "utilPercent": 15,
    "memoryUsedMiB": 1816,
    "memoryTotalMiB": 8188,
    "temperatureC": 64,
    "clockMegahertz": 2370
  },
  "gpuError": null,
  "gpuBackend": "nvidia-smi",
  "host": { "platform": "win32", "release": "10.0.26300" },
  "intervalMs": 3000,
  "updatedAt": 0
}
```

`gpuBackend` names the backend that produced the reading, so "why is my GPU blank / missing a temperature" is answerable from the payload itself. Non-loopback callers get `403`; anything but `GET`/`HEAD` gets `405`.

## Settings

Settings → **System Status**:

| Option | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Enable badge | on | Off means the badge never renders and never fetches |
| CPU | on | |
| Memory | on | |
| GPU | on | |
| Video memory | off | Unavailable while GPU is off |
| GPU temperature | off | Same |
| Refresh interval | 3000 ms | 1500 – 60000 ms |

Every field is `volatile`, so changes apply immediately without a restart. Configuration lives in the settings namespace `dock-vitals` — the `id` of the plugin's entry in your profile.

## Compatibility

- dsh `>=0.2.0-rc.1` (developed and verified on `0.2.0-rc.2`).
- Node `>=22`.
- Windows / macOS / Linux. CPU and memory come from Node's `os`; the GPU backends are read-only CLIs and registry reads (`nvidia-smi`, `typeperf`, `rocm-smi`, `ioreg`). Nothing needs administrator rights — this deliberately avoids `powermetrics`, which is macOS's richest GPU source but requires `sudo` on every call.
- Works in both the desktop app and the browser GUI: `dsh.client.platform` is `web`, and the desktop app is a shell around the same web frontend.

## Development notes

- Client components may only `require` modules from the host whitelist (`react`, `react/jsx-runtime`, `react-dom`, `react-dom/client`, `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-dockkit`). Anything else fails to resolve, and a throwing `require` kills the factory → the entry fails → the desktop build refuses to open. **Wrap every `require` in `try/catch` and ship a fallback.**
- Never call a hook inside `apply()`. `useSyncExternalStore`'s `getSnapshot` must return a **stable reference** — an object rebuilt on every call causes an infinite re-render loop.
- Styles use `--dsw-*` theme tokens only; literal colours are reserved for graphics.
- UI is contributed through `ctx.slots.inject(ownerKey, () => ctx.slots.register(...))`.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Add folder references to the DeepSeek Harness web composer: host folder dialog, /folder command, and folder drag/paste resolved into @path mentions.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-folder-attach

[![test](https://github.com/sixzjd/dsh-folder-attach/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/sixzjd/dsh-folder-attach/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

DSH 网页版拖入文件夹会被拒绝：「只有桌面端支持添加文件夹，浏览器里请添加单个文件」。
这个插件让它在**纯浏览器**里可用 —— 拖文件夹、`/folder`、主机文件夹选择框，都插入标准 `@路径` 引用。

> [English](README.en.md) · 需要 dsh `>= 0.2.0-rc.2`

## 背景

DSH 的输入框对"拖入/粘贴文件夹"有一条硬性限制：

```js
const bridge = globalThis.__DSH_HOST_PATHS__;
if (bridge === void 0 && directory) return t("attachment.directoryDesktopOnly");
// → "只有桌面端支持添加文件夹，浏览器里请添加单个文件"
```

浏览器出于安全**不会**给出拖入文件夹的绝对路径，只有桌面端（Electron shell 注入 `__DSH_HOST_PATHS__`）能把 `File` 映射回真实路径。而 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 目前**没有发布桌面端**：`dsh web` 只有 `--host/--port/--no-open/--trusted-host`，全量搜索也没有任何包写入该全局。

本插件不去绕过这个限制，而是**换一个问题来源**：不问浏览器要路径，问宿主机要。

## 原理

Web 界面分两半：浏览器里的 client，和你机器上的 Node host。浏览器是沙箱化的，**host 不是**。

DSH 已经自带一个宿主目录选择能力（`dsh-host-directory-picker-auto`）。在 macOS + 回环绑定时它解析成 `native` 后端，在**宿主机**上执行：

```
osascript -e 'choose folder' -e 'POSIX path of selectedFolder'
```

返回一个真实的绝对路径。插件把它接到输入框上——桌面端那条判定根本不会被触发。

拖入的文件夹则用 `fileReferences/list`（`@` 补全菜单背后的同一个索引）按名称解析：一次调用，宿主自己的模糊索引，已排除 `node_modules` 等。

## 功能

| 入口 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 输入框左侧「添加文件夹」 | 在宿主机弹出系统文件夹对话框，选中后插入 `@目录/` |
| `/folder` 命令 | 同上 |
| 拖入 / 粘贴文件夹 | 按名称在工作区内解析，插入 `@目录/`；同批普通文件走原有上传通道 |

插入的是**标准 `@路径` mention**，与桌面端拖文件夹产生的等价：工作区内用相对形式，工作区外保留绝对形式，含空格自动加引号。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-folder-attach
```

也可以从 GitHub 装（同一份源码，可钉到某个 tag）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:sixzjd/dsh-folder-attach
```

也可以在侧边栏 **插件 → 添加插件** 里填上面的地址。装完刷新浏览器页面。

<details>
<summary>从源码安装</summary>

```bash
git clone https://github.com/sixzjd/dsh-folder-attach.git
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web        # 或你的 profile 目录
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-folder-attach
```

</details>

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-folder-attach
```

或在插件页关闭开关。插件只在浏览器内注册一个 composer 槽位、一个斜杠命令和两个事件监听器，不写任何全局对象，卸载即无痕。

## 开发

```bash
npm test          # 两个回归测试
npm run check     # 语法检查 + 测试
```

无需构建：`dsh-client-modules` 把 `lib/client.js` **逐字节原样**作为浏览器 bundle 服务，所以它按 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 格式手写。

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | 空的宿主侧 `apply`，让包成为 Loader 条目、从而被扫描到 |
| `lib/client.js` | 全部行为 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 该 bundle 启用时贡献的组合层 |
| `locale/{en,zh}.json` | 插件页显示名（**`en.json` 必须存在**，否则 `zh.json` 不会被读取） |

## 依赖的公开接缝

只用官方声明过的扩展点，不改写官方代码、不打 monkeypatch：

- `ctx.slots.inject("conversation.input.left", …)` — 官方文档点名的 composer 扩展位
- 该座位的标准 props：`sessionId`、`inputActions`、`t`
- `ctx.commandUi.register({ name: "folder", ui: { kind: "action" } })`
- `ctx.remote.directoryPicker.pick()` — 宿主系统对话框，返回绝对路径
- `ctx.remote.fileReferences.list(sessionId, query)` — `@` 菜单背后的索引查询

## 已知限制

- **拖入/粘贴**的文件夹只能按名称在工作区内解析。浏览器不给路径，这无法回避；解析不到时明确报错并提示改用对话框，不会猜一个路径。
- 拖入产生的是 `@目录/` **纯文本 mention**，不是桌面端那种带图标的文件夹 chip——chip 需要真实路径。功能等价，外观不同。
- 索引查询有返回上限，极端情况下同名文件夹可能不在候选里，此时按未解析处理。
- 若 profile 把目录选择解析成 `browse` 后端（远程 / SSH 访问），系统对话框不可用，`pick` 会拒绝并提示；此时仍可用拖拽解析。
- 混合拖拽（文件夹 + 图片）时，插件会复刻 composer 的图片数量/体积预检，**但只统计本次拖入的图片**：已挂载的附件没有任何公开接口可读。宿主侧 `validateImageBatch` 仍按整条消息强制校验，所以这不是漏洞，只是提示可能来得更早、口径更宽。
- 插件页显示名依赖 `locale/en.json` 存在。

## 为什么它能活过 dsh 升级

兼容性闸门只校验 `peerDependencies` 里 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` 前缀的版本，本插件不声明它，因此升级不会让 bundle 被跳过。真正的风险是上面那些接缝改名——那时表现是**静默不显示**，不会拖垮 DSH。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: Wire protocol for DSH Remote Control: sealed-record encryption (XSalsa20-Poly1305), key derivation, pairing URI, relay control frames, payload catalog. Pure functions, zero I/O. DSH 远控的线协议层：密封记录加密、KDF、配对 URI、控制帧与载荷目录，纯函数零 I/O。
plugins.readme_text:
# @dsh-remote/protocol

DSH Remote Control 的**线协议层**：密封记录（XSalsa20-Poly1305）、方向密钥派生（KDF）、
配对 URI、中继控制帧、`cmd.*` / `ev.*` 载荷目录、错误码可重试表、防休眠命令构造器。

**纯函数、零 I/O**：不认识时钟、不认识平台、不发定时器——所以每条冻结契约都能脱离环境
逐字节被测（含 golden vectors 对拍：与小程序里那份保留实现的 SHA-256 锚定）。

## 安装

```sh
npm install @dsh-remote/protocol
```

## 结构

| 子路径       | 内容                                                      |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `…/keys`     | PSK 生成、两把方向密钥的 HKDF 风格派生、计数器 nonce      |
| `…/record`   | `seal()` / `open()`——基于 tweetnacl 的密封记录            |
| `…/frames`   | 中继控制帧的 zod schema + 解析器（帧名冻结，v1）          |
| `…/limits`   | 三端共享的数值预算（帧上限 / 附件上限 / 去重窗口）        |
| `…/registry` | 帧名 / 载荷名 / 能力 id 的注册表（编译期与 zod 联合一致） |
| `…/payloads` | `cmd.*` / `ev.*` 载荷目录的 zod schema                    |
| `…/pairing`  | `dshr:/p?...` 配对 URI 编解码、6 位码工具                 |
| `…/sleep`    | 防休眠命令构造器（`caffeinate` / `systemd-inhibit`）      |

完整清单见 `package.json` 的 `exports`；根入口会把全部子路径再导出一次。

## 开发

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test        # tsc 构建 + node --test
pnpm typecheck
```

## 红线

- **协议中立**：不引入任何传输层（WS / SSE / HTTP）与平台概念——游标、ack 这类
  会话层语义可以进协议，但「因为是 WS 所以……」不可以。
- 帧名与载荷名**冻结**：改动既有形状就是**破坏性变更**，必须同时升 `PROTOCOL_VERSION`
  并让三端一起升（`hello.protocol` 必填且必须与本端相等，不相等的一端在握手上就被拒）。
  ⚠️ 这里原来写的是"增量只许走**能力位**，不许改既有形状"——那条机制（
  `hello.capabilities` / `ev.host_info.caps` 与三端的降级分支）**已整条删除**
  （2026-10-11 用户裁决：没有真实用户，只留单版本制）。所以现在没有"偷偷加、对端不支持就退回"
  这条路：要么同版本，要么明说。
- 本包**不许出现** `node:fs` / `node:os` / `process.*`（I/O 全部在消费方）。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: System-prompt surface drift gate for DeepSeek Harness — sections any plugin contributes are hashed and baselined; silent rewrites fail loud
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-prompt-drift

System-prompt surface drift gate for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh).

Any plugin or preset can contribute sections to the assembled system prompt.
Upgrading one can silently rewrite what the model is **told**; a malicious
one can inject "ignore all safety rules" straight into the prompt. This
plugin hooks the `system-prompt/assemble` waterfall, hashes every section
(name → sha256(text)), baselines the surface, and diffs every later
assembly against it. **dsh-mcp-test guards what the model can call; this
guards what the model is told.** Zero LLM calls in the trust path.

## Why now (checked 2026-10-12)

Empty lane. The nearest neighbour (`dsh-modelprint`, 0★) fingerprints model
config, not the prompt surface. Prompt-injection plugins scan *content
flowing in*; nobody watches the assembled prompt itself — the one channel
every plugin can write to without anyone reviewing a diff.

## How it works

```
system-prompt/assemble ──> sections [{name, sha256(text)}] name-sorted
                     ──> baseline absent? freeze it (commit the file)
                     ──> diff: added / removed / changed sections
                     ──> warn once per distinct drift (signature dedup)
```

Dynamic sections (cwd, timestamps) can be excluded via `ignoreSections`.
Baseline file is stable, name-sorted JSON — commit it; it is the contract.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile default add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-prompt-drift
```

Prebuilt `lib/` ships in the repo — git installs need no build step and no
`allowBuilds` authorization.

## Configure

```yaml
- id: dsh-prompt-drift
  name: dsh-prompt-drift
  config:
    baselinePath: .dsh-prompt-drift/baseline.json
    rebaselineOnDrift: false
    ignoreSections: []
```

## Develop

```sh
npm install && npm test
```

## Kill criteria

If dsh ships first-party prompt-surface pinning, this freezes at its last
working version with a postmortem here.

plugins.description: DSH 提示词工作台：优化、多轮迭代、多模型对比测试 | Prompt Studio plugin for DeepSeek Harness — optimize, iterate, compare prompts
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-prompt-studio 提示词工作台

DSH 插件。在左栏提供一个「提示词」面板，用来优化提示词、多轮迭代、多模型对比测试、保存模板与查看历史。

对标 Prompt Optimizer 的核心能力，但只做提示词，不含图像工作区、提示词花园、MCP、多消息工作区、变量与函数测试。

## 它做什么

- **优化**：给一段原始提示词，选一个已配置的模型，拿回一个改写后的提示词。
- **迭代**：在上一版基础上按方向调整（"更简洁"、"补上输出格式约束"……），形成版本链，可回退到任意一版。
- **测试对比**：单模型测试、2–4 个模型并排对比、裁判模型分析「原始 vs 优化后」的得失。
- **模板与历史**：内置模板（结构化扩写 / 精简压缩 / 加输出格式约束 / 角色设定补全），可另存；历史按时间倒序，可筛选、删除、重新载入。
- **工具**：agent 可直接调用 `prompt_optimize`。

## 它不做什么

- 不管理 API Key，不直连任何第三方服务。所有模型调用都走宿主已有的 `llm` 服务（`ctx.get('llm')`），用的是你在 DSH 里已经配好的 provider / model。
- 不引入构建步骤。宿主侧是原生 ESM，浏览器侧是手写的 bundle。
- 除了 `@deepseek-ai/*` 与 Node 内置模块，没有任何依赖。

## 安装

本插件是一个 DSH **profile bundle**，不能靠 `npm install -g` 生效——它必须被装进某个 DSH profile 才会注册面板、工具与路由。

发布到 npm 后，最简单的方式是让 DSH 自己按包名安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-prompt-studio
```

或者从源码构建出 `.tgz` 再装：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/CECILIALOVE0616/dsh-prompt-studio.git
cd dsh-prompt-studio
npm pack            # 产出 dsh-prompt-studio-<version>.tgz
```

无需 `npm install`：本插件没有运行时依赖（`dependencies` 为空），peer 依赖全部由 DSH 宿主提供。

然后用 DSH 自己的安装入口把这个 tgz 装进目标 profile。两种方式二选一：

- **桌面应用**：用宿主提供的插件安装接口装上该 `.tgz`（本机实测走的是这条路）。
- **CLI**：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-prompt-studio-<version>.tgz`。

装完重载 DSH，左栏会出现「提示词」入口。

两点注意：

- `add` 只接受包名或 `.tgz` 路径，不接受目录。
- **`desktop` profile 由 Electron 桌面应用独占管理**，CLI 对它执行 `add` 会直接报
  `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`。桌面场景请走应用的安装接口。
- 宿主侧代码（`lib/*.js` 里除 `client.js` 外的部分）只在 DSH 启动时加载，装完必须重载；
  浏览器侧 `client.js` 每次页面加载都会从磁盘重新取，刷新即可生效。

## 设置

在 DSH 设置页的插件分区里可以改：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultMode` | `user` | 打开面板时的默认模式（用户提示词 / 系统提示词） |
| `defaultProvider` / `defaultModel` | 空 | 默认模型；留空则用会话当前路由 |
| `maxTokens` | `4096` | 单次调用的输出上限 |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | 单次调用超时（上限 30 分钟） |
| `compareMax` | `4` | 对比模式最多勾选几个模型 |
| `maxPromptChars` | `20000` | 单条提示词长度上限 |
| `historyLimit` | `200` | 历史列表一次取多少条 |
| `toolEnabled` | `true` | 是否注册 `prompt_optimize` 工具 |

除 `toolEnabled` 外都支持热更新：改完立刻生效，不用重启。**`toolEnabled` 需要重启 DSH**——它决定工具在启动时注不注册，这类开关不享受热更新。

也可以走环境变量：`DSH_PROMPT_STUDIO_MODE` / `_PROVIDER` / `_MODEL` / `_MAX_TOKENS` / `_TIMEOUT_MS` / `_COMPARE_MAX` / `_TOOL`。优先级是「插件设置 > 环境变量 > 内置默认」。

## 数据放在哪

每个工作区各自一个 SQLite 库：`<工作区>/.dsh-prompt-studio/prompt-studio.db`。三张表：

- `prompts`：提示词版本（含 `parent_id` 版本链）
- `runs`：每次模型调用（优化 / 迭代 / 测试 / 分析 / 对比）
- `templates`：模板（内置 + 自建）

用的是 Node 内置的 `node:sqlite`，不需要额外装数据库。库是按工作区隔离的，换个项目就是另一套历史。

## 工具：`prompt_optimize`

```
prompt_optimize(prompt, mode?, direction?, provider?, model?)
  → { optimized, provider, model, elapsedMs }
```

- `prompt`：必填，原始提示词。
- `mode`：`system` 或 `user`，默认 `user`。
- `direction`：给了就按迭代模式走（在上一版基础上按方向调整），不给就是通用优化。
- `provider` / `model`：不传则用会话当前路由。传了非法值会直接报错，不会静默回退到别的模型。

调用过程中可以用 `exec.signal` 中断。

## 结构

```
lib/
  index.js    入口：Config、注册工具、挂路由、热更新钩子
  schema.js   schemastery 软导入（解构 {Schema} 会静默拿到 undefined）
  config.js   配置解析（设置 > 环境变量 > 默认），含 volatile cell 解包
  llm.js      对宿主 llm 服务的封装（streamText / listRoutes / assertRoute）
  prompts.js  提示词工程：优化 / 迭代 / 分析的系统提示词，以及容错解析
  store.js    node:sqlite 存储层
  routes.js   浏览器侧 HTTP API（/dsh-prompt-studio/*）
  tools.js    prompt_optimize 工具定义
  client.js   浏览器 bundle（手写，无构建步骤）
```

## 排查

| 症状 | 原因 |
| --- | --- |
| 插件完全没出现 | `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert` 没并入 profile，或者没重载 DSH |
| 左栏有入口但面板打不开 | 客户端 id 与左栏项的 `id`、主区的 `key` 不一致；或 `exports.inject` 少了 `slots` |
| 设置页没有本插件的分区 | `Config` 没导出，或 schemastery 软导入拿到的不是 builder |
| `tool "prompt_optimize" is already registered` | agent preset 里重复声明了这个工具 |
| LLM 调用报 503 / undefined | `ctx.get('llm')` 是空的 |

## 许可

MIT © CECILIALOVE0616

plugins.description: Agent mode picker for DSH: choose an external Agent CLI as the session's default executor, with automatic discovery of installed CLIs.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-picker

**Agent 模式选择器** —— 在 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web 界面的输入框右侧加一个控件，
像选推理档位那样选定一个**外部 Agent CLI**作为当前会话的默认执行体。

它把"有哪些外部 Agent、各自怎么启动"做成**数据**（`agents.json`），
所以加一个新 Agent **只需加一条数据，不必改代码**。

---

## 它解决什么问题

DSH 本身能调用外部 CLI，但"调哪一个"通常要写死在配置里。这个插件把选择权交回给你：
输入框右边一个下拉，选谁，这一轮就交给谁。名册驱动的设计意味着
**同一个插件能挂任意多个 Agent**，包括你自己写的。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-agent-picker
```

装完重启 DSH。插件第一次启动会把自带的 `agents.json` 复制一份到
`$DSH_HOME/agent-picker.agents.json`（默认 `~/.dsh/`），**之后你改的是这一份**，
插件升级不会覆盖它。

## 名册：怎么加一个新 Agent

编辑 `$DSH_HOME/agent-picker.agents.json`，往 `agents` 数组里加一条：

| 字段 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `id` | 唯一标识 |
| `name` | 显示名 |
| `tool` | DSH 里对应的工具名 |
| `bin` | 包装器文件名（用于"是否已安装"的探测） |
| `available` | 初始可用性建议；**真实可用性由插件探测包装器是否存在** |
| `kind` | `task`=任务型（结果可概括）／`chat`=对话型（原样转述） |
| `expertise` | 菜单里显示的「擅长」一行 |
| `note` | 健康状态／接线说明 |
| `desc` | 展开后的详细能力介绍 |
| `launch` | **可选**。自带执行配方：`bin` / `argv` / `env` / `timeoutMs` / `graceMs` / `maxBytes`。写了它，本插件就自己注册 `cli_<id>_direct` 工具 |

改完**重启 DSH** 生效。

### `launch.argv` 的路径规则（重要）

名册是**跨机器**的，所以**不要写死绝对路径**。`argv` 里写**裸文件名**即可，
插件会在运行时按下面顺序解析：

```
codex-dsh.ps1            ->  <cliBinDir>/codex-dsh.ps1
{cliDir}/codex-dsh.ps1   ->  <cliBinDir>/codex-dsh.ps1
C:\some\where\x.ps1      ->  原样保留（你想钉死绝对路径时用）
```

`cliBinDir` 的取值：环境变量 **`DSH_AGENT_PICKER_CLI_DIR`** 优先，
否则默认 `~/dsh-clis/bin`（与 `dsh-sub-cli` 的约定一致）。

### 占位符

`argv` 里可用的占位符：`{task}`（任务正文）、`{permission}`、`{model}`、`{image}`。

**`{image}` 只对命令行真的支持图片参数的 CLI 有意义**（例如 Codex 的 `-i/--image`）。
其余 CLI 就算它自己有读图能力，也**不是**靠这个占位符——那种情况请把图片路径写进任务正文，
让那个 Agent 用自己的读文件工具去读。

## 你需要自备什么

这个插件**只负责调度，不附带任何 Agent**。要用哪个，请自行安装并确认它在命令行可用：

Claude Code · Codex · Qwen Code · Gemini CLI · Aider · Goose · Hermes · OpenClaw · Ollama …

插件按 `cliBinDir` 下的包装器探测可用性；**探测不到的成员不会出现在可选区**。

> 封装脚本的写法与各 CLI 的接入细节，取决于你接哪个模型端点、有哪些凭据。
> 这部分**不在本插件范围内**，请按你自己的环境准备。

## 参数约定

所有 Agent 工具的正文参数统一叫 **`prompt`**（配一个 3–5 词的 `description` 作标题；
`task` 是兼容别名）。新加 Agent 请沿用，别另起名字。

## 兼容性

`dsh.compatibility` 声明为 `>=0.1.5`。
本插件**不依赖** `settings.register()` / `installSection()` 这类会随宿主版本变动的设置 API ——
它只用 `ctx.tools.register` / `ctx.tools.guard` / `ctx.subprocess` / `ctx.webServer.register`。

> 背景：DSH 0.1.7 移除了旧的 settings 注册入口，凡是用到它的插件会在启动时抛
> `TypeError: ... is not a function`。本插件从设计上避开了这条路径。

## 安全声明（请务必读）

**这个插件的本质是：按你的配置，在本机启动外部程序并执行任务。**

它不是沙箱，也不是审核者。请清楚以下几点：

### 1. 它具备"在本机执行程序"的能力

被选为默认执行体后，插件会启动对应的 CLI 进程，并**继承你的用户权限**（能读写你能读写的文件）。
所以"把任务交给哪个 Agent"这件事，等同于"允许哪个程序在你这台机器上干活"。

### 2. 三条可能的滥用面

| 面 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **名册文件** | `$DSH_HOME/agent-picker.agents.json` 里 `launch.bin` / `launch.argv` 写什么，插件就执行什么。**拿到该文件写权限的人，等于拿到本机执行权。** |
| **约定目录** | `$DSH_HOME/agent-picker.d/*.agent.json` 是**任何程序都能丢文件进来**的落地目录。它带来的正是"装了就自动出现"的便利，也是它的风险面。 |
| **自动探测** | 插件会在 `PATH`、`cliBinDir`、`~/.local/bin` 里找已知名字的命令（`codex` / `claude` / `aider` …）。**同目录下放一个同名恶意程序，就会被选中。** |

### 3. 插件做了什么缓解

- 启动子进程时**剥离敏感环境变量**：名字里含 `KEY` / `TOKEN` / `SECRET` / `PASSWORD` 一类的一律不传，
  且**所有 `DSH_*` 一律不传**（避免把会话身份交给外部进程）。
- 每个 Agent 都有**超时上限**（默认 15 分钟，可按成员覆盖）与**输出上限**（默认 200,000 字节），
  防止一个挂住的子进程拖垮会话。
- 缺环境变量或需要常驻服务的 Agent，会标为"待配置"而**不是**静默执行。

### 4. 你的责任

- 用之前**看一眼** `agent-picker.agents.json` 和 `agent-picker.d/` 里到底有什么
- **只安装你信任的 Agent CLI**。插件不审核、不签名、也不沙箱化它们
- 不要把名册文件或约定目录**共享给不可信的人或程序**
- 若你在多用户机器上使用，注意 `$DSH_HOME` 的目录权限

> 一句话：**你交给它多少个 Agent，就等于打开了多少条本机执行通道。** 请按这个前提使用。

## 许可

MIT —— 见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

Copyright (c) 2026 dsh-agent-picker contributors

你可以自由使用、修改、再分发（保留版权声明即可）。本插件**不附带任何 Agent**，
调度的是你自己安装的第三方 CLI，那些工具各自的许可与费用由你自行遵守。

## 开发

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Ok541151/cwk.git
cd cwk
```

离线自检脚本依赖宿主自带的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`。若在仓库外单独跑断言，
需要在 `node_modules/@deepseek-ai/` 下指向宿主那份（**这个目录不要提交**）。

plugins.description: Cited for DeepSeek Harness: search your documents and answer with citations. Install by pasting this repository in Plugins.
plugins.readme_text:
Ask your Cited documents from DeepSeek Harness and get the source with every answer.

[![License: Apache-2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-171717)](LICENSE) [![dsh-tools peer range](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--tools-0.1%20%2F%200.2-171717)](#compatibility) [![CI](https://github.com/RonnieGex/dsh-cited/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/RonnieGex/dsh-cited/actions/workflows/ci.yml) ![Status: early development](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-early%20development-DDF469?labelColor=171717) [English](README.md) · [Español](README.es.md) · [中文](README.zh.md) - Keep your documents in Cited while you work in your agent. - Check answers against numbered source passages. - Choose document search or a full cited answer. **Cited inside DeepSeek Harness.** Two native tools let your agent search a [Cited](https://github.com/RonnieGex/cited) installation and answer from its documents with numbered citations. The plugin connects to your configured installation over `POST /api/mcp`. **Early development.** Installation and a real cited answer have been exercised headlessly. See the dated [compatibility table](#compatibility) for verification limits. [How it works](#how-it-works) · [Real answer](#a-real-answer) · [Install](#install) · [Configure](#configure) · [Tools](#the-two-tools) · [Token](#your-token) · [Compatibility](#compatibility) · [Development](#development) · [License](#license) ## How it works 1. Run `dsh plugin add github:RonnieGex/dsh-cited`. 2. Open the plugin configuration and set **url** and **token**. 3. Ask your agent. It calls `cited_search` or `cited_ask` and answers with `[1]`. Cited hosts documents and retrieval. DeepSeek Harness hosts the agent and this plugin. No MCP client row in `cordis.yml` is needed for these native tools. ## Requirements - DeepSeek Harness within the [declared peer range](#compatibility). - A running Cited server with MCP enabled and its token. - Node `>=22.19`; development and evidence use Node 24. ## A real answer > Yes. Every repair carries a **90-day guarantee on the work**, and parts carry the guarantee of their maker [1]. **3 of 3 English questions received a supported guarantee citation** from an English document. The earlier batch behind the Spanish example scored **2 of 3**: its two Spanish questions succeeded, while its English question missed the Spanish price passage. Keyword search without embeddings can miss a Spanish passage when asked in English. Recorded on 2026-10-09 with the plugin installed from GitHub main in temporary headless state. The image shows the selected `cited_ask` exchange and the complete English answer, with its own source highlighted inside TOOL RESULT. Terminal Markdown stays raw. The [English transcript](docs/evidence/headless-answer-en.txt), [English outcomes](docs/evidence/natural-summary-en.json), [Spanish-example outcomes](docs/evidence/natural-summary.json) and [verification details](docs/evidence/compatibility.md) preserve the evidence and limits. ## Install Run the verified installation command: ```sh dsh plugin add github:RonnieGex/dsh-cited ``` In the desktop app, use **Plugins → Add plugin** and paste `https://github.com/RonnieGex/dsh-cited` (not click-tested; see Compatibility). The repository ships `lib/`: installation needs no compilation or `allowBuilds` permission. ## Configure Open the plugin configuration: | Field | Value | |---|---| | `url` | Your Cited address, such as `https://cited.example.com`. The plugin appends `/api/mcp`, or preserves it when already present. Query strings and fragments are dropped. | | `token` | The server's `CITED_MCP_TOKEN`. Marked as a secret field. | | `timeoutMs` | Positive call timeout in milliseconds; **30000** by default. | Without a server token, Cited’s MCP endpoint is off. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`, set it as `CITED_MCP_TOKEN` on the Cited server (see the [MCP guide](https://github.com/RonnieGex/cited/blob/main/docs/mcp.md)), and enter the same value in the plugin. Keep it out of prompts, screenshots and Git. `url` and `token` start empty so you can install before configuring. A call reports the missing field as a tool error without breaking the harness. After filling both, ask your agent to search a phrase present in your documents. ## The two tools | Tool | Input | Result | |---|---|---| | `cited_search` | `query: string`, `limit?: integer` from **1 to 8**, default **5** | `{ passages: [{ n, document, heading, position, excerpt }] }` | | `cited_ask` | `question: string`, `sessionId?: string` | `{ status, answer, citations }`; status is `answered` or `refused` | **Search, then let your agent answer.** `cited_search` retrieves passages without calling Cited's answer model. Each has its source and citation number. No matches means no passages, not an invented answer. The calling agent's model and any configured embedding provider can still incur charges. **Let Cited write the answer.** `cited_ask` invokes Cited's answering pipeline and returns a cited answer or an explicit refusal. Citations have the passage fields above plus `lead`, the overlap length. The text result includes each source's document, section, position and exact excerpt. Reuse `sessionId` to persist a conversation and its thread on Cited. This can consume that server's model budget. ## Your token - Sent as `Authorization: Bearer` to the configured endpoint; not added to tool arguments or normal output. - Marked secret in the configuration schema for the harness's field handling. This does not establish encryption at rest. Protect the configuration; use HTTPS for remote servers. - Redacted from transport failures, together with URL credentials. Rejected authorization, disabled endpoint, timeout and unreachable host become short tool errors. - The plugin owns no document database. Cited stores documents and conversations created through `cited_ask` with a `sessionId`. ## Troubleshooting | Error | Fix | |---|---| | Missing `url` or `token` | Fill in the named field in the plugin configuration. | | `404` from Cited | Check `url`, set `CITED_MCP_TOKEN` on that server and restart it. | | `401` from Cited | Make `token` match the server’s `CITED_MCP_TOKEN`. | | Timeout | Check the host and network, then raise `timeoutMs` if needed. | ## Compatibility Declared `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` peer range: ```text >=0.1.6-alpha.2 <0.3.0-0 || >=0.2.0-rc.0 <0.3.0-0 ``` A range is not proof of every version. MCP clients below connect directly to **Cited**, without this native plugin. | Client | Date | Evidence and limit | |---|---|---| | DeepSeek Harness 0.1.6-alpha.2 | 2026-10-09 | GitHub main plugin installation and three supported English guarantee answers in isolated headless state. [Record](docs/evidence/headless-answer-en.json); [gate](evidence/gate.txt). | | DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2, bundled CLI | 2026-10-09 | Installed and answered in a local run on 2026-10-09; raw log not kept in this repository. [Provenance](docs/evidence/compatibility.md). | | Claude Code → Cited MCP | 2026-10-09 | Prior verification: connected and listed both tools. No model tool call claimed. [Provenance](docs/evidence/compatibility.md). | | Codex → Cited MCP | 2026-10-09 | Prior verification

plugins.description: A judgment kernel for coding agents: routine judgments go to a small Jev judge, and every verdict is recorded in a ledger.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-jev-judge

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

A judgment kernel for coding agents. The small, frequent calls an agent makes —
does this tool output matter, did anything actually verify that claim, does this
page carry instructions aimed at the model, did the user really ask for this
command — go to a small judge instead of the main model. The agent keeps its
context and its tokens for the work that needs reasoning.

> **Read the scope before installing.** This layer treats a *context budget*, not
> code quality or execution speed: it takes no part in compiling, caching or
> optimising, and changes only what the model sees. Measured over 55 days of real
> sessions on the machine it was written on — context windows of 262k–1M, zero
> pressure-triggered compactions, zero injection hits, and 0.4/day of the one
> decision point that maps onto an outcome — **it was uninstalled there**. See
> [R10 of `docs/verification.md`](docs/verification.md). It earns its place when
> the host's context really is scarce, or when the output is mostly *scanned*
> rather than worked on: shell logs, introspection dumps, browser snapshots.

It runs in **DeepSeek Harness** as a plugin bundle, in **Claude Code**, **Codex**
and **OpenCode** through command hooks or MCP, and anywhere else that can start
an MCP server or run a command.

## Why a kernel

An agent loop makes dozens of small judgments per run. Handing every one to the
main model is slow and expensive; encoding every one as a fixed rule breaks on
real input. This package is the layer in between: one bounded question over a
small state, answered by a small judge, consumed by code that owns the
thresholds, the fallbacks and the final action.

The design follows [`mu`](https://github.com/qybaihe/mu), which loads a judgment
kernel into the `pi` coding agent. What this project adds is reach: the kernel is
host-free, so the same decision points run in agents that `mu` does not cover.
[`docs/mu-analysis.md`](docs/mu-analysis.md) is the study, including the wording
discipline and the measurements behind it.

## Install

### DeepSeek Harness

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-jev-judge
dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config   # shows the layer
```

Or install it from **Settings → Plugins** in the Web GUI, by registry name, git
address or local path.

### Everything else

- **Claude Code / Codex** — command hooks in `settings.json` / `hooks.json`.
- **OpenCode, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Cline** — the MCP server.

```sh
claude mcp add jev-judge -- npx -y dsh-jev-judge mcp
```

[`docs/agents.md`](docs/agents.md) has the exact configuration for each host and
what a verdict is able to do in each.

## What it decides

| Decision point | The question | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `judge.items` | One yes/no question asked of many items — hundreds of log lines, files or findings, without reading them all | on when called |
| `tool.admission` | Which chunks of a long tool result are needed for this task, so the rest never enters the context | `active` |
| `tool.injection` | Which passages of fetched content read as instructions aimed at the model rather than material for a reader | `active` |
| `turn.completion` | Does this "it's done" claim have anything that verified it | `active` |
| `turn.continue` | Did the turn stop in front of a step it announced, or ask for a go-ahead it already had | `active` |
| `memory.capture` | Is this message a correction worth keeping, or just the next task | `active` |
| `tool.risk` | For a command the rules already flagged: did the user actually ask for this | `shadow` |

Every point carries a deterministic fallback equal to the behaviour without this
package, and every verdict is written to a ledger — which is how a point earns
`active` from real sessions instead of from optimism.

`tool.risk` starts in `shadow` on purpose: its verdict can only loosen policy, so
it has to earn that from your own ledger before it is allowed to.

## Configure

The provider is a private record you own, in the format published by the
[`typesafe-ai-jev-skill`](https://github.com/HunterXing/typesafe-ai-jev-skill)
Agent Skill:

```text
$JEV_SKILL_CONFIG  →  ~/.config/typesafe-ai-jev-skill.json
```

```json
{
  "providerName": "your-provider",
  "baseUrl": "https://api.your-provider.example",
  "model": "jev",
  "apiKeyEnv": "JEV_API_KEY",
  "protocol": "systemone",
  "endpointPath": "v1/systemone",
  "authHeader": "Authorization",
  "authScheme": "Bearer",
  "timeoutSeconds": 30
}
```

```sh
jev-judge verify    # offline; reports the contract, never the key
jev-judge doctor    # what will happen: judges, modes, ledger
```

Kernel settings, all optional, live in `~/.config/jev-judge/kernel.json`:

```json
{
  "modes": { "default": "shadow", "tool.admission": "active" },
  "routes": { "turn.continue": ["jev"] },
  "tiers": ["jev"],
  "ledger": { "path": "~/.config/jev-judge/ledger.ndjson", "recordState": false },
  "options": { "judge.items": { "maxItems": 20 } },
  "timeoutMs": 8000
}
```

`jev-judge ledger` reads the ledger; `--json` prints the records as stored.

### Admission only thins what is *scanned*

`tool.admission` acts by default only on output whose size nobody chose: a log, a
dump, a listing, a page. The default list:

```json
["bash", "cordis_inspect_*", "mcp__*", "web_fetch", "webfetch", "web_search", "websearch", "fetch"]
```

`read`, `grep`, `glob`, `skill`, `write`, `edit` — the tools whose *shape* the
agent asked for — pass through whole. Thinning one of those saves tokens and
buys a re-read that may come back thinned differently. Names match without case
(`bash` and Claude Code's `Bash` are the same tool), and a trailing `*` matches a
prefix.

```json
{ "options": { "admission": { "toolNames": ["bash", "mcp__*"], "minChars": 4000 } } }
```

In DeepSeek Harness this goes in the plugin row's `config.options`, i.e. the
profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.

## Design rules

- **A verdict never decides that the agent should ask the user something.** It
  changes what the model sees, or whether it keeps working.
- **No verdict means the behaviour you would have had without this package.**
- **Small state, bounded question.** The judge reads summaries and metadata, not
  bulk text; a `choice` question always carries an escape answer.
- **One predicate per question.** Compound questions are split and combined in
  the policy — measured, not assumed ([`docs/verification.md`](docs/verification.md)).
- **Shadow first.** A point whose verdict can only loosen policy starts there.
- **Fail open.** A judge that is slow, unreachable or unsure yields the fallback,
  never a stalled agent loop.
- **The key never leaves your private record** — not into a log, a ledger record,
  an error message, or a chat.

## Measured

From [`docs/verification.md`](docs/verification.md), on a real 81-line test log
with two failures, judged by the live provider 20 items per call:

- 81 lines → 5 selected, **191 of 3047 bytes (6.3%)** need reading, 7.9 s;
- the same log with the question aimed at fixing rather than triage selected the
  assertion message and the error text instead of the summary line.

## Development

No runtime dependencies and no build step, on purpose: the package loads straight
from a checkout, so `dsh plugin add <path>` needs no build-script approval.

```sh
node --test              # 217 tests, no network
node src/cli.js --help
```

Releases are cut by pushing a version tag: `.github/workflows/release.yml`
publishes to npm through trusted publishing (no token in the repository) after
the same suite passes. See [`docs/market.md`](docs/market.md).

## License

[MIT](LICENSE). TypeSafe, System One and Jev belong to their respective rights
holders; this project is not affiliated with them. The judgment-kernel design is
adapted from [`mu`](https://github.com/qybaihe/mu) (MIT) — see
[ATTRIBUTION.md](ATTRIBUTION.md).

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：侧边栏实时余额 + 每轮对话花费（人民币，含 token 明细）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-deepseek-usage

一个 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件，做两件事：

1. **侧边栏余额**：在左下角「设置」旁边实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额（默认每 60 秒刷新；点击可展开充值余额 / 赠送余额并手动刷新；侧栏收窄成图标栏时显示为彩色状态点）。
2. **每轮对话花费**：在每一轮对话底部的信息栏里额外显示**这一轮花了多少钱**，点击可展开三列明细（项目 / tokens / 单价）。

> 只适用于**官方 DeepSeek（`deepseek-official`）** 且在**带 Web 界面的 profile**（`desktop` 或 `web`）里使用。用其他 provider 时余额读不到、也不该按 DeepSeek 价目计价。

## 关于安装入口（曾踩过的坑）

部分第三方桌面客户端内置的「插件市场」有一条硬性边界：**只接受 `包名@精确版本` 这种 npm 目标**，`github:` 源、`file:` 路径、裸包名一律拒绝。遇到这种客户端时，市场的报错大致是：

> 这个桌面客户端只能安装已发布到 npm 的插件，而该插件仅提供 GitHub 源，因此装不了——这是客户端的安装边界，不是插件或市场的问题。可以改用普通 dsh web 安装，或请插件作者发布 npm 包。

**本插件现已发布到 npm**（`@blackthunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage`），因此这条边界不再是问题：用「方式一」或「方式二」都能装。如果市场仍报上面的错，说明你用的市场缓存了旧目录，或你点的是插件的 GitHub 条目而不是 npm 条目。

## 环境要求

| 项目 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| 操作系统 | Windows / macOS / Linux 均可（本插件不含平台相关代码，未使用任何平台专有 API） |
| dsh | 带 Web 界面的 profile（官方桌面版或 `dsh web`）；headless / SDK profile 没有 webserver，插件不会生效 |
| Node.js | ≥ 22.19（宿主读取余额用 `fetch` 与 `AbortSignal.timeout`） |
| DeepSeek 凭据 | 官方 provider 的 API Key，存在 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 的 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`，或同名环境变量 |
| 依赖 | **零运行时依赖**：host 半不 import 任何包，client 半只向 dsh 的模块表要 `react` |

## 安装

包名是 **`@blackthunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage`**（带 scope，因为 npm 上 `dsh-deepseek-usage` 已被无关项目占用）。

### 方式一：命令行从 npm 安装（推荐）

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop add @blackthunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage
```

**装完重启 dsh。**

### 方式二：从图形插件市场安装

市场只会把 `包名@精确版本` 交给客户端，所以本插件**发布到 npm 之后**可以从市场一键安装——在市场的搜索框里找 `dsh-deepseek-usage`，或直接粘贴上面的完整包名。

> 如果你在市场里看到过「只能安装已发布到 npm 的插件，而该插件仅提供 GitHub 源」这样的提示，说明你用的是**本插件还没有 npm 版本时**的市场状态，或者你点的是插件的 GitHub 条目。请改用方式一，或先确认版本。

### 方式三：从 GitHub 源码安装（无需 npm）

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:BlackThunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage
```

pnpm 默认会拦截 Git 依赖的构建脚本。本插件**没有任何编译步骤**，但仍带一个 `prepare` 安装钩子（`tools/prepare.mjs`）用于完整性检查；若安装时被拦下，按提示在该 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里加上：

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  '@blackthunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage': true
```

> ⚠️ `allowBuilds` 表示**允许该包的安装脚本在你的机器上执行**。本插件的钩子只做一件事：检查四个关键文件存在且非空，缺任何一个就拒绝安装——它不编译、不下载、不访问网络。**授权前请先读一遍 `tools/prepare.mjs`。** 想更稳妥可锁定 commit：`github:BlackThunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage#<sha>`。

### 方式四：从 Releases 下载 tarball（无需 Git、无需 npm、无需授权脚本）

每个版本都会在 [Releases](https://github.com/BlackThunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage/releases) 附上 `blackthunder2191026-dsh-deepseek-usage-<版本>.tgz`：

```sh
# 下载后在下载目录执行
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./blackthunder2191026-dsh-deepseek-usage-1.0.0.tgz
```

### ⚠️ 从旧版本（不带 scope 的 `dsh-deepseek-usage`）升级

包名换了，dsh 会把它当成**两个不同的插件**，同时装会让界面出现两套余额栏。升级前先移除旧包：

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-deepseek-usage
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop add @blackthunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage
# 然后重启 dsh
```

### 所有方式都要做的一步

**重启 dsh。** 包 manifest、`exports`、profile 的 bundle 列表都不参与热重载；只改 `lib/client.js` 时刷新页面即可，改了 `lib/index.js`（host 半）就必须重启。

## 验证安装是否成功

```sh
# 1) 装之前：包结构自检，不需要 dsh 在运行
npm run verify

# 2) 装好后：profile 里应出现该 bundle，且路由可访问
curl "http://127.0.0.1:<你的端口>/deepseek-usage/summary?debug=1"
```

第 2 步应返回 `{"ok":true,...,"balance":{...}}`，带 `debug=1` 时还会给出折叠诊断（是否找到会话、读了多少事件、算出多少轮）。`debug.diagnostics.reason` 是 `ok` 就说明这条链是通的。

**`npm run verify` 包含三个彼此独立的检查**，都不依赖你的 profile，也不发起网络请求：

| 脚本 | 检查什么 |
|---|---|
| `tools/verify-client.mjs` | 浏览器半能加载、两个 slot 注册成功、展开明细按真实 payload 渲染（含表头、单价、空值占位） |
| `tools/verify-render.mjs` | 用桩路由 + 每实例一套 hook 状态的桩 React，断言两个座位在真实数据下渲染正确（金额、tokens、未计价轮次文案、`TurnLocation` 形状兼容） |
| `tools/verify-composition.mjs --source` | 复刻 dsh 的解析链：manifest 的 `dsh.client` / `exports["./client"]` / 产物里的模块 id / bundle patch 的行 id 三者一致 |

维护者另外还有一条 `npm run selfcheck`：发布前扫描所有文件，检查是否混入本机绝对路径、用户名、疑似密钥，以及 `repository`/`homepage`/`bugs`/`author` 等发布元数据是否齐全。

## 排错

| 现象 | 原因与处理 |
|---|---|
| 图形市场里点安装失败，提示「只能安装已发布到 npm 的插件」 | 该客户端只接受 `包名@精确版本`。用「安装」方式一（npm）或方式四（tarball）；若仍报错，是市场缓存了旧目录 |
| 界面上出现两套余额栏 | 旧的 `dsh-deepseek-usage` 与新的 `@blackthunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage` 同时装着。见「从旧版本升级」一节 |
| 侧边栏没有余额行 | 该 profile 没有 webserver 或不是 Web 界面；或 host 半未激活。先看 `?debug=1` 有没有响应 |
| 余额显示不可用 | 没有 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`，或你用的不是官方 DeepSeek provider |
| 每轮只显示「本轮进行中，结束后计价」 | 该轮尚未结束（正常）；若显示「本轮未计价（宿主已算到第 N 轮）」则是异常，请反馈那一整行 |
| 启动时报 `declares no dsh.bundle` | 包没装全，或安装链接损坏；重新安装 |
| 安装时报 ENOENT 指向某 tgz | 你删掉了 profile 正在引用的 tarball；重新 `pnpm pack` 并按原路径放回，或重新安装 |
| 改了代码不生效 | host 半需重启 dsh；client 半需刷新页面（强刷 Ctrl+F5） |

## 维护者注：发布与续版

包名是 scope 形式（`@blackthunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage`），scope 不会与任何人冲突——npm 上无 scope 的 `dsh-deepseek-usage` 是无关项目，不能用那个名字。

```sh
npm login                     # 首次需浏览器认证
npm publish                   # publishConfig.access=public 已配置，scoped 包也会公开发布
```

**发布前必看**：`package.json` 的 `name`、`cordis.patch.yml` 里行的 `name`、`lib/client.js` 中 `__ModuleLoader__.load({ id })` 这三处必须是**同一个字符串**。任何一处不一致，要么插件根本不挂载，要么浏览器侧静默不加载（表现为侧边栏和对话底部都没有东西，且不报错）。`npm run selfcheck` 与 `npm run verify:package` 都会检查这一点。

续版流程：改 `version` → `npm run verify && npm run selfcheck` → `npm publish` → 打 tag 推 GitHub → 重新 `pnpm pack` 并把新 tgz 传到 Release。

## 计费口径

- 数据来自**会话日志里 provider 真实上报的 usage**（`assistant/message.usage`），不是界面上的估算值。
- 每轮按以下公式计价（价格单位：元 / 百万 tokens）：

  ```
  花费(CNY) = 未命中输入 × miss价
            + (缓存命中输入 + 缓存写入) × hit价
            + 输出 × output价
  ```

  价目表来自**官方中文定价页**（<https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/>），单位就是**元 / 百万 tokens**，与余额同币种。缓存写入按未命中价计。

  > 早期版本用的是**英文页的美元表**，再乘一个 `usdToCny`（我当时填 7.1）换成人民币。那是错的：中文页并不是英文页的固定换算——`0.02/0.003 = 6.6667`（Flash）而 `0.15/0.022 = 6.8182`（Pro），是**各自独立定价**。用 7.1 去折美元表，得到的数字官方两边都对不上（实测偏高约 6%）。现在直接采用中文页的元价，**插件里不再有任何汇率**。
- 高峰/低谷自动判断：高峰为**北京时间周一至周五 09:00–12:00 与 14:00–18:00**（即 01:00–04:00 与 06:00–10:00 UTC），其余时段（含周末）为低谷，费率为高峰的一半。中国法定节假日无法自动识别，那几天会按高峰计（偏高）。
- 花费与余额同为人民币，可直接相减；**没有任何汇率换算**。
- **只有已经结束的轮次才计价**（日志里 `turn/end` 已落盘）。进行中的这一轮显示「花费统计中…」，结束后自动出现金额。
- API Key 只在 Host 侧经 `ctx.credentials` 读取（`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 的 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`，或同名环境变量），**不会下发到浏览器**；浏览器只请求同源的 `/deepseek-usage/summary`。

## 关于本机 profile 的两点提醒

> **必须重启 dsh 进程**：包 manifest、`exports`、profile bundle 列表都不参与热重载；只有同一路径下 `lib/client.js` 内容变化（配 `tsdown --watch` 之类 watcher）才走 client HMR。
>
> **tarball 方式安装后别删那个 tgz**：profile 的 `package.json` 会用 `file:` 指向它，删了它 pnpm 下次安装会报 ENOENT。

## 改配置

行 id 是 `deepseek-usage`。改配置走 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` —— **整段替换，不是深合并**，要重述全部需要的键：

```yaml
- id: deepseek-usage
  name: dsh-deepseek-usage
  config:
    apiKeyEnv: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY   # 凭据引用名，同时作为环境变量名
    baseURL: https://api.deepseek.com
    currency: CNY                 # 余额币种；价目表也用这个币种，不做换算
    balanceTtlMs: 30000           # 余额缓存时长
    defaultModel: deepseek-flash  # 价目表里没有的模型用哪一行
    maxTurns: 300                 # 单次返回的最大轮次数
    models:                       # 元 / 百万 tokens（官方中文定价页）
      deepseek-flash:
        hit:    { peak: 0.04, offPeak: 0.02 }
        miss:   { peak: 2,    offPeak: 1 }
        output: { peak: 8,    offPeak: 4 }
      deepseek-v4-pro:
        hit:    { peak: 0.3,  offPeak: 0.15 }
        miss:   { peak: 9,    offPeak: 4.5 }
        output: { peak: 27,   offPeak: 13.5 }
```

价格随 DeepSeek 官方调整而变，请对照 <https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/> 更新 `models`。**注意别用英文页的美元价**——两页不是固定汇率关系。

## 实现结构

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | Host 半：`GET /user/balance` 取余额；按会话日志折叠每轮 token 并计价；注册 `GET /deepseek-usage/summary` |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半：手写 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 工厂（无构建步骤），注册 `sidebar.footer.action` 与 `conversation.chat.turnTail` 两个 slot |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 层：插入 `deepseek-usage` 行并带默认配置与价目表 |
| `tools/verify-client.mjs` | 用假 loader / 假 cordis context 跑 client bundle：断言两个 slot 注册、首屏渲染，并把一份价格化的轮次推过展开明细 |
| `tools/verify-render.mjs` | 起一个桩 `/deepseek-usage/summary` 路由 + 每实例一套 hook 状态的桩 React，断言两个座位渲染出真实 payload（金额、tokens、未计价轮次文案） |
| `tools/verify-composition.mjs` | 复刻 `client-modules` 的解析链：profile bundle 列表 → Loader 解析归属 manifest → `dsh.client` 声明与 `./client` 产物 → `inject` 依赖可解析 → patch 行 id/name/config 与 host 导出一致 |
| `tools/verify-turns.mjs` | 解压真实 `.jsonl.zstd` 会话日志（多帧 zstd）并打印逐轮折叠结果 |

Host 半的每轮折叠是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter` 里 `deriveTurnTokenUsage` 的等价实现，差别在于它保留每次 attempt 各自的 `provider/model` 路由，因此混合模型的会话也能逐轮正确计价。

## 自检

```sh

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: turn a YouTube link into study notes — captions, on-screen content via vision, then your own notes merged in.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-youtube-study-notes

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin that turns a YouTube link into study notes — and then gets *your* notes involved.

Give it a link. It pulls the video's own captions, samples the frames so it can read what was on screen, **stops and asks what you took from it**, and merges all three into one document.

The middle step is the point. Every other video-to-notes tool produces the same summary for everyone. This one writes the notes you'd have written, if you'd been taking notes.

## What it does

| Step | What happens |
|---|---|
| 1 | **Captions** — `yt-dlp` fetches the caption track YouTube already publishes. Human-written preferred, auto-generated as fallback. No ASR, no third-party transcript sites. |
| 2 | **Outline** — the timestamped transcript is read in full and outlined by chapter. |
| 3 | **Visual pass** *(optional)* — `ffmpeg` scene-change detection samples one frame per shot; a vision model reads the on-screen text. Catches slides, code, formulas and diagrams the narration never says out loud. |
| 4 | **Ask** — the agent stops and asks what *you* noticed, in your words. Type it or dictate it. |
| 5 | **Merge** — transcript + on-screen evidence + your observations, into one markdown file. |
| 6 | **Save** — `notes.md`, written beside the transcript so the evidence stays with it. |
| 7 | **Clean up** — the frame stills and any video file are removed; the transcript stays. |

### What it leaves on disk

The video is never kept: step 3 downloads it into a temporary directory that is deleted
when the script exits (`--keep-video` is the only way it survives). The frame JPEGs are
removed by step 7 once `notes.md` exists — they are derived from someone else's video and
are typically tens of megabytes, against a few kilobytes of transcript.

Kept, because it is the evidence behind every spoken claim and costs almost nothing:

```
transcript.md  transcript.txt  meta.json  notes.md
```

`cleanup.py` refuses to act on a directory that does not carry one of those markers, so
it cannot be pointed at an unrelated folder. Pass `--keep-frames` to review the stills
yourself.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-youtube-study-notes
```

Restart the profile afterwards — bundle changes apply at boot.

Then trigger it either way:

```
/youtube-study-notes https://youtu.be/VIDEO_ID
```

or just ask in plain language ("get me notes from this video: …"). A link plus a request
for notes, a summary, or study material is enough.

> **Desktop clients:** the desktop app manages its own profile. Use its **Plugins → Add
> plugin** flow rather than the CLI, and enable the bundle when the install finishes.

## Requirements

The plugin ships no runtime code — its substance is the Skill, which drives local tools.
`dsh` does not install these for you:

| Tool | Role | Install |
|---|---|---|
| `python3` | runs the bundled scripts (standard library only) | `brew install python3` |
| `ffmpeg` / `ffprobe` | audio/video probing, scene detection, frame extraction | `brew install ffmpeg` |
| `yt-dlp` | caption listing and download | `brew install yt-dlp` |

The Skill detects missing tools, names them, and waits for your confirmation before
installing anything.

## Enabling the visual pass

Step 3 needs a model that accepts images, and **many model entries do not** — even ones
whose name says "vision". A model is only offered images if its configuration declares
`input: [text, image]`; entries otherwise default to `["text"]`, and the harness refuses
the image before attaching it with:

```
model "<provider>/<model>" does not declare image input
```

The Skill handles this: it tries `read_image` on a single frame first. If the session
model can see images, it reads the frames directly. If not, it delegates through the
`workflow` tool's per-agent `provider` / `model` override, and asks you once which
image-capable model to use.

To make a model explicitly image-capable, declare it in your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml` (the file your profile tells you to edit — not `cordis.yml`):

```yaml
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      your-provider:
        # ...existing provider config...
        models:
          - id: "your-vision-model"
            name: "Your Vision Model"
            contextWindow: 200000
            input:
              - text
              - image
```

A profile with live reload picks this up without a restart.

> **Only declare this if the endpoint actually serves images.** Over-claiming admits an
> image the provider then rejects mid-turn, after the message is already durable. The
> declaration is not verified for you.

**If you skip all of this**, the plugin still works — it just produces transcript-only
notes, and says so rather than pretending it saw the screen.

## Limitations

- **Caption-less videos stop the run.** If a video publishes no caption track at all
  (not even auto-generated), step 1 reports which video failed and stops. Nothing is
  invented to fill the gap. Pair this with a local speech-to-text plugin if you need
  those covered.
- **Auto-generated captions are rough** — no punctuation, misheard proper nouns. The
  skill always reports which kind it got.
- **Vision reads can be wrong at the character level.** A period can read as a hyphen,
  `1` as `l`. Fine for prose, worth double-checking in code and formulas. The skill is
  instructed to flag anything load-bearing that looks ambiguous.
- **Frame sampling sees shots, not motion.** A diagram built up over one continuous shot
  yields a single frame.
- **Personal study use.** Captions, frames and notes are derived from someone else's
  work. Don't republish them.

## How it's built

```
package.json          declares dsh.bundle → cordis.patch.yml
cordis.patch.yml      inserts one @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem row
lib/index.js          resolveSkillRoot() — resolves skills/ from the profile's own module identity
skills/youtube-study-notes/
  SKILL.md            the workflow
  scripts/            yt_transcript.py, video_frames.py, cleanup.py
  references/         notes template and merge rules
```

The bundle mounts its `skills/` directory as an **isolated** provider
(`includeDefaultRoots: false`), so installing it contributes exactly one skill and
cannot shadow or reorder the ones you already have.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: Doubao Search (Volcengine) web search provider for DeepSeek Harness — makes the standard web_search tool return real excerpts, not just titles and links.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-search-doubao

Give DeepSeek Harness's standard **`web_search`** tool a search backend that returns
**real excerpts**, not just titles and links.

This is a **search provider plugin** for the harness's web capability seam (`ctx.web`).
It registers a Doubao Search (Volcengine) backend and points the seam at it, so the
model-facing tool `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web` keeps working unchanged — only the
backend behind it changes.

English | [中文](./README.zh.md)

---

## Why this exists

The harness ships `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek`, which performs search by
asking a model to call the **server-side `web_search` tool** over an
Anthropic-compatible Messages API. That route works, but the results it can surface
carry only a **title and a URL** — the response has no citation excerpts, so the
normalized `sources[].snippet` is always empty.

The Doubao Search API is a plain search endpoint that returns structured results,
including a per-result body. This plugin maps that body onto `snippet`, so every
source arrives with text the model can actually read and cite:

| | model-side `web_search` tool | this plugin (Doubao Search API) |
|---|---|---|
| `sources[].title` / `.url` | ✅ | ✅ |
| `sources[].snippet` | ❌ always empty | ✅ real excerpt per source |
| `sources[].publishedAt` | sometimes the `1970-01-01` epoch sentinel | real date, sentinel filtered out |
| Cost per search | one extra model turn (thousands of tokens) | one API call, no model tokens |
| Typical latency | 6–14 s | ~0.2–0.6 s |

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` (the `ctx.web` seam's provider API).
- Node.js `>= 22`.
- A **Volcengine API key**. An **Agent Plan** key works here and draws on the plan's
  AFP quota — the official Agent Plan docs describe Doubao Search as the plan's search
  service, callable with the plan's dedicated API key. A key from an unrelated
  Volcengine product will authenticate but is not covered by the plan.

The endpoint defaults to `https://open.feedcoopapi.com/search_api/web_search`, which is
the public Doubao Search URL. No configuration is needed to reach it.

## Install

```sh
# straight from this repository
dsh plugin --profile web add github:gilsaia/dsh-web-search-doubao

# or from a local checkout
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-web-search-doubao
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so adding it also adds it to the profile's
bundle list, and its patch selects this provider:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: web-search-doubao
      name: 'dsh-web-search-doubao'

- id: web
  config:
    searchProvider: doubao
    fetchProvider: http
```

`fetchProvider` is restated because a row patch **replaces** the targeted row's whole
`config`; omitting it would unset the fetch provider and break `web_fetch`.

> **About the `Issues with peer dependencies found` warning:** it is expected. The
> `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` packages this plugin imports are provided by the harness itself
> at load time rather than installed into the profile, so pnpm reports them as missing
> peers. The harness resolves them when it mounts the plugin.

Restart the harness afterwards (or reload the profile), then run a search.

## Configure it in the GUI

The plugin ships a **client half**. After one restart it adds a **联网搜索 (Web search)**
page to the harness settings sidebar, and everything below can be done there:

- **API Key** — typed into a password field and written through the harness credentials
  domain under the reference the form names. The literal never enters a settings file,
  and the page only learns whether a key is *configured*, not what it is.
- **Every config field** — endpoint, search type, result count, time range, authority
  filter, query rewriting, summary toggle. Fields you changed show **未保存**; fields the
  user layer overrides show **已覆盖** with a one-click **恢复默认**.
- **Save** applies one revision-fenced write; **撤销** discards the staged edits.

A save takes effect on the next search — no restart needed for either the config or the
key. The page mounts only while the host serves the `web-search-doubao` settings
namespace, so a deployment without the plugin shows no trace of it.

## Provide the key without the GUI

The plugin requires a key. It resolves one in this order:

1. the literal **`apiKey`** config value;
2. the credential named by **`apiKeyEnv`** (default `ARK_API_KEY`), read through the
   harness credentials service, falling back to the launching environment.

So either export it:

```sh
export ARK_API_KEY=...        # then start the harness
```

or set it in the plugin's config in the profile's patch layer:

```yaml
- id: web-search-doubao
  config:
    apiKey: '...'             # a secret; prefer apiKeyEnv so no key enters a config file
```

> If the profile patch is still the shipped default, it contains a bare `[]`. Replace that
> `[]` with your entries — appending a `- id:` item after it makes the file two YAML
> documents and the harness refuses to parse the overlay.

A missing key fails the search with `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING` and a message
naming the reference that was consulted — it never silently returns zero results.

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string (secret) | — | Literal API key. |
| `apiKeyEnv` | credential ref | `ARK_API_KEY` | Credential reference resolved per search. |
| `baseURL` | string | Doubao Search URL | Full endpoint; override for a proxy or a different region. |
| `searchType` | `web` \| `image` | `web` | `image` returns image results instead of pages. |
| `maxResults` | 1–50 | `10` | Result count when a request carries no bound. |
| `timeRange` | string | — | `OneDay` / `OneWeek` / `OneMonth` / `OneYear`, or `YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `authLevel` | 0–2 | `0` | `1` restricts to authoritative sources. Web searches only. |
| `queryRewrite` | boolean | `false` | Let the service rewrite a conversational query into a search-shaped one. |
| `needSummary` | boolean | `true` | Request the excerpt surfaced as `snippet`. Turning this off empties `snippet`. |

`baseURL` can also be overridden with the `DOUBAO_SEARCH_BASE_URL` environment variable.

Every field is read **per search**, so a settings change applies to the next search
without restarting the harness.

## Reverting

Remove the `- id: web` block from `cordis.patch.yml` (or override it in your own patch
layer, which is applied after every bundle layer) to keep the default provider. The
plugin stays registered and selectable, just unused:

```yaml
- id: web
  config:
    searchProvider: deepseek-official
    fetchProvider: http
```

## Verify

```sh
# pure-function and plugin-contract tests: no network, no key
npm test

# live check against the real API; asserts sources carry snippets
ARK_API_KEY=... npm run test:live
```

To confirm the composition without booting:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A4 'id: web$'
# searchProvider: doubao
# fetchProvider: http
```

## How it works

- `provider.js` — `DoubaoSearchProvider`, the wire format, result mapping, and error
  translation. It uses the native `fetch` client and does **not** go through `ctx.llm`.
- `index.js` — the Cordis plugin: `name`, `inject: ['web']`, the `Config` schema, and
  `apply()`, which registers the provider into the seam.
- `client/client.js` — the browser half, declared as `dsh.client` and served by the host
  under `/plugins`. Hand-authored against the loader's client-bundle envelope, so it
  needs no build step and requires only the platform `react`. Every read and write goes
  through the documented Remote namespaces (`settings.describe` / `settings.mutate` /
  `credentials.describe` / `credentials.set`).
- `cordis.patch.yml` — the bundle patch that mounts the plugin and selects it.

Two details worth knowing if you fork it:

- The API answers failures with **HTTP 200** and an `Error` object under
  `ResponseMetadata`, so a successful status code is not enough — the body is checked
  too.
- The API emits an epoch sentinel (`1970-01-01T08:00:00+08:00`) for pages whose crawl
  time is unknown. That is filtered out rather than surfaced as a publication date.

## Compatibility

`@de

plugins.description: OpenCode Go quota in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar foot: one 42px cell plus a hover popover with the rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, each carrying a usage bar, an elapsed-time marker, the remaining share and a reset countdown.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-opencode-go-quota

**English** — OpenCode Go quota in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar foot, directly under the workspace/session list. One 42px cell shows the most constrained window; hovering or clicking opens a popover with the rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, each carrying a usage bar, an elapsed-time marker (so you can tell whether you are burning faster than the clock), the remaining share and a reset countdown. A Host half serves `GET /api/opencode-go-quota` from OpenCode's official usage endpoint (`https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage`) using the key already in the DSH credential store, so the key never reaches the browser. The collapsed 56px rail shows the percentage as a number.

---

在 DeepSeek Harness 网页版**左侧边栏最底部**（「工作区 / 会话列表」下方、与「设置」同排）显示
**OpenCode Go 订阅额度**的 DSH 插件。

## 显示内容

| 区域 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 展开的侧边栏 | **一行 42px 的单元格**：`◯ OpenCode Go ………… 本月 18%`。左边的小圆环本身就是进度指示，右边是最紧张那一档的已用百分比 |
| 收起的侧边栏（56px 竖条） | 一个 36px 圆形按钮，直接显示百分比数字 |
| 悬停 / 点击 | 弹出一个 320px 浮层：每一档一行，含 6px 用量条、**时间进度标记**（窗口已经过去多少，用来判断你是用得比时间快还是慢）、剩余百分比与重置倒计时 |
| 浮层里的「刷新」 | 立即重新拉取（绕过 Host 端 30 秒缓存） |

浮层里每档的三行含义：

```
5 小时窗口                        已用 8%
▓▓▓░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░   ← 填充=已用；竖线=时间进度
剩余 92%            时间已过 46%      2 小时 12 分钟后重置
```

* 竖线在填充右边 → 你比时间用得慢，安全；竖线在填充左边 → 比时间快，要收着点。
* `本月` 的时间进度带 `≈`，因为计费周期的起点不在接口里，是按「重置时间往前推一个自然月」估算的；`5 小时窗口` 和 `本周` 是精确值（5 小时 / 7 天）。

颜色：`< 70%` 品牌蓝，`70%–89%` 黄色，`≥ 90%` 红色，取不到数据显示为灰色 `--`。

## 数据来源

* Host 半边 `GET /api/opencode-go-quota`（同源、拒绝跨站调用）。
* 上游是 OpenCode Go 官方额度接口 `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage`，
  响应形如：

  ```json
  {"usage":{
    "rolling":{"status":"ok","percent":5,"resetsAt":"2026-10-07T06:00:12.000Z"},
    "weekly":{"status":"ok","percent":5,"resetsAt":"2026-10-12T00:00:00.000Z"},
    "monthly":{"status":"ok","percent":17,"resetsAt":"2026-10-28T11:29:15.000Z"}}}
  ```

* 鉴权用你**已经存好**的凭据 `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`（就是 `opencode-go`
  provider 在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `apiKeyEnv` 指向的那一个）。
  **API Key 只留在 Host 进程，永远不会下发到浏览器。**
* 页面每 **60 秒**自动刷新一次；Host 端另有 30 秒缓存，点击卡片可立即强制刷新。
* 上游返回 `cache-control: no-store`，即接口本身不做缓存；数字会随着你（或任何其他机器）正在使用 OpenCode Go 而实时上涨。
* 三档的官方含义（与 OpenCode 面板一致）：`rolling` = 滚动 5 小时窗口、`weekly` = 本周（周一 UTC 重置）、`monthly` = 当前计费周期。接口数字是**全账号**口径，包含其他机器的用量。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-opencode-go-quota/
├── package.json        # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client（platform: web, immediately）
├── cordis.patch.yml    # 插入 id: opencode-go-quota 的 loader 行
├── index.js            # Host 半边：/api/opencode-go-quota 路由
├── client.js           # Client 半边：window.__ModuleLoader__ 工厂，注册进 sidebar.footer.action
├── locale/{en,zh}.json # 插件列表里显示的标题与说明
├── icon.svg            # 插件卡片图标
└── README.md
```

## 安装 / 卸载

安装（已在本机 desktop profile 装好）：

```
plugin_manager  action=install_bundle  target=<本目录或 file:/绝对路径>
```

卸载：

```
plugin_manager  action=remove_bundle   target=dsh-opencode-go-quota
```

临时停用：`plugin_manager action=set_plugin target=opencode-go-quota enabled=false`。

安装后无需重启即可生效；若浏览器页面没有立刻出现，刷新一次页面即可。

## 排查

* 卡片显示红色错误文字：把鼠标停在上面看完整信息。
* `凭据 OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY 未配置` → 在「设置 → 模型」里给 `opencode-go` 填 API Key。
* `额度接口返回 401` → Key 失效或已轮换，重新填一次。
* 直接验证 Host 半边：

  ```bash
  curl -s http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/opencode-go-quota
  ```

plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin to use OpenAI decisions API
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-decisions-classifiers

OpenAI **Decisions API** classifiers for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

The Decisions API (`POST /v1/decisions`, model `gpt-6-luna`) answers typed questions about text
and images instead of generating prose: a **predicate** returns the probability that a condition
holds, a **choice** returns one of your options with the full probability distribution, and a
**score** returns a probability-weighted average over ordered levels. This plugin puts that
capability in four places.

| Surface | What it gives you |
| --- | --- |
| Agent tools | `decisions_classify` (one built-in classifier), `decisions_ask` (arbitrary typed questions, up to ~10 per request), `decisions_status` |
| Cordis service | `decisionsClassifiers` — `listPresets()`, `classify()`, `ask()`, `status()` for other plugins |
| Opt-in call gate | Classify every `run_code`/`bash`/`write`/`edit` call before it executes and deny the flagged ones |
| Advice card | A "classifier opinion" card beside `ask_user_question` multiple-choice prompts, with one click to adopt |

## Classifier library

| id | type | answers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `moderation` | predicate | Does this content violate a standard acceptable-use policy? |
| `prompt-injection` | predicate | Does this text try to manipulate an AI system rather than inform a reader? |
| `dangerous-command` | predicate | Does this command irreversibly destroy data or change machine-wide state? |
| `pii` | predicate | Does this text identify a real individual? |
| `relevance` | predicate | Is this passage relevant to the stated query? (pass `context`) |
| `severity` | score | Cosmetic / workaround available / fully blocked |
| `intent` | choice | billing / technical / shipping / other |

Anything else goes through `decisions_ask`, which takes the wire question types directly.

## Setup

1. Install the bundle (see below).
2. Open **Settings → Decisions Classifiers**, paste an OpenAI API key, and press **Store key**.
   The key is written through the DSH credential seam as `OPENAI_API_KEY` (or the env name you
   set) and is never read back by the page. `OPENAI_API_KEY` in the process environment or a
   `.env` file works too.
3. Press **Test connection**.

The call gate is **off by default**: installing this plugin changes no agent behaviour until you
turn it on.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-decisions-classifiers
```

or through the Harness plugin manager with the package directory as the target.

## Configuration

Every field is settable from the Settings page (persisted to
`~/.dsh/decisions-classifiers/config.json`) and overridable from the bundle row; live edits win.
Pin a deployment in `cordis.patch.yml`.

| key | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | master switch |
| `baseUrl` | `https://api.openai.com/v1` | endpoint base; `/decisions` is appended |
| `model` | `gpt-6-luna` | the only model the Decisions API serves today |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `OPENAI_API_KEY` | credential-seam reference name |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | per-request budget |
| `defaultThreshold` | `0.5` | predicate cut-off when a preset does not fix one |
| `advisorEnabled` | `true` | the advice card |
| `gateEnabled` | `false` | the pre-execution gate |
| `gatePreset` | `dangerous-command` | classifier the gate runs |
| `gateThreshold` | `0.5` | gate cut-off |
| `gateDecision` | `deny` | `deny` or `escalate` |
| `systemPromptSection` | `true` | tell the agent the classifiers exist |

## What the numbers mean

The endpoint returns a probability distribution over a support, then projects it: `choice` takes
the argmax, `score` takes the expectation of the zero-based level index, and `predicate` has
nothing to project. Those projections are where the interpretation lives, and they are not
equally portable.

| type | support comes from | scalar you get | portable? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `predicate` | the world (true/false) | `probability` | **yes** — the one number that travels |
| `choice` | **your options list** | `choice` (argmax) | no — menu-dependent |
| `score` | **your ordered levels** | `score` = E[index] | no — level-dependent, and metric-imposing |

**`predicate` is the only portable scalar.** It is a Bernoulli parameter, so it is calibratable
against realized outcomes (reliability diagrams, Brier score) and thresholdable against a cost
rule. One caveat matters more than it looks: the endpoint accepts *any* input, so many predicates
are subjective ("is this code maintainable?"). There, `probability` is not a property of the
world — it is a marginal over a rule set nobody wrote. Calibration still works, but its referent
becomes *your* raters instead of reality: it licenses "consistent with our standard", never
"true".

**`choice` distributions are menu-dependent.** The support is your options list, so relabeling
the menu moves the numbers while the world stays put. Measured on one fixed top category, with
only the tail split ever more finely:

| menu | max p | sum p² | top-2 gap |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2-way [0.80, 0.20] | 0.8000 | 0.6800 | 0.6000 |
| 4-way [0.80, 0.09, 0.06, 0.05] | 0.8000 | 0.6542 | 0.7100 |

Two candidate concentration measures move in **opposite directions** under that relabeling. So a
4-option and a 2-option question in the same batch are not comparable on any confidence number,
and the interpretable signal is the **top-2 margin** — how close the routing is to a coin flip.

**`score` is an ordinal position presented as an interval.** Levels carry only `label` and
`description`; the API assigns indices 0..n-1 by position, with no client-supplied weight or
value. E[index] is meaningful only if your levels are equally spaced in the quantity you care
about — usually false for severity, where cosmetic→workaround is a far smaller real jump than
workaround→blocked. Prefer thresholding on `P(level >= k)` over the returned `probabilities`:
that needs no metric assumption.

**`confidence` is a concentration index, not a probability.** The guide calls it a separate field
and never defines it, and it cannot be recovered from the published examples: sum p² and the
top-2 gap both fit them to within ~0.01 while disagreeing in *sign* under relabeling. It is also
not comparable across questions with different option counts. Read `probabilities` directly and
compute your own statistic with weights you know.

### Where the rubric actually lives

No answer type removes the standard you were supposed to specify; they relocate it.

| type | where the standard lives | failure mode | detectable? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `predicate` (observable) | the world | estimation error | yes — reliability |
| `predicate` (subjective) | model prior + prompt | **definition ambiguity** | mostly invisible |
| `choice` | **your options list** | menu sensitivity | yes — measurable |
| `score` | your levels list | imposed equidistance | visible, magnitude unmeasurable |

A `choice` externalizes the standard — readable, diffable, and its sensitivity is measurable. A
subjective `predicate` internalizes it, which makes it *less* auditable, not more objective. And
a subjective `probability` is a mixture over provenance channels with unknown weights: the
model's prior over "maintainable" is built from scraped text, paid annotation, users' own chat
inputs and corrections, and automatic outcome signals such as test pass/fail — each with
different epistemic standing. That is the practical reason "does the test pass" is trustworthy
and "is this maintainable" is not: only the first has a rubric in the loop.

### Auditability

Every `decisions_classify` verdict carries the exact `question` that was sent — type, name,
instructions, and the choices or levels — and `decisions_ask` returns the questions as
normalized and sent. For a subjective predicate that instruction text is the only part of the
decision with a knowable provenance, so a verdict without it cannot be reviewed after the fact.
The full wire request is deliberately not echoed: it can carry inlined base64 images.

## Known limitations

- **Images must be inline base64.** The endpo

# dsh-llm-kilo-gateway

[![test](https://github.com/aqiu817/dsh-llm-kilo-gateway/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/aqiu817/dsh-llm-kilo-gateway/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)

**中文** | [English](./README.en.md)

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的 **Kilo Gateway 免费模型**提供商插件。

自动发现 Kilo Gateway 的免费模型目录，把它们注册成 Harness 里可直接使用的 provider，
并提供一个设置页：你自己的 API Key、可用模型列表、模型增减日志、按模型累计的 Token 统计。

> **一句话结论**：它让 Harness 零成本地用上十几个免费模型，但**这些免费模型的提示词与输出可能被上游记录并用于训练**。不要用它处理任何敏感内容。

---

## ⚠️ 风险与限制（请先读这一节）

**以下每一条都标注了来源。官方条款部分引用 Kilo 的公开文档原文，实测部分是本插件对真实 API 响应的观察。**

### 1. 免费模型的输入可能被记录并用于训练

这是本插件在模型目录里**实测**到的：目录共 401 个模型，其中 16 个是免费的，
**16 个全部**标注 `mayTrainOnYourPrompts: true`。
Kilo 官方文档对此的表述是：

> Auto Free 可能会把你的请求路由到**会记录提示词与输出、并用它们改进自身服务**的 provider。
> 使用 Auto Free 时**不要提交个人或机密数据**。

NVIDIA 系免费端点的官方说明更严格：

> **仅供试用 —— 不要提交个人或机密数据。** 你的使用会被记录，用于安全目的以及改进 NVIDIA 的产品与服务。

### 2. Kilo 服务条款授予的许可范围很宽

Kilo 服务条款（[kilo.ai/terms](https://kilo.ai/terms)，最后更新 **2026-09-30**）第 7(A) 条规定：

> 上传数据即授予 Kilo 一项「**永久的、不可撤销的、已全额付讫的、免版税的、全球性的、可再许可的、可转让的**」权利与许可，
> 「用于提供和改进服务及 Kilo 的其他产品与服务」。

同条还写明：

> 如果你选择不授权任何 AI 模型把你的 Customer Data 用于**训练**目的，你**可能无法使用某些 AI 模型**。

第 9 条提供的退出选项是**营销邮件**，不是 AI 训练。社区讨论（非官方声明）称
零数据保留（ZDR）目前似乎限于企业/团队方案。**本插件不改变这些条款，也无从规避它们。**

### 3. 免费额度与限流

- **匿名访问**：官方文档称免费模型对已认证与匿名用户都可用，**匿名用户限 200 请求/小时/IP**。
- **上游限流**：官方文档称「部分免费模型可能被上游 provider 限流」。
  实测中免费池会返回 `429 Provider returned error / request limited concurrency reached`，
  这是上游的并发上限，不是配置问题。
- **免费不等于无成本**：目录里这些模型 `pricing` 全为 0，但上游随时可能调整。

### 4. 免费模型会消失

免费目录是**动态**的。实测中 3 个模型带有明确的到期日：

| 模型 | 到期 |
| --- | --- |
| `poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free` | 2026-10-31 |
| `poolside/laguna-xs-2.1:free` | 2026-10-31 |
| `dots-studio/dots-3-note-preview:free` | 2026-12-31 |

其余模型没有到期日，但这不代表长期可用。**任何依赖免费模型的工作流都要做好模型随时下线的准备。**
本插件的设置页会记录模型增减日志，便于你发现变化。

### 5. 本插件的其它已知边界

- **免费池的稳定性不可控。** 实测遇到上游返回 400（某模型声明的输出上限高于其上游实际接受值）、
  429（并发限流）、以及「HTTP 200 但内容为空」。插件会把可恢复的失败正确分类并重试，
  但重试预算用尽后仍会失败。
- **推理档位只反映目录所声明。** 目录说有哪些档位就显示哪些，不猜。
- **`expires` 只显示不过滤。** 到期日会显示在设置页，但不用于过滤已过期模型。
- **端口占用即禁用通知端点。** 见「通知链路」；这是刻意的设计。
  注意**两个宿主同时运行时，旧进程会占住端口**，导致新进程的端点是关闭的。

### 6. 本仓库不对上游行为作任何担保

本插件是**第三方客户端**，与 Kilo 无隶属关系。上游 API 的字段、限流政策、
训练的条款、甚至端点地址都可能随时变化。出现问题时请先确认是上游变更还是插件缺陷。

---

## 功能特性

- 🔄 **自动发现免费模型** — 从 Kilo Gateway 目录读取 `isFree: true` 的模型，无需手工维护列表
- 📅 **定时刷新** — 默认每 24 小时刷新，可在设置页调整
- 🔔 **变更通知** — 模型新增/移除时弹出通知，并写入增减日志
- 🧰 **完整工具调用** — 请求带 `tools`，解析流式 `delta.tool_calls`，组装成可执行的工具块
- 🧠 **推理强度** — 从目录的 `opencode.variants` 读出每个模型**真实声明**的档位
- 🖼️ **图像输入** — 按目录声明的 `architecture.input_modalities` 判断，图片以 data URL 送上游
- 📊 **Token 统计** — 按模型累计调用次数与各类 token（含缓存读写单列）
- 🔑 **自带 Key 输入** — 在设置页粘贴 API Key，写入 Harness 凭据系统，**永不回显**
- 📋 **可用模型列表与增减日志** — 设置页内查看目录现状与历史变化
- ♻️ **上游错误重试** — 状态码映射到 Harness 的重试词汇，`429`/`5xx`/超时自动重试

## 依赖要求

| 依赖 | 版本 |
| --- | --- |
| Node.js | **≥ 22** |
| DeepSeek Harness | **0.2.x**（在 0.2.0-rc.2 上验证） |

插件的运行时包（`dsh-llm`、`cordis`、`schemastery` 等）声明为 **`peerDependencies`**，
版本范围是 `*`，并在 `peerDependenciesMeta` 里**全部标为 `optional`**。两条都不是随手写的：

- **必须是 `peerDependencies`。** Harness 在决定「把插件的裸导入重定向到哪一份实例」时，
  读的正是插件清单元数据里的 `peerDependencies` 键名（宿主源码里是 `readPeerNames`）。
  这些名字若只出现在 `dependencies` 里，重定向就不会发生，插件会拿到一份私有的
  `dsh-llm` 副本 —— 与宿主不是同一个实例，适配器注册不会生效。
- **范围必须是 `*`。** 宿主会拿 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 这些 peer 的
  **版本范围**去比对**运行中的 dsh 运行时版本**（不是包自己的版本）。实测把 `dsh-llm`
  钉成 `^0.1.5-rc.2` 时，宿主直接拒绝加载：

  ```
  dsh: skipping profile bundle "...": Plugin dsh-llm-kilo-gateway@1.0.0 is
  incompatible with dsh 0.2.0-rc.2: peerDependencies {"@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm":"^0.1.5-rc.2"}
  ```

  钉死范围会让插件在 rc 升级后自己锁死自己，所以留 `*`，由宿主的兼容性检查把关。
- **必须标 `optional`。** 这是给 npm 看的，与宿主无关（宿主只读键名，不看 `meta`）。
  npm 的 `latest` 标签指向 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` 的**旧版本** `0.0.1-rc.1`，
  不标 optional 时 npm 会照着自己解析出一份错版本的副本装进消费者工程。
  实测标注后 `added 1 package`，consumer 里不再多出 `@deepseek-ai/*` 目录；
  而插件的导入仍解析到宿主提供的那一份（已验证 `require.resolve` 指向同一文件）。

## 安装

```bash
# 从 npm 安装到 profile（本例为 web profile）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-llm-kilo-gateway
```

从源码安装用 `link:`（符号链接），改源码即刻生效：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-llm-kilo-gateway
```

**桌面端**：profile 名是 `desktop`，命令相同，但要用桌面端自带的 CLI
（宿主会拒绝 `dsh --profile desktop`，因为该 profile 由 Electron 应用独占管理）。

装完**重启宿主**。模型选择器里会出现 Kilo Gateway 分组，「设置 → 插件」出现设置卡片。

## 设置页

入口是侧边栏「插件」页里的 **Kilo Gateway** 卡片，或 `dsh-llm-kilo-gateway` 这张 bundle 卡片的详情页。

### 可编辑字段

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKeyEnv` | (空) | API Key 的凭据名；**留空 = 匿名访问**（200 请求/小时/IP） |
| `refreshIntervalMs` | `86400000` | 目录刷新间隔（毫秒），下限 60000 |
| `notifyPort` | `9876` | 通知端点端口，**填 0 关闭** |
| `notifyOnFirstLoad` | `true` | 首次加载是否弹通知 |
| `maxRetries` | `2` | 单次失败请求最多重试几次（0 = 关闭），上限 10 |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `300000` | 单次上游请求超时（毫秒），10 秒 – 30 分钟 |

`baseURL` 与 `catalogUrl` **不在设置页**：改它们会重写 entry config 并重载 fiber，
属于 shell/发布层管理的字段。

### 你自己的 API Key

「Kilo API Key」是一个**只写**控件：密钥字面量不进入设置文档、不随 `settings.describe` 回传，
页面只知道「是否已配置」。写入走 Harness 凭据服务，地址是**当前 `apiKeyEnv` 的取值**；
该字段留空时回落到占位符提示的 `KILO_API_KEY`。

这是一条硬约束：**密钥绝不能放进请求头或设置分节**——宿主会把整个分节原样回传给浏览器。

也可以不用页面，改用环境变量：

```bash
export KILO_API_KEY=your_key_here
```

### 只读面板

页面底部有三个面板，数据来自宿主的 loopback 端点：

- **可用模型列表** — 当前免费模型及其目录自报的能力。只显示目录**声明过**的能力，不猜不补。
- **模型增减日志** — 最近 50 次目录变动，最新在前。
- **Token 统计** — 本进程按模型累计的用量。表尾的「合计（所有模型）」是一行**汇总**，不是模型。

## 配置

### 重试策略

重试由 Harness 的 `dsh-llm-retry` 执行。本插件只负责两件事：
把状态码**分类**成失败码，并把 `maxRetries` 作为预算报上去。

| 状态 | 失败码 | 会重试 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 400 / 422 | `INVALID_REQUEST` | 否 |
| 401 / 403 | `AUTH` | 否 |
| 402 | `QUOTA` | 否 |
| 404 | `INVALID_MODEL` | 否 |
| 408 | `TIMEOUT` | **是** |
| 429 | `RATE_LIMIT` | **是** |
| 5xx | `SERVER` | **是** |

**哪些失败可重试是分类结果，不是设置项**——用户能手动重试的失败不代表请求能活下来。
适配器自己只在**流尚未开始**时重试一次连接层抖动（预算刻意小于宿主的，避免两层循环相乘）。

### 输出预算 ≠ 输出上限

目录里的 `max_completion_tokens` 是模型**最多能吐多少**（能力），不是每次请求该要多少（预算）。
把能力当预算发送会被上游拒绝。本插件取 `min(目录上限, 32768)`，
与内置 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 适配器的 `DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS = 32768` 惯例一致。
用户仍可通过 Harness 的 `maxTokens` 显式要求更多。

## 通知链路

Host 半边在配置端口上起一个 loopback HTTP 服务，浏览器半边按**同一端口**轮询。

| 路由 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /notify` | 目录摘要（变更 toast 用） |
| `GET /state` | 模型列表 + 增减日志 + Token 统计（设置页面板用） |

两个路由**仅监听 `127.0.0.1`**，且**每个响应都带 CORS 头**（含 404）。
页面与端点不同源，缺 `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` 时浏览器会屏蔽整个响应，
把状态码吞成一句 `Failed to fetch`——这曾导致本插件的故障排查被引向错误方向。

服务端**不会**在端口占用时回退到随机端口（客户端按配置端口寻址，换端口等于静默失效）。
绑定失败会记录警告并让端点保持关闭。**排查端口冲突**：

```bash
netstat -ano | grep 9876                              # 谁占着
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'" | Select ProcessId,CommandLine
```

## 当前免费模型（16 个）

下表由一次真实抓取生成，与设置页「可用模型列表」同源同格式。
**目录随时会变，以设置页为准。**
