plugins.description: DSH plugin: context-aware per-step reasoning-effort routing — classify → escalate → hysteresis → capability clamp; Auto mask in the native selector; default effort fill + wire mapping for custom llm-pi-ai models. AI-authored (kimi-k3), produced by @neo805. No Issues/PRs; forks welcome (MIT).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-effort-router

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

**Version:** `0.2.5-rc.1` · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md)

A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: **context-aware per-step reasoning-effort routing**, plus reasoning levels for hand-declared `llm-pi-ai` custom models.

- Task-shape classification: `trivial / standard / engineering / hard` from the brief itself, not from tool-call counts
- Wish detector: a short delegation-style brief in the cue vacuum zone (`帮我…`, `can you…`) starts at the engineering floor — underspecified tasks get the benefit of the doubt
- Evidence escalation: tool errors, identical-argument retries, brief text volume, and recent tool-result volume lift the class (loudest signal wins, capped per task, sliding 32-step window)
- Hysteresis: upgrades apply immediately, downgrades wait for two consecutive quiet decisions
- Frugal signals: subagents, context pressure, or a session token budget demote one class
- Capability clamp: the scheduled tier maps onto the target model's advertised vocabulary (nearest rank, so gateway vocabularies like `ultra` work)
- Manual wins: a concrete level in the selector passes through verbatim; Auto hands the step to the scheduler

## Why an Auto mask instead of a panel

The host's native model selector already is the per-session effort control. The plugin advertises an `Auto` level on every reasoning-capable model (injected into `reasoning.efforts`, resolved to a concrete wire level by the request interceptor before validation), so there is **no second selector to keep in sync**: Auto schedules, a concrete level passes through.

## Custom models (llm-pi-ai)

Hand-declared custom models often ship no `reasoningEfforts` table, so the composer shows no effort selector at all. On startup and on settings changes the plugin scans the `llm-pi-ai` config and fills the default `{ low, high, max }` table through a **resolution gate**: every table-less user-layer row is resolved with `resolveModelInfo`, and only models that resolve with NO thinking levels are filled — a model inheriting levels from its catalog is skipped, so catalog capability is never shadowed. An explicit table or an explicit `false` is never touched. The table deliberately has **no `off` rung**: an off selection followed by a tool call poisons the conversation for every later thinking-enabled request, and the router never routes to off either (you can still add `off: null` back per model in the editor — explicit intent is never overwritten). Models filled on explicit `openai-completions` routes also gain `compat.supportsReasoningEffort: true`, the switch that protocol needs to actually send the effort.

The per-model level → gateway wire-value mapping (e.g. `high → ultra`) is edited under **Settings → Effort Router** and written straight into the `llm-pi-ai` config, gated by the official schema, effective on the next request. pi-ai serializes the table natively; no plugin-side translation layer.

## Settings

**Settings → Effort Router**:

- Enabled / default level / subagent default
- Bounds: allow max (**on by default** since 0.2.0 — hard tasks reach max; opt out here and `maxFallback` applies), max fallback, wish detector, poison recovery, trajectory hoisting, frugal demotion, context-pressure threshold, token budget
- Class → tier route table (trivial/standard default low, engineering high, hard max)
- Advanced: downgrade hysteresis, escalation thresholds (apply on plugin reload), custom cue dictionaries (strong / normal / cheap / wish)
- Custom-model editor: expand a provider, tick levels and enter wire values, or fill missing levels everywhere in one click

## In-session visibility

- **Composer badge** (left of the model selector): the mode and effort of the session's last step (`Auto · high`), with class and reason in the tooltip. Read-only — control stays in the native selector.
- **Trajectory hoisting** (default on): each step's `provider/model · effort` is projected onto the NATIVE trajectory ledger rows (DOM projection anchored on `data-trajectory-row-key` — the assembly-layer route, no host package touched and no new view added). The anchor table is folded host-side from `request/header` + `assistant/message` + `tool/call` events and served on the state route. The chat flow itself stays annotation-free.

## Safety and degradation

- The interceptor is one try/catch: any error passes the request through untouched (fail-open)
- Models without reasoning metadata never receive `reasoningEffort` — never an `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`
- Automatic routing never emits `off` (thinking continuity on strict thinking-mode APIs). A history PROVEN poisoned — a reasoning-less tool-call turn exists AND the session's decision log recorded a manual `off` step — pins `off` with a warning until compaction removes the offending turn. Shape alone never pins: models like kimi-K3 emit no reasoning blocks before tool calls with thinking on (measured, 2026-10-10). Disable via `poisonRecovery` if your routes are all non-strict
- Session reads go through `deriveMessages()` + `sessionProjections` only; an empty sample raises an explicit warning instead of silently degrading

## Authorship & maintenance

- **Author**: kimi-k3 (an AI model, designing and coding through DeepSeek Harness).
- **Producer / repository owner**: KEI.NEO (@neo805) — the human publisher responsible for this repository.
- **Maintenance scope**: a personal hobby (vibe-coding) project, published for sharing. **No maintenance or updates are promised in response to external demand.**
- **Contribution policy**: this repository has **Issues disabled and does not accept Pull Requests**. Forks are welcome under the MIT license.
- **Disclaimer**: the software is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind (see LICENSE). Evaluate it yourself before production use.

## Thanks & license

MIT. The policy core (classification / escalation / hysteresis / tier mapping / signal collection / projection / store) is adapted from [@neptune810/dsh-model-router](https://github.com/Neptune810/dsh-model-router) (MIT © Neptune810); the capability layer and Auto-mask pattern follow [dsh-thinking-levels](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-thinking-levels) (MIT © drscrewdriver); the custom-model default-fill idea comes from [@hytime/dsh-thinking-effort](https://github.com/hytime/dsh-thinking-effort) (MIT © hytime).

plugins.description: Hermetic composition lock for DeepSeek Harness — profile fingerprint; drifted compositions warn or fail (strict)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-freeze

Hermetic composition lock for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh).

**"Today's agent composition is byte-identical to the one you reviewed."**
Fingerprints the booted profile — installed dependencies (name-sorted), the
ordered bundle composition, the pnpm lockfile hash, the user patch layer —
baselines it, and compares on every boot. A session running on a drifted
composition says so loudly; `strict: true` fails the boot entirely (the
`--frozen` posture for CI). Zero LLM calls in the trust path.

Family: ... mcp-test (what agents can call) · prompt-drift (what they are
told) · **freeze (what exactly they are running)**.

## Why now (checked 2026-10-12)

The supply-chain lane has seven install-time scanners and one read-only
plugin ledger (`dsh-harbor`) — all answer "is this package ok to install?"
Nobody answers **"is the composition I'm running today the one that was
audited?"** Spike-verified: `dsh --dump-config` is byte-stable across runs,
and profile files (package.json / pnpm-lock.yaml / cordis.patch.yml) are the
complete composition truth — a deterministic fingerprint is sound.

## What moves the alarm

| field | meaning |
|---|---|
| `dependencies` | a package was added/removed/retargeted |
| `bundles` | the ordered composition changed |
| `pnpm-lock` | resolved versions moved (upgrade!) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | the user layer changed |

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile default add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-freeze
```

Prebuilt `lib/` ships in the repo — git installs need no build step and no
`allowBuilds` authorization.

## Configure

```yaml
- id: dsh-freeze
  name: dsh-freeze
  config:
    baselinePath: .dsh-freeze/baseline.json
    strict: false          # true: drift fails the boot (CI posture)
    profile: ""            # '' auto-detects from argv (--profile, else 'web')
```

Note: the baseline is written into the *working directory* of the session by
default; for CI, point it somewhere durable and commit it.

## Develop

```sh
npm install && npm test
```

## Kill criteria

If dsh ships first-party profile pinning (`--frozen` boot flag or
equivalent), this freezes at its last working version with a postmortem
here.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-dex-style-edit

Codex-style message editing for DeepSeek Harness: edit an already-sent message and continue from there.

Click the pencil under any user message, change the text in place, press Enter. DSH session logs are append-only, so the plugin forks a new session at the turn *before* that message, sends your edited text as its opening message, and archives the session it replaced. Your files and working directory are left exactly as they are.

The model you pick in the composer before sending is the model that runs the edited message.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

像 Codex App 一样编辑已发送的消息：点铅笔改气泡内容，**从这条继续**。

DSH 会话日志只追加、不可改写，所以实现方式是：在此消息之前那一轮处 fork 一个新会话，把改过的文本作为新会话的第一条消息直接发出，并归档被替换的原会话。工作目录与文件保持现状。

发送前你在输入框里选的模型，就是这条改过的消息实际使用的模型。

</details>

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:XylaAlyx/dsh-plugin-dex-style-edit
```

Then **restart DSH**. A pencil appears under every user message, and forked sessions carry a branch glyph in the sidebar.

Full notes (behaviour details, implementation, known limits): [docs/README.full.zh.md](docs/README.full.zh.md).

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-bid-qual-check — Bidder qualification condition register check

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-bid-qual-check` reads one bidder qualification condition register — the 投标人资格条件核对表, its header plus one row per qualification condition — and checks that register's own closed loop: that each condition records its requirement, that the bidder's actual position is recorded, that evidence is attached, that the verdict comes from your vocabulary, that a pass/fail item records position, evidence and verdict together, that the register names its project and bidder, that condition numbers are unique, and that no unreplaced placeholder survives in the requirement column.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-bid-qual-check: real output over its BQ-002 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-bid-qual-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-bid-qual-check-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `BQ-002` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| One row has both `资格条件` and `要求内容` blank. Is that reported? | Yes. `BQ-001` holds every row to at least one of those two columns and reports the row when both are empty. It checks that something was written, not whether that condition is lawful or should have been set at all — that is a review of the tender document itself. |
| A condition has its `投标人情况` column empty, and no `证明材料` either. | Two findings: `BQ-002` reports the row for the blank `投标人情况` (`actual`) and `BQ-003` for the blank `证明材料` (`evidence`). Both check only that the cell is filled — not whether the position satisfies the condition, nor whether the document is valid, current or matches the original, which needs the originals and the committee's call. A column that is present with every cell blank is still reported row by row; a material without that column puts the rule in `skipped` instead of passing silently. |
| The `核对结论` column is blank on a row. Does `BQ-004` report it? | No — `BQ-004` tests only the values that are written and skips blank cells. Its `values` list ships empty, so out of the box the rule reports itself in `skipped`; once you configure your institution's vocabulary in `values` (`符合` / `不符合` / `需澄清`, say), a value outside that list is reported row by row. It checks that the value is in your vocabulary, not that the conclusion is correct, and no value ever invalidates a bid. The rule is capped at `info`, because the vocabulary is your institution's to set. |
| A row's `是否否决项` cell reads `是`, but `投标人情况` or `证明材料` is missing. | `BQ-005` requires `投标人情况`, `证明材料` and `核对结论` together on every row whose `是否否决项` cell matches the configured marks (`是`, `Y`, `yes`, `true`, `否决项`, `√` by default) and reports the row with what is missing. Which conditions count as pass/fail comes entirely from the tender document and from that column, never from a built-in list. If no row carries such a mark, the rule reports itself in `skipped` instead of passing — and it never decides whether the bid should be rejected. |
| The register's header names the tender number, but not the project or the bidder. | `BQ-006` reports the header once and names what is missing: `project` (the project name) or `bidder` (the bidder name). It only checks that the header declares those two parties — it does not check the tender number or the check date, and adding the verdict vocabulary to this rule would not help, because that is controlled by `BQ-004`'s `values`. |
| This register was copied from a template: two rows share the number `3`, and one `要求内容` cell still reads `待填`. | `BQ-007` reports the repeated `序号` (the comparison ignores whitespace, so `3` and ` 3 ` are the same number), and if no row carries a number at all it reports itself in `skipped` instead of passing. `BQ-008` reports the residual placeholder in `要求内容` — `【`, `】`, `{{`, `}}`, `XXX`, `待填`, `待补充`, `TBD`, `示例` and the rest of its `terms` list, which you can narrow. Both checks are literal: neither judges whether the requirement itself is right, and a requirement genuinely quoted with an `XXX` in it is reported too. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《中华人民共和国招标投标法》 | 1999年8月30日通过，2017年12月27日修正（全国人大常委会《关于修改〈中华人民共和国招标投标法〉、〈中华人民共和国计量法〉的决定》），本法自2000年1月1日起施行 | BQ-001, BQ-002, BQ-003, BQ-004, BQ-006, BQ-007, BQ-008 |
| 《中华人民共和国招标投标法实施条例》 | 国务院令第613号（2011 年 12 月 20 日公布，2017 年 3 月 1 日修订，自 2012 年 2 月 1 日起施行） | BQ-005 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks a **投标人资格条件核对表** for the closed loop a checklist can be held to —
that every condition records its requirement and the bidder's actual position, that evidence is attached, that
verdicts come from your vocabulary, that a **pass/fail item** records all three, that the table names its
project and bidder, that numbers are unique, and that no placeholder survives. It does **not** decide whether a
bidder is qualified, whether qualification fails, or whether a bid should be rejected. **That is the
qualification committee's call, made against the evidence originals and the tender document's conditions.**

> ### ⚠️ Read this before trusting a citation in the report
>
> **Every `excerpt` in this plugin's rule pack says, in so many words, that the clause text was not
> obtained.** The regime lives in 《中华人民共和国招标投标法》(notably its articles on qualification
> conditions and on bidders' qualifications), 《招标投标法实施条例》, and **each tender document's own
> qualification conditions**. The verification pass could not retrieve verbatim clause text, so rather than
> paraphrase a quotation the pack states the gap in the `excerpt` field itself and puts the honest reasoning
> in `note`. Every rule is therefore `warn` or `info`, and a test asserts that no rule claims a quotation it
> does not have. **When the texts are in hand, two things must be done: replace each `excerpt` with the real
> clause, and raise `kind` to `direct`.**
>
> Two judgements are yours, not the plugin's. **Which conditions count as pass/fail items depends entirely on
> the tender document**, so `BQ-005` reads the **checklist's own 是否否决项 column** rather than any built-in
> list, and the values that mark an item as pass/fail are configurable. And the **verdict vocabulary ships
> empty** — with nothing configured, `BQ-004` reports itself in `skipped`. A finding never says a bid is
> invalid; it says a cell is empty or a value is not in your vocabulary.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately not declared: it has no reader and cannot reject a host |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native`, `ptc` and `both`; for several bidders use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `bid_qual_check` tool. It reads one qualification register — the package header plus one row per
condition — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BQ-001` | every condition records its requirement | warn | direct |
| `BQ-002` | every condition records the bidder's actual position | warn | direct |
| `BQ-003` | every condition attaches evidence | warn | direct |
| `BQ-004` | the verdict comes from your vocabulary (off by default) | info | local |
| `BQ-005` | a pass/fail item records position, evidence and verdict | warn | principle |
| `BQ-006` | the table names its project and bidder | warn | principle |
| `BQ-007` | condition numbers are unique | warn | principle |
| `BQ-008` | the requirement column holds no unreplaced placeholder | warn | principle |
## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-bid-qual-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-bid-qual-check'
```

## Configuration

| Key | Type | Default | Descripti

plugins.description: DSH 桌宠插件 dsh-pet 的二创版：新增亲密度养成、番茄钟、语音朗读、音效、增强菜单、每日统计；可与原版并存
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pet-plus

**DSH（DeepSeek Harness）桌面宠物插件** —— 基于 [`dsh-pet`](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet) `0.3.6` 的二次创作。

保留上游**全部基础功能**（动画、漫游、拖拽抛掷物理、余额、碎碎念、对话与记忆、系统通知、工作状态联动、
多开与布局、透明置顶桌面小窗），并新增六组功能。与上游**可以并存**（改名隔离，见下）。

> ### 二创来源与权利声明
>
> - **上游**：`dsh-pet` 0.3.6，作者 **PC2005-cloud**，MIT 许可
>   （<https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet>）。
> - **本二创**：`dsh-pet-plus`，作者 **youhuangqing**，就本仓库**新增与修改的部分**同样以 MIT 释出。
>   上游 `LICENSE` 原文完整保留，两者许可互相独立、互不影响。
> - **素材例外**：动画 / 提示词 / 源视频沿用上游声明 —— **允许开源使用，禁止商用**。
> - 详见 [`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

---

## 〇、路径约定

下文用 **`<DSH安装目录>`** 表示你的 DeepSeek Harness 安装位置（**不是固定值**，取决于你安装时选的路径）。
`dsh.cmd` 与 pnpm 都在它下面。不确定就查：

```powershell
Get-Command dsh | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Source   # dsh 已在 PATH 时
```

拿到的路径形如 `<DSH安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`，往上退三级就是 `<DSH安装目录>`。

---

## 一、环境要求

| 项 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| DSH | 桌面版 `0.2.0-rc.1` / `0.2.0-rc.2`（`0.1.7-rc.2` 不兼容） |
| 系统 | **Windows 优先**（桌面小窗与语音朗读依赖 Windows 自带能力）；其它平台可用浏览器内的那只宠物 |
| 网络 | 仅在**首次**会下载 Electron 运行时（约 200MB，用于桌面小窗）。之后离线可用 |
| 语音朗读 | 走 Windows 系统语音（离线），或用 Edge 联网音色（可选） |

不需要额外安装 Node.js —— 构建产物已随包提供。

---

## 二、安装

假设你的档案名是 `desktop`（DSH 桌面版默认）。

### 方式 1：一行命令（推荐，直接从 Release 装）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/youhuangqing/dsh-pet-plus/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-pet-plus-0.1.0.tgz
```

`dsh` 不在 PATH 时用全路径：`& '<DSH安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' plugin --profile desktop add <上面的网址或本地 tgz 路径>`。

### 方式 2：从本地 tgz 装

```powershell
& '<DSH安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' plugin --profile desktop add file:C:\path\to\dsh-pet-plus-0.1.0.tgz
```

装完**重启 DeepSeek Harness** 即可（插件在启动时加载）。

> 若该包日后发布到 npm，也可以按包名安装：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-pet-plus`。

### 为什么装完要重启

DSH 在启动时组合插件树，运行中不热加载第三方插件。

### 安装后怎么确认装上了

浏览器开发者控制台（`Ctrl+Shift+I`）里搜 `dsh-pet-plus`，应能看到功能就绪日志；
或访问 `http://127.0.0.1:19387/dsh-pet-plus-7340/state`，返回的 `sections` 里应含
`social` / `pomodoro` / `stats` / `sfx` / `tts`。

---

## 三、功能一览

| 功能 | 怎么用 |
|---|---|
| **亲密度 + 喂食养成** | 点击宠物摸头；右键「互动」→ 摸摸头 / 喂小鱼干；`/social` 看状态 |
| **番茄钟** | 右键「专注」→ 开始 25 / 10 / 45 分钟；菜单标题实时显示倒计时 |
| **语音朗读** | 自动朗读宠物说的话；右键「偏好 → 语音朗读」开关；`/tts status` 看提供方 |
| **音效** | 自动（点击 / 落地 / 余额 / 番茄钟结束 / 升级 / 喂食）；右键「偏好 → 音效」开关 |
| **增强菜单** | 右键新增「互动 / 专注 / 统计 / 偏好」四组，浏览器里那只与桌面上那只完全一致 |
| **每日统计与记账** | 右键「统计」；`/stats`；`/dsh-pet-plus-7340/stats?days=7` |

上游原有功能（余额、碎碎念、对话、系统通知、工作状态联动、多开布局、设置页）全部保留。

---

## 四、配置

**首次运行后**配置文件在：

```
C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\dsh-pet-plus\main-config.jsonc
```

改完**即时生效**（每个请求重读），不用重启、不用重装。包内 `assets/config.jsonc` 是带完整注释的默认值，
想看所有可配项就看它。

### 语音音色（最常问的一个）

在 `main-config.jsonc` 里写 `tts` 段，然后让它说句话（或 `/tts 你好呀`）即可听效果：

```jsonc
{
  "tts": {
    "enabled": true,
    "provider": "edge",          // "auto"（Windows→系统语音）| "sapi" | "edge" | "stub"
    "voice": "zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural", // ← 音色名写这里
    "rate": 0,                   // 语速 -10~10
    "volume": 100
  }
}
```

**音色名怎么选**：

- `provider: "sapi"`（离线，系统自带）：音色名要写**已安装的 Windows 语音名**。列出本机已装的：
  ```powershell
  Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Speech
  (New-Object System.Speech.Synthesis.SpeechSynthesizer).GetInstalledVoices() |
    ForEach-Object { $_.VoiceInfo.Name + '  [' + $_.VoiceInfo.Culture.Name + ']' }
  ```
  Windows 中文版通常只有 `Microsoft Huihui Desktop`（成年女声）。**想要少女音/萝莉音，需要另外装 Windows 语音包**，或者用下面的 Edge。

- `provider: "edge"`（**联网**，微软 Edge「大声朗读」接口，音色明显更好且免 key）：候选音色名包括
  `zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural`（少女）、`zh-CN-XiaoshuangNeural`（童声/萝莉）、`zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural`（默认女声）、
  `zh-CN-XiaomengNeural`、`zh-CN-XiaohanNeural`。
  ⚠️ 这是**未公开接口**，随微软改动可能失效。为此做了三重保护：**默认不用它**、返回字节必须是合法 MP3 才采纳、
  失败**自动回落系统语音**。所以最坏结果只是"Edge 没生效、退回系统语音"，不会更坏。
  `/tts status` 会显示**实际生效**的提供方；应用日志里会写明是否发生过回落。

- `provider: "stub"`：只产出静音，用来验证链路（排查用，不出声）。

### 改设置页里那一行的名字

`src/client/settings.ts` 里 `zh` 字典的 `nav` 字段（以及 `en` 的），改完重新构建：

```powershell
& '<DSH安装目录>\resources\runtime\pnpm\bin\pnpm.mjs' run build
```

（仓库里 `lib/` 是构建产物、不入库，所以要自己构建一次；详见第九节。）

---

## 五、命令

| 命令 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `/pet` | 选择当前桌宠（支持选择框或手输 id/名字） |
| `/chat` | 与桌宠对话 |
| `/balance` | 查询余额 |
| `/social` | 亲密度 / 小鱼干状态 |
| `/pomodoro` | 番茄钟（start / stop / status …） |
| `/stats` | 每日统计 |
| `/tts` | 语音朗读（status / 直接给一句试听文本） |

**与上游 `dsh-pet` 并存时**，`/pet` `/chat` `/balance` 三个短名归**先加载的原版**，
本插件会自动改用 **`/pet-plus` `/chat-plus` `/balance-plus`**（注册失败只告警，不会让插件加载失败）。
卸掉原版后短名自动归本插件，无需改配置。

---

## 六、卸载

```powershell
& '<DSH安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-pet-plus
```

然后重启。用户数据（`~/.dsh/dsh-pet-plus/`）不会自动删除，需要时手动删。

---

## 七、与上游并存

本插件把所有注册进 DSH 全局命名空间的标识都加了 `-plus`：包名、cordis 行 id、路由前缀
（`/dsh-pet-plus-7340`）、桥协议 scheme、用户数据目录（`~/.dsh/dsh-pet-plus/`）、Electron 应用名、
环境变量前缀、**客户端插件名与插槽 id**、**locale 命名空间**（`pet-plus.config`）、斜杠命令。

两套可以同时装、互不影响（会看到两只宠物、设置页两个分区）。想只用一套就卸掉另一个。

> ⚠️ Electron 运行时目录（`~/.dsh/electron/`）是两套**共用**的，这是刻意的 —— 避免重复下载 200MB。

---

## 八、已知限制

| 项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 悬停快捷条 | **未实现**（计划里有）。它要改桌面端「整窗点击穿透」的判定，改错会让鼠标移过去就穿透、按钮点不到，在缺少真机验证条件下风险过高。 |
| Edge 联网音色 | 协议为未公开接口，**未经运行时验证**（有三重保护，最坏退回系统语音）。 |
| token 用量统计 | 会话事件是否携带 usage 未核实，故留空而非填猜测值。 |

---

## 九、开发

仓库**不含** `lib/`（构建产物），clone 后先装依赖再构建：

```powershell
# 1) 装依赖（需要网络；peer 依赖 @deepseek-ai/* 是公共 npm 包）
& '<DSH安装目录>\resources\runtime\pnpm\bin\pnpm.mjs' install

# 2) 构建与自测
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = '1'
$env:PATH = '<DSH安装目录>\resources\runtime\bin;' + $env:PATH
$exe  = '<DSH安装目录>\DeepSeek Harness.exe'
$pnpm = '<DSH安装目录>\resources\runtime\pnpm\bin\pnpm.mjs'

& $exe --expose-internals $pnpm run typecheck     # 类型检查
& $exe --expose-internals $pnpm run build         # tsdown + 重建 shared-core.js
& $exe --expose-internals $pnpm test              # 上游测试套件（553 个用例）
& $exe --expose-internals $pnpm run test:single   # 受限环境用这个（不 spawn 子进程）

# 3) 独立模式（不需要 DSH、不用重启应用）
$env:DSH_HOME = '<工作区内的临时目录>'
& node.cmd lib/standalone.js --port 3099
```

> `$exe --expose-internals $pnpm` 是「用 DSH 自带的 Node 跑 pnpm」的写法。
> 你也可以直接用系统里的 `pnpm`（如果有）：`pnpm install && pnpm run build`。

`runtime/electron-helper/*.js` **不在 tsc 范围内**，改动后要单独做语法检查：`node --check <文件>`。

**打分发用的包**：`pnpm pack` → 产出 `dsh-pet-plus-<版本>.tgz`，把它作为 Release 附件发布。

---

## 十、许可与署名

代码 MIT（见 `LICENSE`）。素材来自上游 `dsh-pet`：**代码 MIT；动画 / 提示词 / 源视频允许开源使用，禁止商用。**
详细说明见 `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`。

plugins.description: DSH 插件：在对话框工具行、权限选择框右侧只读显示当前项目的 git 分支；目录不是仓库时不显示。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-git-branch

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4c8dff.svg)](#安装)

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）的**对话框
（composer）工具行**中，紧跟在**权限选择框**之后，显示当前项目的 **git 分支**。

刻意做成只读：只显示，不提供任何选择。目录不是 git 仓库时**什么都不渲染**——没有占位、
没有空框、没有报错。

## 挂在哪里

对话框工具行的固定布局：

```
[+ 命令] [权限 ▾] [plan] ← 分支标记渲染在这里
```

插件注册到 `conversation.input.left`，即 shell 紧跟在常驻模式控件之后渲染的**追加式**槽位。
该槽位对宿主 UI 是追加式的（`replaceRisk: none`），因此既不会替换也不会遮挡任何自带控件。

样式刻意对齐相邻的权限选择框：同样 28px 高、13px/500 字号、`--dsw-alias-label-secondary`
文字色、无自带背景、14px 的 `currentColor` 图标——浅色与深色主题下都落在同一基线上。分支名
过长时省略号截断，不会把右侧控件挤走。

## 行为

| 目录状态 | 渲染内容 | 悬浮提示 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 在某个分支上 | 分支图标 + `main` | `Git 分支: main` |
| 游离 HEAD | 分支图标 + `a1b2c3d` | `游离 HEAD: a1b2c3d` |
| 仓库还没有第一次提交 | 分支图标 + 默认分支名 | `Git 分支: main` |
| 不在仓库里 | 什么都不渲染 | — |

重新读取的时机：会话工作目录变化、每轮对话结束、标签页重新可见。**从不轮询。**

## 环境要求

- DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 或更新。
- Host 进程的 `PATH` 上有 `git`。
- 别无其它：没有构建步骤、没有运行期依赖、没有配置项。

`git` 不存在或探测超过 5s 超时时，该目录会被判为“非仓库”，标记保持隐藏，不会向用户报错。

## 安装

本包是一个 DSH **bundle**：自带 `cordis.patch.yml`，所以安装它的同时就会加上它的插件行。

**推荐——走插件管理器。** 在 Web 界面 Settings → Plugins → *添加插件*，目标填
`https://github.com/helloHupc/dsh-git-branch` 或本地 checkout 目录。Agent 侧等价的做法是用
`plugin_manager` 工具的 `install_bundle`，`target` 同样是该 URL 或目录。

**本地 checkout 安装。** clone 之后，用上面任一方式安装该目录。

安装是持久改动：对该 profile 下的所有会话生效，重启后依然存在。

> 目前端到端验证过的是**从本地目录安装**；从仓库 URL 安装走的是插件管理器有文档的 git 支持。

### 卸载

在同一个 Plugins 页面移除该 bundle，或用 `plugin_manager` 工具的 `remove_bundle`。依赖与
bundle 选择会一起移除；插件的插件行和它的路由也随之消失。

## 实现方式

**Host 一半（`index.js`）** 在 Web 载体上注册一条只读路由：

```
GET /dsh-git-branch?sessionId=<id>&cwd=<绝对路径>
```

- 工作目录取 Host 会话存储里该 Session 的**权威 cwd**；只有当 Host 尚未物化该会话时，才使用
  客户端传来的绝对 `cwd`。**绝不**把 Host 进程自己的工作目录当作答案。
- 每次探测只用系统 `git` 跑一次（`execFile`；无 shell、无第三方库、无缓存），形式为
  `git -C <cwd> …`，并设置 `GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0`、`GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`、5s 超时，同时
  删除 git 自己的仓库覆盖变量（`GIT_DIR`、`GIT_WORK_TREE` 等）——即便 Host 是在另一个 git
  上下文里启动的，也始终由 `-C` 决定是哪个仓库。
- 仓库判据依次为 `rev-parse --show-toplevel`、`symbolic-ref --short HEAD`，游离 HEAD 时再用
  `rev-parse --short HEAD`。`symbolic-ref` 在“还没有任何提交”的 unborn HEAD 上也能回答，而
  `rev-parse HEAD` 此时已经失败。
- 围栏与 `/api` 网关完全一致：`Host` 必须是回环地址，或部署声明的 `trustedHosts` 之一；拒绝
  `Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site`；带 `Origin` 时主机名必须一致。这是 DNS rebinding 与跨站读取
  的防线，不是身份认证。

一切格式正确的请求都返回 `200` + `{ ok: true, … }`，包括 `{ "isRepo": false }` —— 隐藏标记
是客户端的决定，不是错误分支。只有围栏（403）、非 GET 方法（405）和 URL 畸形（400）才返回其它
状态。

**浏览器一半（`client.js`）** 是浏览器产物：一个 classic script，只注册一个惰性 factory——这
正是 DSH 模块加载器要求的形态。它只用自己写的 React 与主题 token，不 import 任何
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` 包：那些包说变就变，而一个抛异常的组件会把这个槽位条目整个变空。
样式、词典、槽位注册全部登记为 `ctx.effect`，所以插件卸载与 HMR 重新激活都能干净地移除并重装。

## 显示名称

插件列表里的标题与描述来自 `locale/<语言>.json` 的 `meta.title` / `meta.description`，
**不是** `package.json` 的 `name`：

- `locale/en.json` 是必需的回退锚点；同目录下的其它文件（如 `zh.json`）会一起被读取。
- 标题与图标都经过包的 `exports` 解析，所以 `"./locale/*.json"` 这条导出必须保留。
- `package.json` 的 `name` 是标识符：它决定 Loader 行 `name` 与浏览器模块 id。

## 开发

```bash
node test/host.test.mjs   # Host 一半的检查：围栏、方法、工作目录、git 探测
```

`test/host.test.mjs` 会创建真实的临时仓库并直接驱动注册的路由处理器——不需要 profile、不需要
安装 DSH、不联网，只要求有 `git`。

改两半的生效范围不同：

| 文件 | 生效时机 |
| --- | --- |
| `client.js`、`locale/*.json` | 下次页面加载 |
| `index.js` | DSH 重启之后——Host 代码不会在进程内热替换 |

## 安全说明

- 这条路由会通过本地 HTTP 载体暴露某个仓库的分支名。围栏阻止的是敌意页面的跨站读取；把服务绑到
  非回环地址时，请按对待任何本地服务的标准对待它。
- 客户端的 `cwd` 只接受绝对路径，且仅在会话存储没有答案时使用。路由从不回退到 Host 进程的工作
  目录，因此无法被引导去报告一个无关的仓库。
- 只读：每次调用都只是 `rev-parse` / `symbolic-ref` 探测。不写文件、不加锁、不用凭据、不弹提示。

## 已知边界

- 每个请求一次 `git` 子进程；`git` 缺失或探测超时都会被判为“非仓库”。
- 这条路由不做身份认证，这一点与本地 Web 载体的其余部分同一设计。
- 已针对 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 验证。浏览器一半只使用该槽位有文档的标准 props，但未来的 DSH 版本仍
  有可能改动那个槽位。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE) © helloHupc

plugins.description: DSH 插件：左下角账户入口不再显示手机号前2后3位，改用自定义 id，可在「插件」页配置 | DSH plugin: use a custom id instead of the server-masked phone number in the sidebar account entry
plugins.readme_text:
[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/PrismScopes/dsh-account-alias)

# dsh-account-alias

**让 DeepSeek Harness 左下角账户入口不再显示你手机号的前 2 后 3 位，改用你自己设定的 id——并且可以在界面里随时改。**

装完重启一次，侧边栏那一行和「设置 → 账号」资料卡片里都不会再出现服务端下发的脱敏手机号/邮箱。

- 能力分类：界面与体验
- 许可证：MIT
- 平台：DeepSeek Harness（Desktop / Web 客户端），Windows / macOS 均可

![左下角账户入口显示为自定义 id（侧栏底部 3 倍放大）](docs/account-entry-3x.png)

> 上图是侧栏底部区域（3 倍放大）：原本会显示 `13*****678` 的位置，现在显示设定的自定义 id。
> 原始尺寸：[docs/account-entry.png](docs/account-entry.png)

---

## 它解决什么问题

侧边栏底部的账户入口由官方包 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-account` 渲染，标签算法是：

```
profile.name ?? profile.contact ?? t("signedIn")
```

而 `contact` 并不是前端算出来的，是宿主侧 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-deepseek-account-platform`
对 Platform 响应的投影：

```js
contact: mobile || mobile_number || email || null
```

也就是 **Platform 已经脱敏过**的手机号（形如 `13*****678`）或邮箱。前端只是原样显示，
所以没有设置昵称的账号，左下角必然出现手机号的前 2 后 3 位。同一个字段也出现在
「设置 → 账号」的资料卡片里。

本插件把显示换成你自定义的 id。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:PrismScopes/dsh-account-alias
```

装完**重启 DeepSeek Harness**（宿主只在启动时读取 profile）。

也可以在「设置 → 插件市场」里搜索 `dsh-account-alias` 一键安装。

> Windows 上如果你是从本地源码目录安装（`link:` 方式），请用仓库里的
> `install.ps1`：它会做一次真实副本安装并做加载自检。原因见下方「为什么本地源码安装要额外一步」。

## 使用

打开 **侧栏「插件」→ dsh-account-alias → 行 `account-alias` → 配置**，可以改三项：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 自定义 id | `User` | 左下角账户入口与账号设置页显示的内容。留空 = 保留服务端昵称；支持 `{uid}` 占位符，展开成账号 UID |
| 脱敏联系方式 | `不显示` | 服务端下发的就是已脱敏手机号或邮箱。选「不显示」后两处界面都不再出现它 |
| 占位文本 | 空 | 「不显示」时用这段文字顶上；留空则该字段直接不出现 |

保存后**即时生效，不需要重启**（配置字段以 volatile 形式下发）。

等价的配置文件写法（profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`）：

```yaml
- id: account-alias
  name: dsh-account-alias
  config:
    alias: PrismScope
    contact: hide
    contactText: ''
```

## 它改了什么，没改什么

这条链路上只有一个共享注入点：

```
Platform HTTP
  → dsh-deepseek-account-platform   实现 ctx.deepseekAccount
  → dsh-api-account-controller      getProfile() → ctx.deepseekAccount.getProfile(client)
  → client ui-settings-account      settings.launcher 标签 + 设置页资料卡片
```

插件把宿主的 `ctx.deepseekAccount.getProfile` 包一层，只改写返回值里的 `name` / `contact`：

- **没有替换任何 UI 席位**。账户菜单（设置入口、意见反馈、退出登录、头像、赠金通知）
  仍是官方原装组件，只是它读到的资料变了。
- **账号 UID（`id`）绝不改动**。平台用它隔离赠金通知（`identityOf`），
  `getPlatformSession` 也复用它，改掉会串号。
- 被替换的方法从**原型**上取，不从实例取：重装时永远包在真正的 provider 方法外，
  不会叠在上一个包装器上；插件卸载时删掉自己加的实例属性，原行为完整恢复。

## 权限与风险

- **不联网**。插件本身不发任何请求，只改宿主已经拿到的资料投影的显示值。
- **不读凭据**。不接触 token、不读 cookie、不写任何文件；`getProfile` 的原始响应
  仍由官方包获取，插件只在返回路径上改两个字符串。
- **不改服务端数据**。Platform 请求本身照旧，脱敏字段该传什么还传什么；
  推理鉴权、赠金通知的账号标识、意见反馈问卷的 `uid` prefill 都不受影响。
- **配置文件**：只读 profile 的 Cordis 配置（由宿主提供），设置页的写入由官方
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings` 落盘，插件不自己写文件。
- 唯一的外部依赖是宿主自带的 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（用于生成设置表单）。
  拿不到它时，插件仍然工作，只是设置表单消失并在日志里说明原因。

## 已知限制

- **只改显示**。服务端下发的仍然是脱敏后的联系方式，本插件只控制它是否出现在界面上。
- 保存后，侧边栏那条标签要等一次账户资料刷新才会更新——重新打开一次设置面板即可。
- 依赖宿主存在 `ctx.deepseekAccount`（Desktop 登录态）。未登录时侧边栏显示的是
  「更多」行，本来就没有手机号。
- 兼容性：面向 DSH `0.2.x` 系列构建，使用 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` ≥ `3.18.4`。

## 为什么本地源码安装要额外一步

如果你用 `link:` 方式安装（源码目录 + 符号链接），插件里的 bare 导入
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 不会被解析到宿主副本，而是沿真实路径命中你机器上可能存在的
**旧版本**（3.18.2 没有 `Schema.prototype.volatile`），模块在求值期抛错、条目静默失效。

平台规则见 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` 的 `routeLinked()`：linked 包里的 bare 导入，
只有在该包 manifest 的 `peerDependencies` 里列出这个名字时才会被拦截到宿主副本。
本包已经声明了 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` peer，并且 `install.ps1` 会把包复制成
**profile 层包**（真实目录），此时无论走拦截还是普通解析，命中的都是正确那份。
从插件市场（git）安装则天然是 profile 层包，不需要这一步。

## 文件结构

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | 宿主半边：导出 `Config`（三个 volatile 字段）+ `apply`，包装 `getProfile` |
| `profile-alias.js` | 纯逻辑：配置归一化、volatile 现读、资料改写、补丁与还原（无外部依赖，便于单测） |
| `client.js` | 客户端半边：注册 `plugins.row.config` 的设置表单（手写 `__ModuleLoader__` 模块，无需打包） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 补丁行与默认配置 |
| `install.ps1` | 可选：Windows 本地源码安装 / 卸载，自带加载自检 |

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Go (圍棋) plugin for the DeepSeek Harness: full rules engine, three-level AI, dead-stone estimator, LLM review, SGF, and an optional KataGo GTP bridge
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-go-game

圍棋 for the DeepSeek Harness. A full rules engine, a three-level AI partner,
a playout dead-stone estimator, optional LLM review, SGF save/load — surfaced
both as a DSH panel (`shell.overlay`) and as a standalone page at
`/dsh-go-game/`.

## What it does

**Rules (host half, pure JS).** 19×19 / 13×13 / 9×9, Chinese area scoring
(stones + surrounded empty points), configurable komi and handicap, capture by
liberty exhaustion, no suicide, simple ko (immediate recapture forbidden),
pass / two-pass end, resignation, unlimited undo, SGF import and export.
Dead-stone adjudication is explicit: both sides pass, dead stones are marked
(manually or by the estimator), then the area is counted.

**The AI.** Three levels, all run in the host process:

| level | how it plays |
| --- | --- |
| `easy` 入門 | random legal moves that avoid filling its own eyes |
| `medium` 中級 | greedy tactics: capture, rescue from atari, atari the opponent, shape/line preference |
| `hard` 進階 | the medium candidate list, each scored by light random playouts inside a wall-clock budget |

**Honest limit:** this is a practice partner, not an engine. On 19×19 even
`hard` is far below a human amateur; on 9×9 it plays a recognisable game.

**Dead-stone estimator.** `形勢判斷` runs random playouts (avoiding own-eye
fills) from the current position and reports which stones rarely survive, plus a
per-point ownership map the board renders as a translucent overlay. It is an
estimate, not an adjudication — correct anything it gets wrong with `標記死子`.

**LLM review (optional).** `覆盤` asks the harness `llm` service (no API keys in
this plugin) for a short Cantonese commentary plus a suggested move, which the
panel offers as a one-click play. Without a configured model it degrades to the
local scoring summary.

## Layout

| file | face | role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lib/engine.js` | shared | rules: board, capture, ko, score, SGF — no DOM, no DSH imports |
| `lib/ai.js` | host | heuristics, playout opponent, dead-stone estimator |
| `lib/gtp.js` | host | GTP bridge to an external neural-network engine (KataGo) |
| `lib/index.js` | host | sessions + every `/dsh-go-game/*` route, LLM review, SGF files |
| `lib/client.js` | web | the React panel registered in `shell.overlay` |
| `lib/page.html`, `lib/page.js` | web | the standalone page (a thin view over the same routes) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | — | inserts the plugin row into the web profile roster |
| `test/*.test.mjs` | — | 98 cases: 26 engine, 11 AI, 22 host routes, 26 GTP, 13 engine fallback |
| `check-plugin.ps1` / `.cmd` | — | read-only install check |

No rules live in the browser: both views post intent and re-render the state the
host returns.

## Tests

```
node test/engine.test.mjs
node test/ai.test.mjs
node test/host.test.mjs
node test/gtp.test.mjs             # GTP bridge, driven by an injected fake engine
node test/engine-fallback.test.mjs # engine selected but absent -> built-in AI
node test/katago-live.mjs --root=<katago dir>   # real engine, skipped without --root
```

Run each file directly; `node --test` fails on this machine (the runner spawns a
piped child process and the sandbox rejects it). The host suite drives the real
routes through a mock webserver, mock `req`/`res` and a mock `llm`, so the whole
non-UI chain is covered offline.

## KataGo (optional neural-network opponent)

`lib/ai.js` is a heuristic/playout practice partner. For real strength,
`lib/gtp.js` drives an external KataGo process over GTP, **side by side** with the
built-in AI: the panel's `引擎` selector picks one per game, and a missing or
broken engine falls back to the built-in opponent automatically (the reason is
shown in the panel, not swallowed).

Layout it looks for (relative to the workspace, i.e. one level above the plugin):

```
katago/engine/katago.exe        Eigen (CPU) build, or any other backend
katago/engine/default_gtp.cfg   optional, ships with the release
katago/weights/*.bin.gz         one or more networks
```

Environment overrides:

| variable | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DSH_GO_GAME_KATAGO_ROOT` | `<plugin>/../../katago` | engine + weights root |
| `DSH_GO_GAME_KATAGO_THREADS` | 4 | search threads (stay below the core count) |
| `DSH_GO_GAME_KATAGO_VISITS` | 250 | hard visit ceiling per move |
| `DSH_GO_GAME_KATAGO_TIME` | 8 | **seconds per move** — bounds CPU latency |
| `DSH_GO_GAME_KATAGO_TIMEOUT` | 90000 | GTP command timeout (ms) |

`GET /dsh-go-game/engine` reports availability, the network list and live status;
`POST /dsh-go-game/engine {model:"<file>"}` switches network, restarting the
process (KataGo loads exactly one network at startup).

Measured on this machine — i5-8250U, 4 threads, no GPU, b18c384 on the AVX2 Eigen
build: first move ≈ 11 s (it loads the 93 MB network), later moves ≈ 8 s with
`maxTime=8`. Because the search is time-bounded, slower hardware loses strength
rather than latency. Every query replays the game onto a clean engine board after
an explicit `clear_board`: KataGo does *not* wipe the stones on a same-size
`boardsize`, which otherwise surfaces as a spurious "illegal move".

## Install (three steps, outside DSH)

The agent sandbox cannot write outside the workspace, so profile registration is
a manual step — run these in a normal terminal:

1. In the active profile `package.json` (`%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness\profiles\web`):
   add `"dsh-go-game": "link:C:/AppDev/DSH_WORKSPACE/dsh-go-game"` to
   `dependencies`, and append `"dsh-go-game"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`.
2. Point node_modules at the source directory (DSH does not run `pnpm install`
   on boot, and a missing link fails silently):

   ```
   mklink /J "%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness\profiles\web\node_modules\dsh-go-game" "C:\AppDev\DSH_WORKSPACE\dsh-go-game"
   ```

3. Restart DSH.

`check-plugin.cmd` verifies all four links of the chain (package → registration →
node_modules → live route) at any point.

Routes are unauthenticated on loopback, matching the other local plugins:
`GET /dsh-go-game/status` answering JSON is the fastest proof of life.

## Notes and unverified parts

- Sessions live in host memory (12-hour idle sweep) and are keyed by a client id
  the panel/page generates; restarting DSH clears them. SGF files persist under
  `<workspace>/.dsh-go-game/games/`.
- The playout estimator is CPU-bound by design and budget-limited (default
  1500 ms, 40 playouts). It runs on the host so the panel never blocks.
- **Not yet verified on a live GUI**: the panel's rendering inside
  `shell.overlay`, its pointer-event behaviour, and the LLM review path against a
  real provider. The engine, AI and every route are covered by the offline
  suites.

plugins.description: GLM Coding Plan quota pill for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI - real-time per-window usage in the composer stats row
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-glm-quota-dock

[![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Everglow28/dsh-glm-quota-dock?display_name=tag&sort=semver&color=1f6feb)](https://github.com/Everglow28/dsh-glm-quota-dock/releases/latest)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-glm-quota-dock?color=cb3837&logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-glm-quota-dock)
[![Last Commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/Everglow28/dsh-glm-quota-dock/main?color=8250df)](https://github.com/Everglow28/dsh-glm-quota-dock/commits/main)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2da44e)](LICENSE)
![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-DeepSeek%20Harness-1f6feb)
[![PRs Welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-2ea44f)](https://github.com/Everglow28/dsh-glm-quota-dock/pulls)

[DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件:在会话输入框下方的统计行内,常驻一个 **GLM Coding Plan 额度 pill**,实时显示各窗口用量百分比。

A lightweight DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows your GLM Coding Plan quota as an always-visible pill in the composer stats row.

```
◔ GLM 5h 9% · 周 45% · 工具 7%
```

## 截图

详情面板(底部统计行内可见 pill),三种额度状态独立着色:

| 正常(<80%,绿) | 告警(≥80%,黄) | 临界(≥95%,红) |
| :---: | :---: | :---: |
| ![详情面板 正常(45%)](docs/images/panel-45.png) | ![详情面板 告警(88%)](docs/images/panel-88.png) | ![详情面板 临界(99%)](docs/images/panel-99.png) |

> 三张图分别为 5 小时窗口 45% / 88% / 99% 的状态: pill 与对应进度条随窗口阈值同步变色;面板含逐条限额、重置时间、近 24 小时按模型用量与套餐档位。

## 特性

- **实时额度**:输入框统计行内常驻 pill,30 秒轮询;每个窗口(5 小时 Token / 周额度 / 工具月度额度)独立着色 —— <80% 绿、≥80% 黄、≥95% 红
- **仅在 GLM 会话显示**:通过会话的模型选择投影判断,只有当前会话走 **Coding Plan 路由** 且使用 `glm-*` 模型时才渲染;纯 API 计费路由(消耗余额而非套餐)不会误亮,非 GLM 会话完全零请求
- **点击详情**:逐条限额进度条(独立着色)、重置时间(悬停看倒计时)、近 24 小时按模型 Token 用量、套餐档位与版本说明、手动强制刷新
- **空闲降频**:页面可见但 5 分钟无操作时自动降为 5 分钟一轮,恢复操作立即刷新;最小化/切走完全停止
- **套餐版本自适应**:V1(5h + 月度)、V2(含周窗口)、新版积分制均按响应字段自动识别展示,未知形状优雅回退
- **密钥不出本机**:API Key 只在 Host 进程内解析与使用,浏览器仅拿到聚合后的百分比;路由挂在 DSH `/api` 信任栅栏与浏览器鉴权之后

## 要求

- DeepSeek Harness(Desktop 或 `dsh web`,建议较新版本)
- 已在 DSH 模型页配置 GLM Coding Plan 供应商(如 `zai-coding-cn`),其 API Key 会通过凭据引用自动解析(默认 `ZAI_CODING_CN_API_KEY`)

> [!NOTE]
> 作者仅在 **Lite 档(历史版本 V1:5 小时窗口 + 月度工具额度)** 上实际验证过。V2(含周窗口)与新版积分制是按官方响应字段做的适配,逻辑上兼容但未经真机验证;如显示异常,欢迎提 issue 附上返回结构。

## 安装

插件零构建、零依赖,已发布到 npm,最简单的安装只需一条命令。

**方式 A:npm(推荐)**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add dsh-glm-quota-dock
```

**方式 B:让 DSH 会话里的 Agent 安装**(任何 profile 通用)

把仓库地址交给 DSH 会话里的 Agent:

> 请用 plugin_manager 的 install_bundle 安装 https://github.com/Everglow28/dsh-glm-quota-dock

Agent 会克隆仓库并把 bundle 装进当前 profile,安装成功后按提示**重启 DSH + 刷新网页**即可。

**方式 C:`dsh` CLI + git clone**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Everglow28/dsh-glm-quota-dock.git
dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add <克隆目录的绝对路径>
```

**方式 D:手动**

把仓库克隆/复制到 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-glm-quota-dock/`,并在该 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 追加:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: glm-quota-dock
      name: 'dsh-glm-quota-dock'
      config:
        endpoint: https://open.bigmodel.cn
        minIntervalSec: 60
```

安装后**重启 DSH**(Host 半部需要随进程加载),再**刷新网页**(Client 半部)。

## 配置

在安装时生成的 Cordis entry 的 `config` 下调整(改完重启):

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `endpoint` | `https://open.bigmodel.cn` | 全球站用户改为 `https://api.z.ai` |
| `minIntervalSec` | `60` | 上游最小请求间隔(秒),下限 30 |
| `apiKeyRef` | `ZAI_CODING_CN_API_KEY` | 凭据引用名(与模型页写入的引用一致) |
| `apiKey` | 无 | 直接内联 key(不推荐,优先用凭据引用) |
| `cwd` | `\` | 上游请求(curl)的工作目录,一般不用改 |

## 工作原理

```
凭据服务解析 API Key(与 zai-coding-cn 模型路由同一把 key)
        │
        ▼
Host 半部调用官方监控端点(裸 key 鉴权,与官方 glm-plan-usage 一致):
  GET {endpoint}/api/monitor/usage/quota/limit     ← 各窗口百分比/重置时间
  GET {endpoint}/api/monitor/usage/model-usage     ← 近 24h 按模型用量
        │  60s 内存缓存 + 并发去重
        ▼
注册认证路由 GET /api/glm-quota(DSH /api 信任栅栏 + 浏览器签名 cookie)
        │
        ▼
Client 半部:同源 fetch,30s 轮询(空闲降频),渲染 pill 与详情面板
```

数据来自智谱官方监控接口(与官方 `glm-plan-usage` 插件同源),轮询频率保守,不触碰任何非公开接口。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> remove "dsh-glm-quota-dock"
```

或让 Agent 调 `plugin_manager remove_bundle`。移除后重启 + 刷新页面。

## 常见问题

- **pill 不显示?** 确认当前会话使用的是 Coding Plan 路由下的 glm 模型;确认凭据引用已配置(面板报错时悬停 "GLM !" 可看原因);Host 半部改动需要重启而非刷新
