plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-token-usage-panel

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）对话区下方的**模型用量面板**：逐次调用的 token 与花费、峰谷计价、账号余额、日历热力图，全部落在输入卡下方那一条状态条里。

```
会话 ¥0.561 · 15.9M   今日 ¥0.561 · 15.9M ............ 余额 ¥3.44   谷价 · 21h02m   明细 ▴
```

条内从左到右：支出（会话 / 今日）→ 靠右组（余额 / 峰谷状态 / 明细开关）。
**三个主项（会话 / 今日 / 余额）在任何宽度下都常驻**；宽度不够时只压缩次要数字，且永远保持一排：

| 宽度 | 显示 |
|---|---|
| 宽裕 | 会话 ¥x · tokens　今日 ¥x · tokens　余额 ¥x　谷价 · 21h02m　明细 |
| 偏窄 | 会话 ¥x · tokens　今日 ¥x　余额 ¥x　谷价 · 21h02m　明细 |
| 很窄 | 会话 ¥x　今日 ¥x　余额 ¥x　谷价 · 21h02m　明细 |

峰谷倒计时任何档位都完整保留（不随密度压缩）。

判定用一条隐形探针量「当前档位」的真实宽度：放不下升一档，留出 ≥80px 余量才降档，因此不会来回抖；
更窄时由 `nowrap` + 省略号兜底，绝不会变成两排。整条状态条用 `order:1` 排在官方「上下文用量环」
**之后**（dock 本身是 `display:flex` 的 flex 行，list slot 是 Fragment 渲染），所以那枚环落在「会话」左边、
峰谷与明细靠容器右边。

点「明细」在输入卡上方展开面板，四个页签：

| 页签 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 逐次调用 | 每一次模型调用的时间、模型、未命中输入 / 缓存命中 / 输出 token、峰或谷、按单价算出的花费；可按**本会话 / 今日 / 近 30 天 / 全部**切换，附合计行与分页加载 |
| 日历热力图 | 13 / 26 / 39 / 53 周可切的滚动格子，按当日花费分色，悬停显示 日期 · 花费 · 调用次数 · token（有余额观测时还显示当日实扣） |
| 余额 | 充值余额、赠送余额、最近观测时间、手动刷新；「今日余额实扣」与「今日表价估算」并排对账 |
| 设置 | 状态条开关、热力图默认周数、缓存写入计价口径、余额刷新间隔、单价表、峰时段、法定节假日 |

## 安装

```bash
# 从 npm（若有发布）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-token-usage-panel

# 本地开发（link 安装，改代码即时生效，见「开发」）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<本目录绝对路径>
```

也可以在 **设置 → 插件** 里开关；关掉后对话区下方的状态条立即消失，已有的账本数据保留。

> 仓库：[https://github.com/JackRoe/dsh-token-usage-panel](https://github.com/JackRoe/dsh-token-usage-panel) · 许可 MIT · 版本 0.2.3

## 从 GitHub 安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/JackRoe/dsh-token-usage-panel.git
# 然后把克隆下来的目录用 link 方式挂进 DSH（改代码即时生效）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<克隆目录的绝对路径>
```

Windows 下若 `git clone` 拉不动，先确认 hosts 里没有把 `github.com` 指到 `127.0.0.1` 的残留条目。

## 数据从哪来

| 数据 | 来源 | 口径 |
|---|---|---|
| 每次调用的 token | Host 侧 `session/event` 事件流里的 `assistant/message`，其 `data.usage` 是提供方回报的真实用量 | `inputTokens` 是**未命中缓存的输入**、`cacheReadTokens` 是命中部分，两者不重叠；`outputTokens` 已含 `reasoningTokens`（dsh-token-meter 保证 reasoning ⊆ output，因此不重复计费） |
| 模型与供应商 | 同一事件的 `data.message.source.{provider,model}` | 用于查单价表，最长键优先的子串匹配，未知模型回落 `_default` |
| 计费时点 | 事件的 `time`（调用发生时刻），不是渲染时刻 | 历史账目不会随当前时段漂移 |
| 余额 | Host 服务 `deepseekAccount.getBalance(...)`（官方平台账号服务） | 只读；充值余额与赠送余额分列；定时刷新 + 手动刷新；**API Key 模式下列不出账号余额** |
| 余额实扣 | 插件自己按时间采样的余额观测（同日「首次 − 最近」，只记净减少） | 属于观测值：只在「界面开着且余额可读」时有数据，因此面板把它标注为实扣并允许与表价估算对比，而不是当成账单 |

## 峰谷计价（默认值）

默认规则与单价取自本机已装的 `dsh-whale-widget@0.3.18` 所记录的 DeepSeek 官方口径
（官方 pricing 文档，其 2026-09-19 复核过）：

- **峰时段**：工作日（北京时间）**09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00**
- **谷时段**：其余时段，含**周末全天**与**中国法定节假日全天**
- **峰价 = 谷价 × 2**

| 模型 | 缓存命中 | 未命中输入 | 输出 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deepseek-flash`（V4.1-Flash） | 谷 0.02 / 峰 0.04 | 谷 1 / 峰 2 | 谷 4 / 峰 8 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | 谷 0.15 / 峰 0.30 | 谷 4.5 / 峰 9 | 谷 13.5 / 峰 27 |

单位：**元 / 百万 token**。缓存写入默认按「未命中输入」计价（DeepSeek 官方口径），可在设置里关掉。

单价表、峰时段、节假日、时区偏移都能在**设置页签**里改（JSON 编辑，保存即生效）。
改单价与时段**只影响之后的记账**，已记录的账目不会重算——这样历史数字始终可复现。
`holidays` 默认内置 2026 年法定节假日；次年安排公布后请在设置里补日期。

## 本地文件

| 路径 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `$DSH_HOME/usage-panel/ledger.json` | 账本：逐次调用明细（默认保留 400 天，上限 5 万条）+ 按日聚合（永久保留，热力图不会出现空洞）+ 会话标题/汇总 + 余额快照与观测点 |
| `$DSH_HOME/usage-panel/config.json` | 配置（设置页保存的就是它） |

`$DSH_HOME` 默认是 `~/.dsh`。写盘用「tmp + rename」原子替换，并做 1.5 秒合并写，不会因为高频记账而反复落盘。

## HTTP 路由（排查用）

Host 半注册了 5 条只读为主的 JSON 路由：

| 路由 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `GET /dsh-usage-panel/snapshot.json?sessionId=` | 状态条需要的全部数据（今日/本会话/近 30 天/总计/峰谷状态/余额/配置） |
| `GET /dsh-usage-panel/calls.json?scope=&sessionId=&limit=&offset=` | 逐次调用明细与合计 |
| `GET /dsh-usage-panel/heatmap.json?weeks=` | 按日聚合（含零值填充）与区间合计 |
| `GET/POST /dsh-usage-panel/config.json` | 读 / 改配置 |
| `GET/POST /dsh-usage-panel/balance.json` | 读 / 强制刷新余额 |

这些路由走 DSH 自己的信任栅栏：优先委托 `ctx.connection.requestRejection(req)`（含浏览器会话鉴权）；
宿主栅栏不可用时退回本插件自带的回环 `Host` 校验，非回环来源一律 403（可用环境变量
`DSH_USAGE_PANEL_TRUSTED_HOSTS` 声明额外的可信 authority）。浏览器里打开时带会话 cookie 才会拿到 200。

## 开发

浏览器半是**手写的 `__ModuleLoader__.load` bundle**（不需要 tsdown 构建）：改 `lib/client.js`
后，`dsh-client-hmr` 的 stat 监听会推到 `clientModules.rebuilt()`，页面热重载即可看到效果。
Host 半是零依赖 ESM（只用 node: 内置模块）——第三方插件安装目录解析不到 `@deepseek-ai/*` 依赖，
所以凡是需要 DSH 能力的地方都走 Cordis 服务注入。

```bash
# Host 半 + 计价/峰谷/路由/落盘（假 Cordis root 跑真实 apply）
node test/self-test.mjs

# 浏览器半（迷你 hooks 运行时真渲染四个页签，fetch 换成本地假数据）
node test/client-smoke.mjs

# 对正在运行的 DSH 做只读验证：从活动 graph 取真实 bundle URL 并拉取
node test/verify-live.mjs [http://127.0.0.1:19387]
```

## 已知限制

- **估算 ≠ 账单**：表价估算受缓存命中判定、赠送额度、优惠活动影响；面板把「余额实扣」并列展示供对账，但不替代平台账单。
- **余额只在账号登录模式下可用**：用 API Key 直连时账号服务返回空，面板会显示未登录/不可用。
- **热力图按日 86400000 毫秒推进**：对 UTC+8 无影响；若把时区偏移改成有夏令时的地区，跨 DST 的边界日可能偏一天。
- **节假日表需要人工维护**：默认只含 2026 年。
- **依赖未公开契约**：手写 bundle 依赖 `__ModuleLoader__`、slot props 组成（`t` / `useSession` / `inject(sessionId)`）与 `conversation.composer.dock` 的存在；这些是官方客户端插件的现行契约但不是给第三方的稳定 API，DSH 升级后若失效需要跟着修。
- 子代理 / fork 会话的调用同样计入总量与热力图，会话维度按各自 sessionId 分开。
- 账本只从**安装之后**开始记录；安装前的历史调用不会回填。

## 变更记录

| 版本 | 变更 |
|---|---|
| 0.1.0 | 首版：逐次调用明细、峰谷计价、余额查询、日历热力图，注册进 `conversation.composer.dock`。（0.1.0 的备份留在开发机的本地工作区里，不随仓库发布；需要回退时覆盖回插件目录即可，link 安装无需重装。） |
| 0.2.0 | ① 状态条改 `order:1` + `flex:1 1 auto`，整条排到官方上下文用量环之后（环落在「本次会话」左边），支出在左、余额 / 峰谷 / 明细靠右；② 余额改为**充值 + 赠送**合计（此前只算充值，纯赠送账号会显示 ¥0），悬停给出「充值 / 赠送」拆分；③ 状态条内的 chip 与开关设 `flex:0 0 auto`，空间紧张时换行而不是被压成零宽。 |
| 0.2.1 | ① 收紧一排：间距 8→6px、chip 高 22→20px、内边距 8→7px，「本次会话」→「会话」、「谷价 · 距切换 21h02m」→「谷价 · 21h02m」（完整说明移到悬停提示），小于 1 元的花费去掉末尾 0（¥0.5610 → ¥0.561）；② 状态条改 `flex-wrap:nowrap` + 可收缩 chip（超长省略号），并加**隐形探针 + 密度测量**。 |
| 0.2.2 | 密度策略改为「**三项常驻、只压次要数字**」：0.2.1 会在窄时整块摘掉「今日」「余额」，导致状态条变得太窄；现在会话 / 今日 / 余额在任何宽度都保留，只在放不下时去掉 token 数字。同时探针改为量当前档位（升档无余量、降档需 ≥80px 余量），token 的 M 档小数从 2 位收到 1 位（15.92M → 15.9M）。 |
| 0.2.3 | 峰谷倒计时改为**任何档位都完整显示**（此前最窄档会去掉倒计时）：会话 / 今日 / 余额 / 峰谷倒计时四项常驻，密度只压缩 token 数字。其余不变。 |

## 许可

MIT。默认单价表与峰谷规则来自 `dsh-whale-widget` 记录的 DeepSeek 官方价格口径（仅数据引用，代码独立实现）。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness context usage ring, configurable character thresholds, manual compaction and recoverable history. Targets DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-control

DeepSeek Harness 上下文压缩插件。模型选择器旁显示上下文用量环，点击可查看窗口占用、有效字符、窗口容量、最近压缩和原文，修改阈值或手动压缩。窗口计量采用“已用 53k，共 1M”的简洁显示；字符压缩触发线单独标明。

**首版目标：DSH 0.2.0-rc.2。** 使用该版本原生 Session、TokenMeter、StorageDomain、投影、命令及 UI 插槽。其他版本需重新验证；不要直接将本包视作兼容所有 dsh 版本。

![上下文用量面板](screenshots/dsh-native-context-control-quiet.jpg)

Context usage ring and recoverable compaction for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2. Automatic compaction defaults to **400,000 active characters**, with a configurable threshold and manual control. The compact panel uses quiet native RPC and preserves access to original history. Summaries use the session's model and incur normal model API usage.

## 功能

- 默认有效上下文达到 **400,000 字符**自动压缩，范围 10,000–5,000,000；支持关闭自动压缩、当前会话设置和全局默认。
- 手动压缩；工作进行中排队到安全边界，可取消待执行请求。
- 保留最新用户消息和近期工作；被替换的真实用户要求原文加入检查点，历史修正按时间排序。
- 结构化摘要保留任务、约束、决策、文件变化、验证证据、失败与待办。
- 使用官方持久化压缩事务，保留工具调用配对。失败、取消、输出截断或并发历史变化时不替换原上下文。
- 原始会话事件保留，可通过界面或 `context_control` 工具分页回查；成功的 shell 输出只折叠连续完全重复的长日志，先保存原文，保存失败则保留输出。
- 中英文及 dsh 原生主题；通过 `conversation.input.right` 插槽加载。

这里的字符按 Unicode 码点计数，包含当前消息和工具定义的可见文本；图片字节不计入字符。窗口比例来自 dsh token 投影/估算，与字符触发线分别显示。未知模型容量时不显示虚假的百分比。接近模型窗口上限会提前触发安全压缩，自动关闭时同时关闭该提前触发；上下文溢出恢复另由 `overflowRecoveryEnabled` 控制。

包内声明的可选 peer 由匹配版本的 DSH 宿主提供，不会另装一套 Harness；独立 Node 程序中不能直接运行本插件。

## 安装

从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/sxwer001/dsh-context-control/releases) 下载预构建的 `.tgz` 安装包；使用 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2。也可以直接安装固定版本：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/sxwer001/dsh-context-control/releases/download/v0.1.2/dsh-context-control-0.1.2.tgz
dsh --profile web
```

将 `dsh-context-control-0.1.2.tgz` 通过 dsh 的插件管理安装本地包入口安装，或在支持 CLI 的自定义/web profile 中：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add 'D:\path\dsh-context-control-0.1.2.tgz'
dsh --profile web
```

桌面 profile 由 Electron 管理，可使用桌面内插件管理器，或完整关闭应用后使用安装目录内的官方命令入口：`resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add <包路径>`。不要手动改写其依赖和配置。包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 注册插件。重载后在会话输入区模型选择器旁出现小环。首次操作需已有会话；模型未配置时可以保存设置，摘要需要有效模型路由。

已有 billion-context 或其他压缩插件时，建议先在独立 profile 验证再决定保留哪个自动压缩策略。此包不替换原生 `compaction` 服务；多种自动策略同时启用的先后顺序及收益需实测。

## 使用

点环显示紧凑用量卡片，可直接“立即压缩”。展开“设置与详情”后修改字符阈值 → “应用”保存当前会话；“设为全局默认”供未覆盖设置的会话使用。关闭自动压缩后仍可手动压缩。正在运行的任务显示“在安全边界压缩”。无安全旧历史时保留原上下文并提示。

面板通过原生认证 RPC 静默操作，不产生聊天命令记录；旧版面板留下的 `context-control` 行隐藏显示，原始会话数据仍保留。命令与模型工具共用同一 Host 操作：

```text
/context-control status
/context-control compact
/context-control {"action":"configure","scope":"session","settings":{"triggerChars":600000,"autoEnabled":true}}
/context-control {"action":"cancel"}
/context-control {"action":"history"}
```

工具 `context_control` 接受同样的 JSON；大段原文响应包含 `next`，按它继续请求。只回查当前会话的原文。原文属于历史资料，应依据当前要求解释。

## 技术路线与限制

复用官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic` 的选择/事务实现，仅暴露内部辅助函数，来源版本与哈希在 `vendor/upstream.json`，许可见 `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`。参考 [dsh 官方实现](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)、[dsh-compressor](https://github.com/lifeodyssey/dsh-compressor) 与 [billion-context-dsh](https://github.com/Tyan66666/billion-context-dsh) 的分层记忆思路；本包不捆绑这些第三方项目的代码。

摘要默认调用会话最近请求的模型，可在 Host 配置中指定 `summarizationProvider` 和 `summarizationModel`（必须成对设置）。尽量复用真实请求前缀以利用缓存。原始用户要求超过 64,000 字符时拒绝替换，以免保护内容反而使摘要膨胀。

摘要属于有损压缩，原文可回查及明确要求保留降低丢失风险，**不能保证模型后续工作完全不受影响**。累计费用取决于缓存命中、摘要费用及后续轮数；上下文变短不等于已证明账单下降。自动化验证使用脚本模型，另外已完成下述真实模型会话验证，没有宣称真实节省比例。

## 开发与验证

需要 Node ≥22.19；本地验证使用 Node 24 和已安装的 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2。

```powershell
node scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs 'D:\deepseekharness\resources\app.asar' --include-cli
npm run check
npm test
npm pack
```

脚本只读取安装包，将运行依赖复制到任务目录 `.test-runtime`，不会修改 dsh 安装或用户 profile。测试使用真实 Session、投影、计量、StorageDomain/JSON 存储和原生压缩事务；模型流及命令/工具注册服务由本地脚本提供。覆盖字符计数、设置、事务失败回退、取消、并发、原文恢复、摘要继承和工具调用配对。真实模型的工作连续性和费用收益仍需对照评测。

2026-10-12 本地验证：21 项自动化检查通过；安装包已在独立 dsh web profile 加载，用量环位置、详情、自定义阈值保存、重启后设置恢复、无历史手动压缩提示与非法阈值拒绝均已通过界面检查。0.1.1 将默认卡片收紧到约 264 × 182 像素，设置与原文回查折叠显示；0.1.2 将面板查询改为静默原生 RPC，显示简洁窗口数字，并给设置展开/收起加入 200ms 原生高度过渡，尊重系统减少动画设置。验证了重复开关面板不新增聊天命令事件，RPC 手动压缩及原文恢复仍正常。

随后已通过官方命令入口安装到用户的 desktop profile，并创建实际测试会话“上下文压缩插件实际测试 2026-10-12”。使用当前 `opencode-go / deepseek-v4.1-flash` 模型读取生成的公开测试数据：手动命令压缩从 124,481 字符降至 103,328 字符，原文回查成功；自动压缩在临时的 126,197 字符触发线上执行。两次压缩后的真实模型回答均准确保留测试标记和构建约束。测试会话的近期保留预算临时设为 1,000 token / 2 条消息，结束后已恢复原设置及 400,000 字符触发线；全局默认未改变。本次未对真实工作任务的质量或账单节省比例作普遍性结论。结果保存在本地 `.test-state/live-result.json`。

开发遵循用户指定的 Ponytail full 模式：原生能力优先，不新增运行依赖和架构层；必要的数据恢复与边界验证保留。

plugins.description: SiYuan integration for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-siyuan

思源笔记的 DSH 插件：检索笔记、创建与修改内容，多核心连接配置、逐端点授权和会话活动记录。提供五个基础工具，并可将 697 条 HTTP 契约按用途整理为 663 个工具，与发现的 MCP 工具一起注册到工具箱，按会话选择开启。

**0.3.2** 修复 `.well-known` 等路径分组的 ID 含非法字符而导致整批注册失败的问题，分组标题保留原始路径名称。HTTP 工具按路径末段命名，例如 `siyuan_sql`、`siyuan_getBlockInfo`；父路径用于分组，只有重名时才进入工具名。同路径、同处理函数的多种方法合并，优先 POST；不同用途的处理函数分别保留。工具名移除摘要 ID 与 HTTP 方法前缀。升级后需在工具箱重新开启新名字及分组，已有思源端点授权保持不变。

## 连接与凭据

插件加载后，从插件市场附近的思源图标进入主面板。核心连接页支持添加、编辑、停用和删除核心，设置默认核心，检查连接。右侧「思源活动」页可以为当前会话选择核心。调用时的目标顺序为工具参数 `kernelId`、会话选择、明确配置的默认核心；找不到目标或目标失效时拒绝，不挑另一核心。

每个核心可以配置本机 `auto` 或明确的 HTTP(S) 地址、超时、可选端口登记文件与 PID。远程地址支持代理路径前缀，禁止 URL 凭据、查询和片段。自动模式读取思源维护的账户主目录 `.config/siyuan/port.json`，不扫描端口。进入思源连接管理界面、首次工具调用或首次授权时自动检查并绑定唯一实例的 PID；多实例需要人工填写 PID。已绑定实例退出后需要在管理界面重新选择。首次绑定会清除旧版未绑定配置的授权；更换地址、PID 或登记文件也会撤销该核心的旧授权，新的授权在绑定后保存。

API token 只由人工在密码框写入 DSH 的本机 `credentials` 服务，持久配置与活动记录不保存 token 值。凭据的存储与保护由 DSH 负责；本插件负责人工只写、宿主取用及模型输出过滤，不另建凭据存储层。编辑时只显示已配置状态，不回填原值；留空保留，填写新值替换，也可明确清除。工具参数不接受 token 或认证头，宿主向固定核心注入 `Authorization: Token ...`，不转发到重定向地址。

所有核心的已配置凭据共用输出过滤：CRUD、HTTP、插件 RPC、MCP、WS、管理返回和错误都经过安全投影，覆盖原值、JSON 字符串、URL 编码、base64/hex 及含凭据的整体编码响应。过滤依据是凭据服务登记的实际值，字段名不决定是否遮罩，审批数组、token 计数和凭据状态保持原有类型。MCP `tools/call` 的 `content` 与 `prompts/get` 的消息内容中，图片和音频字节只保留说明；`structuredContent` 等业务对象按普通数据处理。错误不转发原始异常对象、stack、cause 或请求配置。过滤作用于本插件的返回接口；本机文件访问和浏览器权限由宿主管理。

DSH 需要提供 `tools`、`storageDomain` 和 `credentials` 服务；两种询问策略使用 `sandboxPolicy` 读取会话模式，并在普通权限下使用 `approval` 请求批准。管理路由通过 `connection.requestRejection` 统一校验来源和身份，兼容 Web 与桌面端；变更请求使用 JSON。持久化或凭据服务不可用时失败关闭，不降级为允许。旧组合里的非空 `token` 在首次初始化时导入 credentials；应由人工清除旧组合中的明文配置，不要将其内容发送到会话。

## 端点授权

端点页提供 697 条来自思源 v3.8.6 的 HTTP 契约，支持按核心、协议、方法、授权状态筛选，搜索路径、方法、工具名和说明，并分页。MCP 工具通过人工点击「发现 MCP 工具」获取，仅进入该核心目录，不获得权限。扩展 HTTP、插件 RPC、MCP 方法和 WS 操作可人工声明入目录。

每个端点可单独设置以下四种权限，并确认具体核心与端点：

| 配置 | 普通权限下 | 完全权限下 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 每次询问，完全权限下拒绝（默认，`ask`） | 请求宿主批准 | 自动拒绝 |
| 每次询问，完全权限下授权（`ask-full-access`） | 请求宿主批准 | 自动通过 |
| 拒绝（`deny`） | 拒绝 | 拒绝 |
| 允许（`allow`） | 直接通过 | 直接通过 |

未配置、首次发现、重新绑定或声明的新端点默认使用 `ask`。升级保留已经显式保存的 `deny`、`ask` 和 `allow`。完全权限按宿主 `sandboxPolicy` 返回的实际会话模式判断；询问通过 `approval.request()` 请求一次性批准。无会话、无法取得模式或需要询问但审批不可用时停止执行；宿主 `never` 策略自动拒绝询问。批准期间配置改变也会停止派发。活动栏记录选定的端点配置，并区分完全权限自动拒绝、完全权限自动通过、直接允许、宿主批准、拒绝、取消和审批不可用。

授权键分别为：

- HTTP：方法与契约路径；未知路径使用具体路径。四个 CRUD 与同路径的原始 HTTP 共用授权。
- MCP：方法；`tools/call` 还需具体工具名的独立授权。
- 插件 RPC：插件名与方法；批量调用另需 `$batch`，且先检查所有内部方法。
- WS：连接路径的 `connect`，发送操作另需该路径与具体 JSON `cmd` 的 `send` 权限。
- 连接状态：`connection/status`。PID 切换只在人工配置页完成。

原始 HTTP 的 MCP、插件 RPC 和 WS 包裹路径不能代替具体方法授权。代理、事务等尚未解析内部效果的委托接口本阶段不开放。WS 二进制发送和无 `cmd` 的不透明消息不开放。编码或折叠等有歧义的端点路径拒绝执行。

本阶段是端点授权：允许覆盖该端点的全部可操作资源。文档、笔记本、文件路径等资源范围授权，以及内容来源、差异追踪和思源侧徽标尚未实现。

## 会话记录

右侧「思源活动」显示当前会话的实际调用：时间、核心、具体端点、callId、operationId、解析出的文档或块 ID、耗时与结果。可过滤当前页、分页和刷新，核心选择与记录由宿主持久化。点击会话中的思源工具卡片打开右侧「思源活动」，参数与结果通过卡片上的独立按钮展开。侧栏「定位工具调用」切回聊天视图，自动加载目标历史、从外向内展开折叠组，并滚动到精确的工具调用卡片；PTC 子调用会连同根调用一起加载。定位期间显示等待状态；切换会话、发起新定位或卸载会取消旧定位。点击「思源连接管理界面」打开管理面板。

操作意图先持久化，再派发业务请求；不保存笔记正文或凭据。成功、失败、拒绝、已发送与结果不确定分别显示。通知和 WS 发送完成不等于内容效果已确认；网络中断后的写入不自动重发。已执行但结算记录失败时，工具结果明确提示勿重复写入。重载打断的运行记录标为结果不确定。旧版将审批明细错误替换为 `[redacted]` 的活动记录在加载时恢复为可读取结构，并标明明细已丢失；原调用结果和已有错误说明保留。

只有本机明确目标的资源 ID 才提供 `siyuan://blocks/...` 快速打开；远程核心只显示 ID，避免在本机打开另一个库的同名资源。没有解析出位置时如实显示未知，不推断完整影响范围。

## 工具箱协同

安装 [dsh-tool-gateway v0.3.0 或更新版](https://github.com/leolee9086/dsh-tool-gateway)，在思源管理界面点击「注册全部 HTTP / MCP 工具」。管理界面显示可注册的 HTTP 工具数、MCP 工具数和实际注册数；HTTP 按父路径分为「思源 · block」「思源 · notebook」「思源 · query」等组，MCP 按核心分组。新组默认关闭，到右侧工具箱选择要在当前会话开启的工具或工具组。

工具箱开关决定当前会话能否使用工具；思源端点授权决定具体核心是否允许执行。注册与开启都不会自动授予端点权限。MCP 调用仍分别检查 `tools/call` 与具体工具名。697 条 HTTP 契约按路径与处理函数合并为 663 个工具：同用途方法优先 POST，其次 GET；`rpc` 等不同处理函数分别保留。其他方法仍可通过基础工具 `siyuan_rpc` 调用，执行原有端点授权与调用限制。

- HTTP 工具以 `siyuan_` 加路径末段命名，例如 `siyuan_sql`；重名才增加父路径，例如 `siyuan_setting_setSnippet` 和 `siyuan_snippet_setSnippet`。动态路径及同路径的不同用途用处理函数名区分。说明保留实际方法与完整路径，可按接口路径搜索。参数 `body` 使用原始请求 schema 及完整 `$defs`，支持 `query`、动态路由的 `pathParams` 和业务 `headers`。`kernelId` 可显式指定核心，省略时使用会话选择或默认核心。
- MCP 工具直接使用发现的完整 `inputSchema`，参数就是该工具的原参数，固定调用发现它的核心。名称为 `siyuan_mcp_<核心ID>_<工具名>`，使不同核心的同名工具可区分；旧版目录缺少 schema 的记录会提示重新发现。
- 新目录注册后，重新发现 MCP 会新增、更新或撤回对应工具。核心改名更新组标题，更换地址或删除核心会撤回该核心的 MCP 目录。注册选择保存到本机，重启后自动恢复；网关卸载时撤回扩展工具，重新连接后恢复。
- 「撤回扩展工具」撤回 HTTP / MCP 注册并保存这一选择，五个基础工具继续可用。网关缺席时也可使用基础工具。

例如，搜索 `/api/query/sql` 的 HTTP 工具后，参数为：

```json
{"body":{"stmt":"SELECT id, content FROM blocks WHERE type = 'd' LIMIT 10"},"kernelId":"local"}
```

HTTP 原始字节请求的 `body` 使用 base64。表单文件的名称填入 `body` 的对应契约字段，内容放入 `files`；`/api/file/putFile` 示例：

```json
{"body":{"path":"/data/example.txt","file":"example.txt"},"files":[{"field":"file","name":"example.txt","base64":"aGk=","mimeType":"text/plain"}]}
```

工具名保持稳定，普通授权修改和再次同步不会重建未变化的工具，也不会覆盖工具箱保存的会话开关。HTTP / MCP 扩展调用同样在「思源活动」中记录实际生成工具名，可通过 callId 定位来源调用。

## 五个基础工具

| 工具 | action / channel | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `siyuan_query` | notebooks、docs、search、sql、read、children | 笔记本、文档、全文搜索、SQL、块内容与子块 |
| `siyuan_create` | doc、block、append | 创建 Markdown 文档、插块、追加 |
| `siyuan_update` | block、rename_doc | 整块替换、改文档标题 |
| `siyuan_delete` | block、doc | 删除块或文档 |
| `siyuan_rpc` | http、contract、plugin、mcp、ws、connection | 通用连接操作与离线契约发现 |

每个工具可附带 `kernelId`。`contract` 可离线发现契约和配置核心 ID，不连接内核，也不获得执行授权。示例中的 ID 需要替换为真实目标。

```json
{"action":"notebooks","kernelId":"local"}
{"action":"docs","notebook":"20261011180000-abcdefg","limit":64,"offset":0}
{"action":"read","id":"20261011180001-abcdefg"}
{"action":"doc","notebook":"20261011180000-abcdefg","path":"/验收","markdown":"# 验收\n"}
{"action":"append","parentID":"20261011180001-abcdefg","data":"正文\n"}
{"action":"block","id":"20261011180002-abcdefg","data":"替换内容\n"}
{"action":"rename_doc","id":"20261011180001-abcdefg","title":"新标题"}
```

创建文档返回 `docId`，插块、追加和更新返回 `blockIds`，并以 `blockIdScope: "transaction-operations"` 标明这些是内核事务操作 ID。一段 Markdown 可生成多个块而只返回一个操作 ID；ID 数量不是写入块数。写入成功与否依据内核响应。内容空白保留，更新接受空字符串。插块至少需要 `nextID`、`previousID` 或 `parentID`；追加需要 `parentID`。CRUD 检查 HTTP 与内核 `{code,msg,data}` 信封，索引或同步可能稍后更新，不因查询暂时无结果重发写入。

```json
{"channel":"contract","path":"/api/block/","limit":20,"includeSchema":true}
{"channel":"http","path":"/api/block/getBlockKramdown","method":"POST","body":{"id":"20261011180001-abcdefg"},"validate":true}
{"channel":"plugin","plugin":"my-plugin","method":"example.echo","params":{"text":"你好"}}
{"channel":"mcp","method":"tools/list"}
{"channel":"mcp","method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"实际发现的工具名","arguments":{}}}
{"channel":"ws","path":"/ws?app=my-app&id=my-session&type=main","messages":[],"durationMs":1000,"maxMessages":20}
{"channel":"connection","action":"status"}
```

HTTP 支持 JSON、text、base64、form、multipart 请求与文件上传，保留状态、响应头和信封，默认响应上限16MiB。`validate` 仅校验已知契约；未收录路径按具体方法与路径请求批准，也可在管理界面声明后设置权限。MCP 使用官方 SDK 1.32.1，协议上限2025-11-25。每个调用结束后释放临时 WS、RPC、MCP 连接。

## 公共服务与独立连接库

共享服务 `siyuan` 只提供经过授权和凭据投影的 `invoke(toolName, arguments, execution?)`：

```js
export const inject = ["siyuan"];
export async function apply(ctx) {
  const service = ctx.get("siyuan");
  const result = await service.invoke("siyuan_query", { action: "notebooks", kernelId: "local" });
  // 公共服务调用也需要端点授权；无 agent 时两种询问策略均拒绝执行。
}
```

`execution` 来自真实 DSH 工具执行上下文，用于关联会话、callId、取消与批准；模型工具不接收自填会话身份。公共服务不发布带 token 的 config、裸 HTTP/WS/RPC、SDK client 或流。

`import { SiYuanConnection } from "dsh-plugin-siyuan/connection"` 仍可用于独立传输库：完整 HTTP、WS、JSON-RPC、MCP 和流由调用者管理，最终 `await connection.dispose()`。独立库的权限策略和原始响应过滤由调用者负责；需要宿主端点授权与凭据过滤时，使用共享受控服务。

## 安装与开发

需要 Node.js >=22.19.0，包管理器 pnpm。宿主安装补丁不包含 token：

```yaml
- id: dsh-plugin-siyuan
  name: dsh-plugin-siyuan
  config:
    apiUrl: auto
    timeoutMs: 15000
```

在 DSH 插件市场中使用以下 GitHub 来源安装或升级：

```text
https://github.com/leolee9086/dsh-plugin-siyuan#v0.3.2
```

客户端通过 `./client` 和 `dsh.client` 声明加载。构建将官方思源 SVG 嵌入客户端，与宿主 JS、类型声明、契约一起放入 `lib/`。

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check
node scripts/gen-contract.mjs /path/to/siyuan/kernel/apicontract/schema.json 3.8.6
```

`test:behavior` 运行 42 项独立行为测试，`test:protocol` 运行 26 项协议与工具行为测试；后者使用隔离 HTTP/WS/MCP 夹具，覆盖扩展工具从注册、授权到实际调用和活动记录的完整链路。详细范围见 [测试说明](./tests/README.md)。`release:pack` 执行检查并生成安装包；开发代码见 [main 分支](https://github.com/leolee9086/dsh-plugin-siyuan/tree/main)。

plugins.readme_text:
# 提示词润色 · dsh-plugin-prompt-polish

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的提示词输入框加一个**润色按钮**：写好草稿后点一下，模型把它改写成更清晰、更完整的提示词，直接替换回输入框。润色用的提示词（system prompt）**随时可以自己改**，不写死。

```
┌─ 输入框 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 帮我弄个插件 加个按钮 润色                                  │
│                                                            │
│                [ ✨润色 ] [ ↻撤销 ] [ ⚙设置 ]   [模型] [发送] │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 功能

| 操作 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 点 **✨ 润色** | 把当前草稿交给模型改写，成功后整段替换回输入框 |
| 点 **↻ 撤销** | 把润色前的原文写回去（只在草稿没被你再改过时出现） |
| 点 **⚙ 设置** | 打开设置面板，修改「润色用的提示词」，可一键恢复默认 |
| 输入框为空 | 按钮置灰 |
| 正在提交 | 按钮置灰 |
| 润色中 | 图标转圈，按钮禁用 |

润色是**一次性补全**：借用你当前的默认模型，但不会写进任何会话历史，所以不污染上下文，也不影响 KV 缓存。

真实效果示例：

> 输入：`帮我弄个插件，在输入框那加个按钮，点了能润色我写的东西，还要能改润色用的提示词`
>
> 输出：
> ```
> 帮我实现一个插件，在输入框那里加一个按钮。
>
> **目标**
> 1. 在输入框区域添加一个按钮。
> 2. 点击该按钮后，对我在输入框里写的内容进行润色。
> 3. 润色所用的提示词要可以修改，我需要能自己改。
>
> **验收标准**
> - 输入框处能看到并点击这个按钮。
> - 点击后能对我输入的内容执行润色。
> - 能修改润色使用的提示词，并且改完之后生效。
> ```

## 安装

### 方式一：从插件界面安装（推荐）

1. 打开 **设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**
2. 填入仓库地址：`https://github.com/imlida/dsh-plugin-prompt-polish`
3. 安装 → 启用 → **重启 DSH**

### 方式二：命令行手动安装

```bash
# 1) 装进目标 profile（profile 名以你自己的为准，例如 desktop / web）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/imlida/dsh-plugin-prompt-polish

# 2) 让这个包的分层生效：把它加进 profile 的 dsh.profile.bundles
#    编辑 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json → dsh.profile.bundles 追加：
#    "dsh-plugin-prompt-polish"
```

> `dsh plugin add` 只是 pnpm 的薄包装，**不会**替你改 `dsh.profile.bundles`，第 2 步必须手动做。

### 方式三：从本地目录安装（开发用）

在插件界面里直接填本机目录的绝对路径，或：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/path/to/dsh-plugin-prompt-polish
```

> **装完必须重启一次 DSH。**
> 原因是 DSH 的插件加载器对已经导入过的模块会命中 Node 的 ESM 缓存：在运行中开关插件条目**不会**重新导入改动后的代码（实测如此）。重启后输入框右下角就会出现按钮。

卸载：在「设置 → 插件」里关掉或卸载，或删掉 profile `package.json` 里的依赖与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 条目。

## 修改润色提示词

点输入框右下角的 **⚙**，直接编辑保存；想还原就点「恢复默认」。

也可以直接改文件（改完立即生效，不需要重启）：

```
$DSH_HOME/plugin-data/prompt-polish/settings.json     # {"prompt": "……"}
$DSH_HOME/plugin-data/prompt-polish/status.json       # 加载自检 / 报错记录
```

`$DSH_HOME` 默认是 `~/.dsh`，也可以用环境变量 `DSH_HOME` 或 `DSH_PROMPT_POLISH_SETTINGS` 指定。
删掉 `settings.json` 就回到内置默认提示词。

内置默认提示词要求模型：只输出润色结果、不执行任务、保持原意与语言、逐字保留 `@文件引用`/代码/命令/路径/URL、补全结构但不臆造事实。

## 可选：换模型或调参数

默认跟随你的默认模型。想让润色更快，可以在 profile 补丁（`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`）里覆盖：

```yaml
- id: prompt-polish
  config:
    provider: deepseek-account
    model: deepseek-flash
    reasoningEffort: low     # 不填则用该模型默认档位
    temperature: 0.3         # 默认 0.3
    maxTokens: 2048          # 默认 2048
```

## 工作原理

```
浏览器半 lib/client.js                      Host 半 lib/host.mjs
┌──────────────────────────┐               ┌────────────────────────────────┐
│ conversation.input.right │  HTTP POST    │ /dsh-prompt-polish/<endpoint>  │
│  ✨ / ↻ / ⚙ 三个按钮       │ ───────────▶  │  connection.admit() 鉴权        │
│  useInput 读草稿          │               │  ctx.llm.stream() 调模型        │
│  setDraft 写回草稿        │ ◀─────────── │  设置读写 JSON 文件              │
└──────────────────────────┘  信封响应      └────────────────────────────────┘
```

- **Host 半**在本机 HTTP 服务上挂一条 `/dsh-prompt-polish` 前缀路由，端点：`polish` / `getSettings` / `saveSettings` / `resetSettings`。线路协议与 DSH 通用 RPC 完全一致（`client-request` / `server-response` 信封），因此浏览器半直接复用 `ctx.connection.rpc.call()`，**无需任何代码生成**。文件只依赖 Node 内置模块，从任意本地目录加载都不需要 node_modules。
- **浏览器半**注册到 `conversation.input.right` 槽位，只依赖 DSH 的**平台种子模块**（`react`、`react/jsx-runtime`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`），所以是自包含的手写产物，不需要打包工具。草稿通过槽位自动注入的 `useInput` 读、`inputActions.setDraft` 写；写回前用 `draftRev` 做一次 CAS，避免覆盖你在等待期间的编辑。

### 两个实现要点（踩过的坑）

1. **`ctx.effect` 的回调必须返回 disposer 函数。** 返回 Promise 会被 Cordis 判为非法并回滚整个作用域，已经注册好的路由会静默消失。
2. **没有使用 `ctx.connection.rpc.handle()`。** 在 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 上这条 API 实际不可用：它内部用 owner 作用域去取 `webServer`，会抛 `cannot get property "webServer" without inject`，而 `handle()` 本身不报错、路由也不会出现（全仓库没有任何官方调用者）。因此这里改用公开且可用的 `webServer.register()` 挂路由 + `connection.admit()` 做鉴权，行为与官方通道一致。

## 开发

```bash
git clone https://github.com/imlida/dsh-plugin-prompt-polish
cd dsh-plugin-prompt-polish
npm test
```

**28 项测试，不需要启动 DSH**（`node:test`，零依赖）：

- **Host 半**：装配契约（依赖注入、路由形状、disposer 契约）、HTTP 层（404 / 401 / 415 / 信封不匹配）、设置端点往返、润色端点（提示词拼装、代码块围栏清理、分片拼接、`finish=error`、抛错包装、空草稿短路）。
- **浏览器半**：用自制的微型 React hook 运行时把组件真跑起来，从元素树里找到按钮并**触发点击**，断言「结果写回草稿」「空草稿只提示不调用」「润色期间草稿被改过则不覆盖（draftRev CAS）」「失败走 error 提示通道」「撤销写回原文」「提交中禁用」「图标用的是星形闪光」。

```
dsh-plugin-prompt-polish/
├── package.json          # 双半声明：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 组合层：把 Host 半作为一个 entry 插入 profile
├── icon.svg              # 插件卡片图标
├── locale/{zh,en}.json   # 插件卡片标题 / 描述
├── lib/host.mjs          # Host 半：HTTP 通道 + 调模型 + 读写设置
├── lib/client.js         # 浏览器半：输入框按钮 + 设置面板
└── test/                 # 单元测试
```

## 已知限制

- 草稿里如果带 `@文件` 引用芯片，整段替换会丢失芯片（LLM 改写本来也会破坏引用语义）；如果担心，先复制一份原文。
- 润色质量取决于「润色提示词」和所用模型；`reasoningEffort` 默认跟随模型档位，想更快可在配置里指定 `low`。
- 一次润色 = 一次模型调用，会消耗你自己的用量。
- 插件安装后 DSH 暂不支持自动更新，升级请先卸载再装新版。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-bgame

DSH Web 小游戏插件。包含德州扑克、21 点、五子棋和 UNO，可与电脑或已配置的模型对战。当前版本为 `0.4.0`。

## 安装

需要 Node.js 24 或以上，以及已经初始化 Web profile 的 DeepSeek Harness。当前验证版本为 DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`。

### 快速安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Kiteluo/dsh-bgame
```

安装后启动 DSH Web 或刷新已运行的页面，在左侧导航和插件列表中打开 **dsh-bgame**。该命令使用当前 `DSH_HOME` 下的 Web profile。

### 从源码安装

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Kiteluo/dsh-bgame.git
cd dsh-bgame
npm install
node install.mjs
```

安装器使用 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web`，未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时默认使用 `~/.dsh/profiles/web`。在本地 DSH 工作区的 `plugins/` 目录下运行时，也会识别该工作区已有的 `.dsh/profiles/web`。可显式指定 profile：

```sh
node install.mjs --profile /path/to/.dsh/profiles/web
```

安装器登记本地 link 依赖和插件 bundle，同步已有 pnpm 锁文件，备份修改前的配置，并迁移旧名称 `dsh-arcade`。重复执行不会重复登记。插件源码目录需要保留，目录链接会指向它。

首次安装后启动 DSH Web；已在运行的服务会热加载插件配置。刷新网页，左侧导航和「插件 → 已安装」中均显示 **dsh-bgame**，插件详情提供「打开游戏大厅」。

## 使用

- **电脑对手**：简单、普通、困难三档，本地运行，不调用模型。简单偏随机；普通采用基础规则策略；困难五子棋检查获胜、阻挡和双重威胁，德扑用公开信息抽样估算胜率，UNO 在对手手牌较少时优先阻止其出牌。21 点庄家固定在 17 点停牌，不受难度影响。
- **模型对手**：使用 DSH 中已配置的模型服务，消耗该模型的调用额度。模型只能看到自己的手牌和公开信息，程序验证其走法。
- **暂停 / 回到工作**：取消当前游戏请求并保存进度，不向工作会话插入消息。
- **自动存档**：每款游戏保存一局，重新打开可继续；电脑难度、模型出招方式和失败处理选项也会保存。旧版 `dsh-arcade` 的浏览器存档会自动读取；清除站点数据会删除存档。

模型提供两种出招方式：

| 方式 | 思考档位 | 输出上限 | 等待上限 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 快速出招 | 优先关闭思考；无法关闭时使用较低档位 | 8192 token | 60 秒 |
| 认真思考 | 使用模型支持的中等或较高档位 | 16384 token | 90 秒 |

认真思考可能增加等待时间和调用费用；无推理档位的模型仍按服务默认运行，出招后显示实际档位。失败时默认停在当前回合，提供「重试模型」「电脑代打本步」；也可选择「电脑自动接手」。代打按所选电脑难度执行，只替代当前一步，下一次仍由模型行动。模型返回完整合法的 JSON 走法后，即使结束标记为输出额度用尽，也会保留它的选择。

对局页显示当前回合、已走步数、上一手动作；模型思考期间显示实时等待时间。德扑额外显示底池、本轮最高下注、双方本轮下注及你需要跟注的金额。暂停、返回大厅或切换设置会取消旧请求，旧回复不会重复落子。

## 游戏规则

| 游戏 | 范围 |
| --- | --- |
| 德州扑克 | 双人无限注，盲注 10/20，完整四轮下注及最佳五张牌比较；按有效筹码限制下注，不设边池 |
| 21 点 | 庄家含软 17 停牌，天然 21 点赔 3:2，可加倍；不含分牌与保险 |
| 五子棋 | 15×15 自由五子棋，黑先，无禁手，连续五子或以上获胜 |
| UNO | 108 张牌，双人局，跳过/反转/+2/+4/换色；不叠罚牌、不设质疑，自动喊 UNO |

德扑与 21 点使用虚拟筹码，每局重新分配。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE) · Copyright (c) 2026 Kiteluo

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: show the Ollama Cloud credit balance and recent usage as a Settings section, with an in-page API key editor.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ollama-quota

DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows the **Ollama Cloud credit balance** as a Settings section
(id `ollama-quota`, order `-9`, directly below the shipped Account entry) and lets you enter
or replace the Ollama Cloud API key on that same page.

Ollama moved the account to a credit model: `GET https://ollama.com/api/usage` no longer
carries the old `limits.session` / `limits.weekly` windows (it answers a
`range`/`totals`/`buckets` report instead), so readers built on that shape fail with
**"Could not parse the response · no limits object"**. The remaining credit now comes from
`GET https://ollama.com/api/balance`, which is what this plugin reads.

## Data sources

| Endpoint | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `GET https://ollama.com/api/balance` | primary: `included.balance_usd`, `included.allowance_usd`, `included.period`, `purchased.balance_usd` |
| `GET https://ollama.com/api/usage?range=24h\|7d\|30d` | advisory: `totals` (cost, requests, tokens) and daily `buckets` |

Both take `Authorization: Bearer <Ollama Cloud key>`. A failure on the usage report never
hides a healthy balance; it renders as an inline note inside the usage card. The usage report
is re-read on its own slower interval (`usageRefreshMs`) because its wide window barely moves.

## What it shows

| Row | Source |
| --- | --- |
| Remaining included credit | `included.balance_usd` of `included.allowance_usd` |
| Used share bar | `allowance - balance` over `allowance` |
| Purchased credit | `purchased.balance_usd` |
| Allowance period | `included.period.from` → `included.period.until` |
| Spend, requests, input/cached/output tokens | `usage.totals` over `usageRange` |
| Daily spend strip | `usage.buckets[].usage_usd` (max 31 buckets) |
| Off-peak state and countdown | computed from the browser clock: peak pricing runs weekdays 12:00–18:00 UTC, everything else is off-peak |
| Key source | which credential reference resolved |
| API key editor | `remote.credentials.describe(refs)` / `set(ref, value)` / `unset(ref)` over the DSH Remote (`remote.credentials` is a declared inject edge) |

Per-model request counts are not shown: the endpoint stopped reporting them.

### Sidebar widget

The plugin also registers `sidebar.footer.action`, the list slot that stacks above the shipped
Settings entry. That widget is visible at all times, not only while Settings is open, and shows:

- remaining credit and the 30-day spend,
- whether off-peak pricing applies right now, with the current local time,
- the countdown to the next boundary at minute granularity (off-peak start while peak, off-peak
  end while off-peak),
- a 24h strip on the **browser's local clock** with the peak window charted onto it. JST turns
  12:00–18:00 UTC into 21:00–03:00, so the band splits across local midnight; the ticks are local
  hours and the strip caption is the local time.

The collapsed 56px rail keeps the credit and a compact `H:MM` countdown.

Ollama applies off-peak pricing outside 12:00–18:00 UTC on weekdays and all day at weekends, so
the peak window is the only interval whose end is a peak start.

The Settings section carries the same state as an additional card with the full rule text, the
local peak window, the current local time, and both countdowns.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/okku000/dsh-ollama-quota.git
```

While developing against a checkout, link the directory instead so edits are live:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-ollama-quota
```

A Host change needs an application restart; the Client half needs a page refresh.

## Configuration

The row reads these fields, all optional (`cordis.patch.yml`):

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `keyEnvs` | `[OLLAMA_CLOUD_API_KEY, OLLAMA_API_KEY]` | credential references tried in order; the first is what the editor writes |
| `apiBase` | `https://ollama.com` | API origin |
| `usageRange` | `30d` | usage window, one of `24h`, `7d`, `30d` |
| `refreshMs` | `60000` | balance refresh interval, minimum `5000` |
| `usageRefreshMs` | `300000` | usage-report interval, minimum `60000`; `?force=1` or a new key re-reads it |
| `timeoutMs` | `15000` | per-request timeout |

The Host half serves `GET /ollama-quota/snapshot` (add `?force=1` to refresh first). The
snapshot carries dollar amounts, counts, timestamps, error labels, and the credential
reference order — never the key.

## Verify

```sh
node scripts/verify.mjs          # offline: fake Host context and fake browser runtime
node scripts/verify.mjs --live   # also drives the real endpoints with the stored key
```

`--live` reads `OLLAMA_CLOUD_API_KEY` from `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: Delete button for archived DeepSeek Harness sessions: removes a Session's log, its Workspace membership and its archive mark — with a deferred mode for Sessions the Host still holds.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-archive-purge — a delete button for archived DSH sessions

DeepSeek Harness can archive a Session but has never been able to delete one. This
workspace contains a working plugin that adds that verb, plus the research and test
harnesses that established how to do it safely against a live Harness.

**Status: installed and verified on this machine** (`desktop` profile, GUI at
`http://127.0.0.1:19387`).

| | |
|---|---|
| Host entry | live Loader row `archive-purge-<revision>` → `fiberPhase: active` |
| Menu row | `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` → `archive-purge.delete`, order 500 (after Archive 400) → `active` |
| Hover button | `sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action` → `archive-purge.delete`, order 300 (after Archive 100, Pin 200) → `active` |
| Route | `POST /api/archive-purge/deleteSession` → authenticated, all probes green |
| Patch row | `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`, marker-delimited block, timestamped backup kept |

## First real use, and what it exposed

The first click on a real archived Session — its title is withheld here — was refused with
`archive-purge/session-live`. The diagnosis was worth the detour:

- the Session was still **loaded** by the Host (idle, not running) because it had just been
  open — and a loaded Session stays loaded for the Host's whole lifetime. Measured:
  `tools/watch-liveness.mjs` polled for six minutes and the loaded set never changed;
- it **cannot be unloaded** from a plugin: `ctx.sessions.enter()` throws for an id already in
  the store, the Client's release never reaches the Host, and the Agent's registration
  belongs to a Cordis effect inside the `agents` service;
- deleting the log anyway was not an option either: `sessionQuery.listSessions()` is the
  union of the in-memory store and the persisted headers, so the row would have come
  back — unopenable.

So the plugin grew a **deferred mode**: a loaded Session's purge is staged (history
untouched; the archive mark kept as both the authorization and the cancel switch) and
finished automatically at the next Host start, when nothing is loaded. The dialog says so in
both languages — and that is exactly how the Session above was eventually removed.

Two smaller truths came out of the same detour, both now encoded in the plugin: the desktop
Host does **not** export `DSH_HOME` to its own process, and a `!!js dshHomePath(...)` Loader
row keeps an *unevaluated* `{"__jsExpr": …}` marker — so the Harness home is derived from the
persistence layer's own located paths instead.

## How to use it

To see the buttons on an archived Session:

1. switch the sidebar's view filter to **仅显示已归档 / Archived only** (or 全部对话);
2. hover the archived row and click the **trash icon**, or open its `...` menu and choose
   **删除会话 / Delete session**;
3. confirm in the dialog. A Session the Host has released disappears immediately (the Host
   pushes `api-session/removed`) with its log directory; a Session the Host still holds is
   **staged** and removed automatically at the next start, and the dialog says exactly that.

If the buttons do not appear, reload the page once (Ctrl+R). The Host half needed no
restart: the profile is a live-patch profile and the entry is already `active`.

A staged purge is recorded in `$DSH_HOME/archive-purge/pending.json`, and the deferred run
at the next start empties that file again. Unarchiving a Session before then cancels its
staged purge. To stage one from a shell instead, `node tools/purge.mjs <sessionId>`; to see
what is currently staged, read that JSON file.

## Layout

| path | what it is |
|---|---|
| `plugin/` | the plugin: `index.js` (Host half), `lib/client.js` (hand-written browser bundle), `package.json`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `README.md` |
| `plugin/README.md` | the plugin's own documentation — design, seams, what it deletes, limits |
| `install.mjs` | install / uninstall / dry-run for one profile, with revisioned Loader rows |
| `tools/test-host.mjs` | Host half against a throwaway session root: every refusal + a real recursive delete |
| `tools/test-client.mjs` | browser bundle against a fake `__ModuleLoader__`, module table, React, and `fetch` |
| `tools/test-route.mjs` | the **running** Host end to end: trust fence, cookie, routing, JSON contract |
| `tools/e2e-delete.mjs` | creates + archives one throwaway Session through the product's own API, then probes the guards |
| `tools/e2e-forged-delete.mjs` | **the real destructive run** (`--staged` for the deferred path): manufactures a stored Session, hands it to the plugin, audits the disk and every durable store, and cleans up |
| `tools/purge.mjs` | call the deletion route from a shell |
| `tools/remote.mjs` | call any Remote namespace/method from a shell (file-based I/O, so PowerShell quoting cannot mangle it) |
| `tools/watch-liveness.mjs` | watch whether the Host ever releases loaded Sessions |
| `tools/verify-paths.mjs` | the session-directory derivation, checked against every real Session header |
| `tools/cycle.mjs` | force one fresh Host-side import while iterating on a live profile |
| `tools/asar.mjs` | list / cat / extract-tree inside the shipped `app.asar` |
| `vendor/` | read-only extracts of the DSH packages this work depends on |
| `REPORT-host-rpc.md`, `REPORT-delete-archived-session.md` | the two research reports: client→Host seams, and session/Workspace durable state |

## What the research established

These are not in DSH's public docs, and each one changed the design:

**1. `ctx.connection.rpc.handle()` — the seam DSH's own docs point at — is broken in this
build.** It reads `webServer` through the Connection *service's* Context, which does not
declare that service in its `inject`, so Cordis' strict accessor throws
`cannot get property "webServer" without inject` from inside `register()`
(`dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js:656`). The plugin surfaces as a `FAILED` fiber with no
message anywhere. The working seam is `ctx.connection.fetch.register()`, an exact route on
the shared `/api` Fetch handler: matched before the Gateway's Remote interceptor, and
authenticated for free because the `/api` prefix route runs `connection.admit()` (Host/Origin
fence → signed cookie) before dispatching.

**2. Deleting a Session means deleting a directory, and only that directory.** There is no
deletion API anywhere: `sessionPersistence`'s seam is `create/open/stat/list/flush`;
`workspaceRegistry.delete()` removes a Workspace registration. A Session owns exactly
`<sessionsRoot>/<projectKey(cwd)>/<encodeSegment(id)>/` — log generations only, no lock file
on Windows. The one durable store that must also change is `$DSH_HOME/storages/workspace.json`
(the `workspace` domain: membership, archive set, pin set), reachable through
`Workspace.detachSession()` and `workspaceRegistry.unarchiveSession()`. The SQLite search
index is `:memory:`/`openAt: never` here and self-prunes when enabled; the projection cache
row is inert; attachments are shared content-addressed blobs that must **not** be touched.

**3. A loaded Session is unremovable, and it is what broke the first real click.** The Host
keeps every Session it has ever loaded for its whole lifetime — measured: six minutes of
idle polling with `tools/watch-liveness.mjs` and the loaded set never changed. No
plugin-reachable API unloads one (`ctx.sessions.enter()` throws for an id already in the
store; the Client's release never reaches the Host), and deleting the log underneath it
would produce a row that returns on the next refresh and cannot be opened, because
`sessionQuery.listSessions()` is the union of the in-memory store and the persisted headers.
Hence the deferred mode.

**4. The Host's own process has no `DSH_HOME`, and the Loader row has no evaluated config
root.** `process.env.DSH_HOME` is undefined inside the Host (it is injected only into tool
subprocesses), a `!!js dshHomePath('sessions')` row keeps an *unevaluated*
`{"__jsExpr":"dshHomePath('sessions')"}` marker in `options.config`, and there is no
`dshHomePath` global at runtime. Paths are therefore derived from the persistence layer's own
`locate()` results, with each `dirname` hop spelled out in a named helper.

Also measured, and encoded

plugins.description: War Room Protocol — autonomous AI-run software office led by Sloane (Chief Orchestrator). 15 specialists, 5 divisions, four-phase War Room with Prompt Writer + Knowledge Wizard.
plugins.readme_text:
# War Room Protocol 🏢

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![PRs Welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen.svg)](CONTRIBUTING.md)
[![Validate](https://github.com/nx9161/war-room-protocol/actions/workflows/validate.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/nx9161/war-room-protocol/actions/workflows/validate.yml)

> An autonomous AI-run software office. Say the phrase, and **Sloane** —
> Chief Orchestrator — boots 20 specialists across 6 divisions to design,
> build, secure, and ship software through a four-phase War Room.

## ⚡ Activate this office

Paste this to any AI agent:

> I want to use War Room Protocol from nx9161's github public repo.

For maximum reliability (some AIs can't browse or search fresh repos),
paste this full block instead:

> I want to use War Room Protocol from nx9161's github public repo.
> Fetch this exact URL — do not web-search for it:
> https://github.com/nx9161/war-room-protocol
> If you cannot fetch it, ask me to paste office/AGENTS.md and I will.

The office stays active until you say **"End War Room Protocol"** —
and while active, **every message you send goes through the War Room
loop** (full war room for big work, quick huddle for small stuff).

Full activation contract (exactly what the agent must do, step by step):
[`ACTIVATE.md`](ACTIVATE.md).

## 🔌 Install as a DeepSeek Harness plugin

Rather paste nothing at all? Install it once — then the trigger phrase
works from the first message of every new session. In the Harness
plugin screen, enter the GitHub address:

```
nx9161/war-room-protocol
```

or via CLI:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:nx9161/war-room-protocol
# local clone also works:
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/war-room-protocol
```

Then open a **new** session. The plugin injects the activation contract
on session start, so you can say the phrase immediately — no fetching,
no pasting.

The npm package name `dsh-plugin-war-room-protocol` is reserved for a
future publish; the GitHub address installs today. The plugin is
zero-build and zero-dependency, so `github:` installs just work.

## What this is

A complete software team as agent profiles. Product, architecture,
engineering, security, QA, DevOps, legal, and business analysis —
coordinated by Sloane, debated in the War Room before anything ships,
with every decision recorded. Built for owners who want senior-level
execution without managing a team.

Sister project: **[Seller Protocol](https://github.com/nx9161/seller-protocol)** —
the same operating model for Amazon FBA / DTC e-commerce, led by Mercer.

## How it works

**The Chief.** Sloane takes your request, dispatches specialists,
runs the War Room, and reports back status, numbers, and decisions
needed. One voice upward; zero fluff.

**The seats — 20 roles, 6 divisions.**

| Division | Seats |
|---|---|
| Product & UX | Product Owner, UI/UX Designer, Business Analyst |
| Architecture & Code | Enterprise Architect, Lead Backend Dev, Lead Mobile/Frontend Dev |
| Security & Compliance | AppSec Lead, AI Red Teamer, Global Tech Law Lead |
| Quality & Ops | QA Manager, DevOps / SRE, Prompt Writer, Knowledge Wizard |
| Legal & Governance | General Counsel |
| Games | Game Architect, Gameplay Designer, Game UI/UX Designer, Console Platform Engineer, Game Producer |
| **Leadership** | **Sloane (Chief Orchestrator)** |

Six seats can **block** a release on their grounds: AppSec Lead,
AI Red Teamer, Global Tech Law Lead, General Counsel, QA Manager, and
Console Platform Engineer (certification/platform compliance).
Blocks stand until cleared or the owner accepts the risk in writing.

**Playbooks** (`office/playbooks/`) — repeatable procedures, each run as
one subagent per step: `intake`, `war-room`, `ship-feature`, `fix-ci`,
`skill-hunt`.

**The War Room** — runs before any significant build:

- **Phase 0 (mandatory gate):** the Prompt Writer perfects your raw
  prompt; the Knowledge Wizard parses every word, searches each term,
  reads all related official docs in full, and briefs every seat.
  No seat speaks before the dossier lands.
- **Phase 1 — Intake & PRD:** Product Owner, UI/UX Designer, Business
  Analyst. Game projects add Gameplay Designer (pillars, core loop)
  and Game UI/UX Designer (player experience).
- **Phase 2 — Architectural debate:** Enterprise Architect vs. Backend,
  Frontend, DevOps. Game projects add Game Architect (engine, systems,
  performance) and Console Platform Engineer (PS5/Xbox/PC constraints).
- **Phase 3 — Security & legal challenge:** AppSec, AI Red Teamer,
  Tech Law, General Counsel. Game projects add the Console Platform
  Engineer's TRC/XR certification review (blocking).
- **Phase 4 — Build & QA sign-off:** branches, PRs, 100% pass gate.
  Game projects add the Game Producer's production gate.

**Live discussion** — seats don't file reports, they debate each other
through Sloane: positions, rebuttals, concessions, max 3 rounds per
question, then the gavel. Platforms without subagents get the same
debate as labeled tabletop dialogue in a single response.

**Phase regression** — phases aren't one-way. A finding that
invalidates earlier output loops the request back to that phase
(max 3 regressions per request, then Sloane escalates or terminates).

**"Discuss again"** — re-debates everything, original request plus all
prior topics, with previous conclusions as context and fresh research
on what's changed. New verdict references the prior ADR. No new
information, no theater — Sloane recommends instead.

**Sloane decides** — she monitors every phase gate with full
operational power: advance, loop back, re-scope, pause, escalate,
terminate. Money, production deploys, and external commitments still
need your explicit approval.

**Memory** (`memory/`) — the office's working memory: project notes,
decisions/ADRs, security policies, and your preferences. The office
reads it before acting and writes back every decision. See [Privacy](#-privacy--read-before-you-commit)
— this matters on a public repo.

**Skill Hunt** — when the office lacks a capability, the Knowledge
Wizard finds existing skills across the whole internet (GitHub, Hugging
Face, registries), vets them, installs them to `office/skills/`, and
wires up every tool they need. See `office/playbooks/skill-hunt.md`.

## Getting started — connect it to your system

Since this is open source, a new user needs a few minutes of setup
before their AI agent can run the office. Two paths:

### What you need

- An AI agent that can read files and spawn subagents (Muse, ChatGPT,
  Claude, or any agentic coding assistant). Agents without subagents
  (e.g. Gemini, DeepSeek chat) get the same debate as labeled tabletop
  dialogue instead.
- `git` — only if you want the local-integration path below.

### Option A — trigger phrase (30 seconds, zero setup)

Paste the activation phrase from [above](#-activate-this-office) into
any AI agent. It fetches this repo, loads the office bundle
(`office/AGENTS.md`), becomes Sloane, and confirms activation. Nothing
to install.

### Option B — local integration (recommended for daily use)

1. **Clone the repo:**
   `git clone https://github.com/nx9161/war-room-protocol && cd war-room-protocol`
2. **Give your agent the office.** Either:
   - Open the clone as your agent's working directory, or
   - Drop `office/AGENTS.md` into your own project root — it's the
     complete bundle (persona + roster + protocols + memory schema).
3. **Let it load memory.** The agent reads `memory/INDEX.md` first
   (Memory Operations Protocol, repo-root `AGENTS.md`), so it starts
   every session with full context.
4. **(Optional but recommended) connect GitHub:** run `gh auth login`.
   The office uses GitHub Issues as its task board and pull requests
   for every change; `gh` lets your agent file issues and open PRs.
5. **Talk to Sloane.** Give it work in plain language — text,
   screenshots, or voice notes (the intake playbook handles all three).
   End the session with **"End War Room Protocol"**.

### Option C — Codex global install (one-time)

Codex CLI auto-loads `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` at every session start.

# dsh-gongwen-word-check — Document register formatting-element check for official documents

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-gongwen-word-check` reads one document register — one row per issued document — and checks the text that register records against a versioned rule pack: whether `发文字号` follows the 「机关代字〔年份〕序号」 shape with the year in 六角括号〔〕, whether `成文日期` parses as a date and is not later than the day of the check, whether `文种` comes from the vocabulary your own unit configures, whether `主送机关` is filled in, whether `标题` stays within the configured length, whether a `发文字号` repeats anywhere in the register, and whether a title still holds an unreplaced template placeholder.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-gongwen-word-check: real output over its GW-006 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-gongwen-word-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-gongwen-word-check-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `GW-006` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| The document number was typed as `某政发[2026]15号`, with square brackets. | `GW-001` reports the row: the pattern it was configured with requires 六角括号〔〕 around the year, so `某政发〔2026〕15号` is the shape to write. The rule only checks the document number's form — the 机关代字 itself is set by your unit, so it does not judge whether the code is the right one, nor whether the serial numbers are consecutive or reused. |
| The signing date is written the way a document usually carries it: 二〇二六年三月十五日. | `GW-002` reports that it cannot parse this value. It reads `2026-03-15` and `2026-03-15 09:30`; a 汉字 date has to be written in one of those forms, or the rule switched off. The rule also does not check the signing date against the dispatch date — that is internal to the issuing workflow. |
| We never configured the list of 文种 for our unit. Does `GW-003` quietly pass? | No. `GW-003` carries no built-in list, so with `values` unset it appears in the report's `skipped` rather than passing silently. 《党政机关公文处理工作条例》 lists fifteen main kinds, but the pack does not hard-code them — which kinds your unit may use is your own decision. The rule also does not judge which kind a given document ought to have used. |
| A row leaves 主送机关 blank. | `GW-004` reports that row, because without a main recipient there is nothing to confirm who the document was sent to. It checks that the column is filled in, not whether the recipient range is the right one — who is addressed and who is copied is a drafting decision. |
| Our title is long. Where does the length limit come from? | `GW-005` reports a `标题` longer than the configured ceiling of 60 characters. That figure is this rule pack's default, not a standard number: GB/T 9704-2012 fixes 「2 号小标宋体字」 for the title and gives no character limit, so if your unit writes longer titles, raise `maxLength` or switch the rule off. The rule only counts characters — it does not judge the wording of the title. |
| Two rows carry the same 发文字号. | `GW-006` reports the repeated number; it compares values ignoring whitespace, and a hit usually means a reused or mistyped number that a human has to confirm. It does not decide which of the two documents should hold that number. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《党政机关公文格式》 | GB/T 9704-2012（现行，本次未取得条文） | GW-001, GW-002, GW-004, GW-005, GW-007 |
| 《党政机关公文处理工作条例》 | 中办发〔2012〕14号（自 2012 年 7 月 1 日起施行） | GW-003, GW-006 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks a **公文台账的版头与主体要素** for what a register can be held to
mechanically — that the document number follows its 「机关代字〔年份〕序号」 shape, that the signing date
parses, that the document kind comes from your vocabulary, that a main recipient is recorded, that the
title is not over-long, that numbers do not repeat, and that no template placeholder survives. It checks
**the text a register records, not the layout** — typeface, size, margins and seal placement can only be
judged from the document itself.

> ### ⚠️ What the citations in this plugin's report actually rest on
>
> **《党政机关公文处理工作条例》(中办发〔2012〕14号) was obtained and read verbatim**, and
> `rules/evidence/clause-verification.md` records which articles were quoted — article 8 (the fifteen document
> kinds), article 9 (the format elements, including 「发文字号。由发文机关代字、年份、发文顺序号组成」 and
> 「主送机关。公文的主要受理机关」), article 10 (which delegates layout to GB/T 9704-2012) and article 42
> (in force from 2012-07-01, superseding two earlier documents this pack therefore never cites).
>
> **GB/T 9704-2012 itself was not obtained.** That matters for one detail worth stating plainly: **the
> 六角括号〔〕 in `GW-001`'s pattern is the layout standard's convention, not something the regulation
> fixes** — article 9(5) requires only 「发文机关代字、年份、发文顺序号」.
>
> **The rule `excerpt` fields still say "本次未取得", and every rule remains `warn` or `info`.** What this
> plugin checks is what a *register of text* says; the regulation governs the *document*, so calling a blank
> column a `direct` breach of "a document shall consist of …" would overstate the finding. Half the rules rest
> on the layout standard or on your own convention in any case.
>
> Two thresholds are local, and the pack says so. The title-length ceiling (`GW-005`, 60 characters) is
> **this rule pack's default, not a standard figure** — article 9(7) fixes only that the title consists of the
> issuing body, the subject and the kind, and **no character count appears in either document**. And the
> document-kind vocabulary (`GW-003`) ships **empty** despite article 8 listing fifteen kinds, because the
> article says "主要有" and units also use names outside the list.
>
> The placeholder check deliberately **omits 「某」** from its term list: template titles often read
> "关于某某工作的通知", but 某 also appears in legitimate titles as a stand-in for a confidential subject.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately not declared: it has no reader and cannot reject a host |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native`, `ptc` and `both`; for a year's register use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `gongwen_word_check` tool. It reads one document register — one row per issued document — applies
a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GW-001` | the document number follows 「代字〔年份〕序号」 | warn | principle |
| `GW-002` | the signing date parses and is not in the future | warn | principle |
| `GW-003` | the document kind comes from your vocabulary (off by default) | info | local |
| `GW-004` | a main recipient is recorded | warn | principle |
| `GW-005` | the title is not over the configured length | warn | principle |
| `GW-006` | document numbers are unique in the register | warn | principle |
| `GW-007` | the title holds no unreplaced placeholder | warn | principle |

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-gongwen-word-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-gongwen-word-check'
```

## Configuration

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rulesFile` | string | `rules/gongwen-word-check.yaml` | Rule-pack path, relative to the package root |
| `disabledRules` | string[] | `[]` | Rule ids to stop running; each appears in `skipped` |
| `onlyRules` | string[] | `[]` | Run only these rule ids; empty runs every rule |
| `skipNotes` | string | `""` | Note appended to every `skipped` reason |
| `timeoutMs` | number | `120000` | Cooperative tool timeout budget |

Rule-level parameters worth knowing:

- `GW-001` `pattern` — the document-number shape. Widen it for joint issuances or minutes that carry no
  number, or disable the ru

plugins.readme_text:
# BabelDOC PDF Translate — 通用 Agent 技能

Layout-preserving PDF translation skill for **Codex and DeepSeek Harness**, powered by a separately installed BabelDOC runtime. Supports bilingual output, page selection, custom glossaries and contextual terminology review. Local parsing/typesetting; translation uses the provider you configure. No telemetry or bundled cloud account.

## Codex plugin 安装

```sh
codex plugin marketplace add reliable-ly0411/babeldoc-pdf-translate
```

在支持仓库市场的 Codex 客户端选择 `BabelDOC PDF Translate` 安装。该仓库市场独立于 OpenAI 官方公共目录，不代表官方收录。插件只封装技能；Python/BabelDOC 按部署文档另行安装。

## DeepSeek Harness skill 安装

DSH 原生发现项目 `.dsh/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`。在目标项目根目录运行：

```sh
git clone --branch main --depth 1 https://github.com/reliable-ly0411/babeldoc-pdf-translate.git .dsh/skills/babeldoc-pdf-translate
```

这是文件系统技能，无需安装 Cordis 插件或运行 npm 安装脚本。也可从本仓库复制 `skills/babeldoc-pdf-translate` 到 `.dsh/skills/` 或配置的用户技能目录。需要 DSH 的文件/命令工具和独立 BabelDOC 运行时；未声称验证所有 DSH 版本。

See [DSH's filesystem skill discovery](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/subsystems/skills.md). Root `SKILL.md` remains available for direct skill installers; the nested `skills/` copy is the Codex plugin payload. Maintainers edit the root skill resources, run `python scripts/sync_plugin_skill.py`, and check with `--check`.

## License / 许可

本仓库原创技能和适配脚本采用 MIT。`patches/babeldoc-0.6.4/` 中的上游衍生补丁采用 AGPL-3.0，见该目录的 LICENSE；嵌套技能内副本亦同。BabelDOC、PyMuPDF 及其他运行时依赖分别适用各自上游许可；完整依赖和二进制不包含在本仓库内。

入口：[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)。这是可分发的技能与脚本包，不是包含所有模型和依赖的独立翻译软件。

适用于支持文件访问和命令执行的 agent 平台；核心不依赖 Codex 工具。`agents/openai.yaml` 是可选界面元数据，其他平台可忽略。

## 快速使用

1. 将整个 `babeldoc-pdf-translate` 目录复制到目标平台支持的技能目录；若没有技能机制，让 agent 读取 SKILL.md。
2. 按 [部署说明](references/deployment.md) 配置 BabelDOC 运行时。
3. 告诉 agent PDF 路径、目标语言和偏好；服务未配置时也可先准备术语和作业草案。

示例请求：

> 使用这个技能把论文第 2–4 个物理页翻译为中文，输出交替页中英对照，只保留选中页。phase margin 固定翻译为相位裕度，其余术语结合控制领域上下文自动匹配。保留公式、图片和单位。云端接口稍后配置，先准备作业和术语表。

> 翻译整份 PDF，输出中文单语及左右对照两个版本。航空专有名词采用英文（中文），使用我提供的 CSV；先试译有公式和表格的两页。

## 本机聊天额度自动翻译

1.3.0 提供 Codex / DSH 原生客户端桥接：复制 `assets/job.codex.example.json` 或 `assets/job.dsh.example.json`，运行 `chat-doctor` 检查登录，再执行 `run --execute`。支持私有译文缓存、有限重试、中断清理和代码标识符保护；无需手动复制模型回复。Codex 使用 ChatGPT 登录额度；DSH 默认账户路由，也可在用户明确选择后复用已配置的官方 API 及余额。配置及边界见 [无人值守说明](references/unattended.md)，真实验收状态记录在 [Issue #8](https://github.com/reliable-ly0411/babeldoc-pdf-translate/issues/8)。

## 包结构

```text
SKILL.md              agent 入口与工作流程
scripts/              参数校验、引擎探测、PDF 检查与执行
references/           参数、术语、质量、部署和来源
assets/               作业、术语表、提示词模板
agents/               可选的平台界面元数据
requirements.txt      已测运行时版本基线
patches/              带哈希保护的 BabelDOC 0.6.4 兼容补丁及上游许可
```

支持单双语、双语页顺序、页码、术语表、自动术语提取、风格提示、字体、扫描处理、并发和云端兼容接口。专业领域判断由 agent 结合上下文完成；本包不自带各行业权威词库，不保证复杂 PDF 完全免返工。

运行与测试边界见 [VALIDATION.md](VALIDATION.md)。不要在分发包中加入个人密钥、PDF、缓存或虚拟环境。

1.2.0 的修复需要按部署文档显式运行 `scripts/repair_runtime.py --apply`；更新技能文件不会自动修改引擎。补丁检查原始文件哈希并保留可验证回滚副本，未知版本或文件会拒绝修改。`doctor` 仅证明 CLI 可用，`needs-review` 表示结构校验通过，译文与版式仍需检查。
